extension.text: Could I also get a blueberry muffin?
extension.annotatedText: Could I <u>al</u>so get a <u>blue</u>berry <u>muf</u>fin?
extension.translation: 能再来一个蓝莓马芬吗？

extension.text: Of course. Anything else?
extension.annotatedText: Of <u>course</u>. <u>An</u>ything else?
extension.translation: 当然，还要别的吗？

extension.text: No, that's it. Thanks.
extension.annotatedText: No, <u>that's</u> it. <u>Thanks</u>.
extension.translation: 不了，就这些。谢谢。

extension.text: Your total is six seventy-five. Cash or card?
extension.annotatedText: Your <u>to</u>tal is six <u>seven</u>ty-five. <u>Cash</u> or card?
extension.translation: 一共6.75美元。现金还是刷卡？

extension.text: Card, please.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Card</u>, please.
extension.translation: 刷卡。

practice.text: I'd like a medium latte, please.
practice.annotatedText: I'd <u>like</u> a <u>me</u>dium <u>lat</u>te, please.
practice.translation: 我想要一杯中杯拿铁。

practice.text: Would you like that hot or iced?
practice.annotatedText: Would you <u>like</u> that <u>hot</u> or <u>iced</u>?
practice.translation: 您要热的还是冰的？

practice.text: Can I get an extra shot of espresso?
practice.annotatedText: Can I get an <u>ex</u>tra <u>shot</u> of es<u>pres</u>so?
practice.translation: 能加一份浓缩吗？

practice.text: That will be four fifty.
practice.annotatedText: That will be <u>four</u> <u>fif</u>ty.
practice.translation: 一共4.5美元。

practice.text: Here you go — enjoy your drink!
practice.annotatedText: <u>Here</u> you go — en<u>joy</u> your <u>drink</u>!
practice.translation: 给您——请享用！

practice.text: Could I also get a blueberry muffin?
practice.annotatedText: Could I <u>al</u>so get a <u>blue</u>berry <u>muf</u>fin?
practice.translation: 能再来一个蓝莓马芬吗？

practice.text: Your total is six seventy-five.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>to</u>tal is six <u>seven</u>ty-five.
practice.translation: 一共6.75美元。

practice.text: Cash or card?
practice.annotatedText: <u>Cash</u> or <u>card</u>?
practice.translation: 现金还是刷卡？

extension.text: That sounds lovely. I'll make sure you get a window seat.
extension.annotatedText: That sounds <u>love</u>ly. I'll make sure you get a <u>win</u>dow seat.
extension.translation: 听起来不错。我会确保给你安排靠窗的座位。

extension.text: Thank you so much. Do you have a cake or anything like that?
extension.annotatedText: Thank you <u>so</u> much. Do you have a <u>cake</u> or anything like that?
extension.translation: 非常感谢。你们有蛋糕之类的东西吗？

extension.text: We can arrange a small birthday cake for an extra charge. Would you like one?
extension.annotatedText: We can arrange a small <u>birth</u>day cake for an <u>ex</u>tra charge. Would you <u>like</u> one?
extension.translation: 我们可以额外收费安排一个小生日蛋糕。您想要一个吗？

extension.text: Yes, please. That would be perfect.
extension.annotatedText: Yes, <u>please</u>. That would be <u>per</u>fect.
extension.translation: 好的，麻烦了。那太好了。

practice.text: I'd like to make a reservation for Friday evening.
practice.annotatedText: I'd like to make a <u>res</u>ervation for <u>Fri</u>day <u>eve</u>ning.
practice.translation: 我想预订周五晚上的位子。

practice.text: Table for four at seven thirty, please.
practice.annotatedText: Table for <u>four</u> at <u>sev</u>en <u>thir</u>ty, please.
practice.translation: 四个人，七点半。

practice.text: Can I get a name for the reservation?
practice.annotatedText: Can I get a <u>name</u> for the <u>res</u>ervation?
practice.translation: 请问预订人的名字？

practice.text: It's under Chen — C-H-E-N.
practice.annotatedText: It's under <u>Chen</u> — <u>C</u>-<u>H</u>-<u>E</u>-<u>N</u>.
practice.translation: 姓陈，C-H-E-N。

practice.text: Is there anything special you're celebrating tonight?
practice.annotatedText: Is there <u>an</u>ything <u>spe</u>cial you're <u>cel</u>ebrating tonight?
practice.translation: 今晚有什么特别的庆祝活动吗？

practice.text: It's my wife's birthday — could we get a nice table by the window?
practice.annotatedText: It's my <u>wife's</u> birthday — could we get a <u>nice</u> table by the <u>win</u>dow?
practice.translation: 是我妻子的生日——能安排靠窗的好位置吗？

practice.text: I'll make a note of that. See you Friday!
practice.annotatedText: I'll make a <u>note</u> of that. See you <u>Fri</u>day!
practice.translation: 我会备注的。周五见！

practice.text: We can arrange a small birthday cake for an extra charge.
practice.annotatedText: We can arrange a small <u>birth</u>day cake for an <u>ex</u>tra charge.
practice.translation: 我们可以额外收费安排一个小生日蛋糕。

extension.text: I've attached the revised proposal for your perusal.
extension.annotatedText: I've <u>at</u>tached the <u>re</u>vised <u>pro</u>posal for your perusal.
extension.translation: 我把修改后的提案附上供您参阅。

extension.text: Could you please review it and let me know your thoughts?
extension.annotatedText: Could you please re<u>view</u> it and let me <u>know</u> your thoughts?
extension.translation: 能不能请您看一下，然后告诉我您的想法？

extension.text: I'd like to schedule a call to discuss the next steps.
extension.annotatedText: I'd like to <u>sched</u>ule a call to dis<u>cuss</u> the next steps.
extension.translation: 我想安排一个电话会议讨论下一步。

extension.text: What time works best for you later this week?
extension.annotatedText: What time <u>works</u> best for you later this <u>week</u>?
extension.translation: 这周晚些时候你什么时间方便？

extension.text: I'm available on Thursday afternoon if that suits you.
extension.annotatedText: I'm a<u>vail</u>able on <u>Thurs</u>day afternoon if that suits you.
extension.translation: 我周四下午有空，你看合适吗？

extension.text: Let me confirm the meeting details via email.
extension.annotatedText: Let me con<u>firm</u> the <u>meet</u>ing details via email.
extension.translation: 我通过邮件确认一下会议细节。

practice.text: I'm writing to follow up on our conversation from last week.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>writ</u>ing to <u>fol</u>low up on our conversation from <u>last</u> week.
practice.translation: 我写邮件是为了跟进我们上周的谈话。

practice.text: Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
practice.annotatedText: Please do not <u>hes</u>itate to <u>reach</u> out if you have any <u>ques</u>tions.
practice.translation: 如果有任何问题，请随时联系我。

practice.text: I'd appreciate it if you could get back to me by Friday.
practice.annotatedText: I'd ap<u>pre</u>ciate it if you could get <u>back</u> to me by <u>Fri</u>day.
practice.translation: 如果您能在周五前回复，我将不胜感激。

practice.text: Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Look</u>ing forward to <u>hear</u>ing from you <u>soon</u>.
practice.translation: 期待您的回复。

practice.text: Please find the attached document for your review.
practice.annotatedText: Please <u>find</u> the at<u>tached</u> document for your re<u>view</u>.
practice.translation: 请查收附件文件供您审阅。

practice.text: Let me know if you need any clarification on the points discussed.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>know</u> if you need any clarifi<u>ca</u>tion on the points dis<u>cussed</u>.
practice.translation: 如果对讨论的要点需要任何澄清，请告诉我。

practice.text: I've attached the revised proposal for your perusal.
practice.annotatedText: I've at<u>tached</u> the re<u>vised</u> <u>pro</u>posal for your perusal.
practice.translation: 我把修改后的提案附上供您参阅。

practice.text: Could you please review it and let me know your thoughts?
practice.annotatedText: Could you please re<u>view</u> it and let me <u>know</u> your thoughts?
practice.translation: 能不能请您看一下，然后告诉我您的想法？

extension.text: Sure, I'll be right back with that.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, I'll be <u>right</u> back with <u>that</u>.
extension.translation: 好的，我马上拿过来。

extension.text: Thanks. Oh, and do you have this in a medium?
extension.annotatedText: Thanks. Oh, and do you have <u>this</u> in a <u>medium</u>?
extension.translation: 谢谢。哦，这个有中号吗？

extension.text: Let me check. We have a large, but the medium is out of stock right now.
extension.annotatedText: Let me <u>check</u>. We have a <u>large</u>, but the medium is out of <u>stock</u> right now.
extension.translation: 我查一下。有大号的，但是中号现在缺货。

extension.text: Hmm, that's too bad. Could you order one for me?
extension.annotatedText: Hmm, that's <u>too</u> bad. Could you <u>order</u> one for me?
extension.translation: 嗯，太可惜了。你能帮我订一件吗？

extension.text: Of course. It'll take about 3 to 5 business days to arrive.
extension.annotatedText: Of <u>course</u>. It'll take about <u>3</u> to <u>5</u> business days to arrive.
extension.translation: 当然可以。大约3到5个工作日就能到。

extension.text: That works for me. Can I just exchange it when it comes in?
extension.annotatedText: That <u>works</u> for me. Can I just <u>exchange</u> it when it comes <u>in</u>?
extension.translation: 没问题。到货的时候直接换就行吗？

extension.text: Absolutely. I'll put your name on it and call you when it's here.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Absolutely</u>. I'll put your <u>name</u> on it and call you when it's <u>here</u>.
extension.translation: 当然。我会记下您的名字，到货后给您打电话。

extension.text: Great, thank you so much for your help!
extension.annotatedText: Great, thank you <u>so</u> much for your <u>help</u>!
extension.translation: 太好了，非常感谢你的帮助！

practice.text: I'd like to return this shirt.
practice.annotatedText: I'd like to <u>return</u> this <u>shirt</u>.
practice.translation: 我想退这件衬衫。

practice.text: Do you have the receipt?
practice.annotatedText: Do you have the <u>receipt</u>?
practice.translation: 您有收据吗？

practice.text: I bought it just two days ago.
practice.annotatedText: I bought it <u>just</u> two <u>days</u> ago.
practice.translation: 我两天前刚买的。

practice.text: Would you like a refund or an exchange?
practice.annotatedText: Would you like a <u>refund</u> or an <u>exchange</u>?
practice.translation: 您要退款还是换货？

practice.text: I'd like to exchange it for a larger size.
practice.annotatedText: I'd like to <u>exchange</u> it for a <u>larger</u> size.
practice.translation: 我想换一件大一号的。

practice.text: Let me check if we have that in stock.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>check</u> if we have that in <u>stock</u>.
practice.translation: 我查一下有没有库存。

practice.text: Could you order one for me?
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>order</u> one for <u>me</u>?
practice.translation: 你能帮我订一件吗？

practice.text: It'll take about 3 to 5 business days to arrive.
practice.annotatedText: It'll take about <u>3</u> to <u>5</u> business days to <u>arrive</u>.
practice.translation: 大约3到5个工作日到货。

extension.text: Could you tell me if Dr. Smith has any availability tomorrow morning?
extension.annotatedText: Could you <u>tell</u> me if Dr. <u>Smith</u> has any availability <u>to</u>morrow morning?
extension.translation: 你能告诉我Smith医生明早有没有空吗？

extension.text: I'm afraid not, but we do have a cancellation at 2pm today if that helps.
extension.annotatedText: I'm a<u>fraid</u> not, but we <u>do</u> have a cancellation at <u>2pm</u> today if that helps.
extension.translation: 恐怕没有，不过我们今天下午2点有个取消的预约，你看行不行？

extension.text: Oh, that's perfect. I'll take that slot.
extension.annotatedText: Oh, that's <u>per</u>fect. I'll <u>take</u> that slot.
extension.translation: 哦，那太好了。我就约这个时间。

extension.text: Great, I've booked you in. Please remember to bring your insurance card.
extension.annotatedText: Great, I've <u>booked</u> you in. Please re<u>mem</u>ber to bring your <u>in</u>surance card.
extension.translation: 好的，已经帮您预约了。请记得带保险卡。

extension.text: Also, could you describe your symptoms in more detail?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Al</u>so, could you de<u>scribe</u> your <u>symp</u>toms in more detail?
extension.translation: 另外，您能更详细地描述一下您的症状吗？

extension.text: Well, it's a dry cough and it gets worse at night.
extension.annotatedText: Well, it's a <u>dry</u> cough and it gets <u>worse</u> at night.
extension.translation: 嗯，是干咳，晚上会更严重。

extension.text: Have you taken any medication for it yet?
extension.annotatedText: Have you <u>tak</u>en any <u>med</u>ication for it yet?
extension.translation: 您有没有吃过什么药？

extension.text: No, I haven't. I wanted to see the doctor first.
extension.annotatedText: No, I <u>have</u>n't. I <u>want</u>ed to see the <u>doc</u>tor first.
extension.translation: 没有，我想先看看医生再说。

practice.text: I'd like to book an appointment with Dr. Smith.
practice.annotatedText: I'd <u>like</u> to <u>book</u> an a<u>ppoint</u>ment with Dr. Smith.
practice.translation: 我想预约Smith医生。

practice.text: Is it for a regular check-up or something specific?
practice.annotatedText: Is it for a <u>reg</u>ular <u>check</u>-up or <u>some</u>thing specific?
practice.translation: 是常规体检还是具体的问题？

practice.text: I've had this persistent cough for over a week now.
practice.annotatedText: I've had this per<u>sist</u>ent <u>cough</u> for over a <u>week</u> now.
practice.translation: 我持续咳嗽已经超过一周了。

practice.text: The earliest available slot is Thursday at 10am.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>ear</u>liest a<u>vail</u>able <u>slot</u> is Thursday at 10am.
practice.translation: 最早可约的时间是周四上午10点。

practice.text: Please bring your insurance card and arrive 15 minutes early.
practice.annotatedText: Please <u>bring</u> your in<u>sur</u>ance card and ar<u>rive</u> 15 minutes early.
practice.translation: 请带好保险卡并提前15分钟到。

practice.text: Could you describe your symptoms in more detail?
practice.annotatedText: Could you de<u>scribe</u> your <u>symp</u>toms in more de<u>tail</u>?
practice.translation: 您能更详细地描述一下您的症状吗？

practice.text: I'm afraid we don't have any openings until next week.
practice.annotatedText: I'm a<u>fraid</u> we don't have <u>a</u>ny <u>o</u>penings until next week.
practice.translation: 恐怕我们直到下周都没有空位了。

practice.text: Make sure to arrive 15 minutes early to fill out forms.
practice.annotatedText: Make <u>sure</u> to ar<u>rive</u> 15 minutes <u>ear</u>ly to fill out forms.
practice.translation: 记得提前15分钟到填写表格。

extension.text: No problem! By the way, is there a good café near the museum?
extension.annotatedText: No <u>pro</u>blem! By the way, is there a <u>good</u> café near the museum?
extension.translation: 不客气！顺便问一下，博物馆附近有好咖啡厅吗？

extension.text: Yeah, there's a lovely one just around the corner — they do a great scone.
extension.annotatedText: Yeah, there's a <u>love</u>ly one just around the <u>cor</u>ner — they do a great <u>scone</u>.
extension.translation: 有啊，拐角就有一家不错的——他们家的司康饼很好吃。

extension.text: Perfect, I'll check it out after visiting the museum. Cheers!
extension.annotatedText: <u>Per</u>fect, I'll check it out after <u>vis</u>iting the museum. <u>Cheers</u>!
extension.translation: 太好了，我参观完博物馆就去看看。谢啦！

practice.text: Can you tell me the way to the train station?
practice.annotatedText: Can you <u>tell</u> me the <u>way</u> to the train station?
practice.translation: 你能告诉我去火车站怎么走吗？

practice.text: Go straight and then take the first left.
practice.annotatedText: Go <u>straight</u> and then take the <u>first</u> left.
practice.translation: 直走然后第一个路口左转。

practice.text: It's about a ten-minute walk from here.
practice.annotatedText: It's about a <u>ten</u>-minute <u>walk</u> from here.
practice.translation: 从这里走过去大约十分钟。

practice.text: You'll see a red brick building on your right.
practice.annotatedText: You'll see a <u>red</u> brick <u>build</u>ing on your right.
practice.translation: 你会看到右手边一栋红砖楼。

practice.text: Is it far or can I walk there?
practice.annotatedText: Is it <u>far</u> or can I <u>walk</u> there?
practice.translation: 远不远，我能走过去吗？

practice.text: It's not too far — just keep going until you see the big sign.
practice.annotatedText: It's not too <u>far</u> — just keep <u>go</u>ing until you see the <u>big</u> sign.
practice.translation: 不太远——一直走直到你看到那个大牌子。

practice.text: You might want to take the bus — it's a bit of a trek.
practice.annotatedText: You might <u>want</u> to take the <u>bus</u> — it's a bit of a <u>trek</u>.
practice.translation: 你也许该坐公交——有一段路要走。

practice.text: Thanks for your help! I think I've got it now.
practice.annotatedText: Thanks for your <u>help</u>! I think I've <u>got</u> it now.
practice.translation: 谢谢你的帮助！我想我明白了。

extension.text: Could I take a look at the kitchen and the bathroom?
extension.annotatedText: Could I <u>take</u> a <u>look</u> at the kitchen and the bathroom?
extension.translation: 我能看看厨房和卫生间吗？

extension.text: Sure, the kitchen's got a new fridge and a microwave.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, the kitchen's <u>got</u> a <u>new</u> fridge and a microwave.
extension.translation: 当然，厨房配了新冰箱和微波炉。

extension.text: Is there any parking available for tenants?
extension.annotatedText: Is there any <u>parking</u> available for <u>tenants</u>?
extension.translation: 租户有停车位吗？

extension.text: Yes, there's a garage space included in the rent.
extension.annotatedText: Yes, <u>there's</u> a <u>garage</u> space included in the rent.
extension.translation: 有的，房租里包含一个车库车位。

extension.text: Great, I'll take it! Let's start the paperwork.
extension.annotatedText: Great, I'll <u>take</u> it! Let's <u>start</u> the paperwork.
extension.translation: 太好了，我租了！我们来办手续吧。

practice.text: I'm here to see the apartment I called about.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>here</u> to see the a<u>partment</u> I <u>called</u> about.
practice.translation: 我来看看之前电话里说的那套公寓。

practice.text: Let me show you around the living area.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>show</u> you a<u>round</u> the <u>living</u> area.
practice.translation: 我带你看看客厅。

practice.text: Is the apartment fully furnished?
practice.annotatedText: Is the a<u>partment</u> <u>fully</u> <u>furnished</u>?
practice.translation: 公寓是拎包入住的吗？

practice.text: Utilities like water and electricity are separate.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Utilities</u> like water and <u>electricity</u> are <u>separate</u>.
practice.translation: 水费电费这些是分开算的。

practice.text: The lease is for twelve months with a deposit.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>lease</u> is for <u>twelve</u> months with a <u>deposit</u>.
practice.translation: 租期十二个月，要付押金。

practice.text: When can I move in after signing the contract?
practice.annotatedText: When can I <u>move</u> in after <u>signing</u> the <u>contract</u>?
practice.translation: 签完合同什么时候能搬进来？

practice.text: The paperwork should be done by next week.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>paperwork</u> should be <u>done</u> by <u>next</u> week.
practice.translation: 手续应该下周能办好。

practice.text: I'll take the apartment and start the lease today.
practice.annotatedText: I'll <u>take</u> the a<u>partment</u> and <u>start</u> the lease today.
practice.translation: 我要租这套公寓，今天就签租约。

extension.text: Every step you take is a step closer to your goal.
extension.annotatedText: Every <u>step</u> you <u>take</u> is a step closer to your <u>goal</u>.
extension.translation: 你迈出的每一步都离目标更近。

extension.text: Don't let fear hold you back from what you can achieve.
extension.annotatedText: Don't let <u>fear</u> hold you <u>back</u> from what you can <u>achieve</u>.
extension.translation: 别让恐惧阻止你去实现你能做到的事。

extension.text: Every time you fall, get up and try again.
extension.annotatedText: Every time you <u>fall</u>, <u>get up</u> and <u>try again</u>.
extension.translation: 每次跌倒，就爬起来再试一次。

extension.text: Your passion is your power; use it to light your path.
extension.annotatedText: Your <u>passion</u> is your <u>power</u>; use it to <u>light</u> your path.
extension.translation: 你的热情就是你的力量，用它来照亮你的路。

extension.text: Believe in yourself, even when no one else does.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Believe</u> in your<u>self</u>, even when no one else <u>does</u>.
extension.translation: 相信自己，即使别人都不相信你。

extension.text: Small efforts every day lead to big results.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Small</u> ef<u>forts</u> every day lead to <u>big</u> results.
extension.translation: 每天的小努力会带来大成果。

practice.text: You have the power to change your life today.
practice.annotatedText: You have the <u>power</u> to <u>change</u> your <u>life</u> today.
practice.translation: 你今天就有能力改变你的人生。

practice.text: Don't wait for the perfect moment; start now.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>wait</u> for the <u>perfect</u> moment; <u>start</u> now.
practice.translation: 不要等待完美的时刻，现在就开始。

practice.text: Your dreams are worth fighting for every single day.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>dreams</u> are worth <u>fighting</u> for every single <u>day</u>.
practice.translation: 你的梦想值得你每天去奋斗。

practice.text: The only limit is the one you set for yourself.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>only</u> limit is the one you <u>set</u> for your<u>self</u>.
practice.translation: 唯一的限制是你给自己设定的。

practice.text: Keep going, even when it gets tough.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Keep</u> <u>going</u>, even when it gets <u>tough</u>.
practice.translation: 坚持下去，即使很难。

practice.text: You are capable of more than you know.
practice.annotatedText: You are <u>capable</u> of <u>more</u> than you <u>know</u>.
practice.translation: 你的能力超乎你的想象。

practice.text: Every challenge is an opportunity to grow.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>challenge</u> is an <u>opportunity</u> to <u>grow</u>.
practice.translation: 每一个挑战都是成长的机会。

practice.text: Your journey is unique; embrace it fully.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>journey</u> is <u>unique</u>; embrace it <u>fully</u>.
practice.translation: 你的旅程独一无二，尽情拥抱它吧。

extension.text: So, how do we embrace this mindset?
extension.annotatedText: So, how do we em<u>brace</u> this <u>mind</u>set?
extension.translation: 那么，我们如何拥抱这种心态呢？

extension.text: It starts by admitting that we don't know everything.
extension.annotatedText: It starts by ad<u>mit</u>ting that we don't <u>know</u> everything.
extension.translation: 首先要承认我们并非无所不知。

extension.text: And that's okay — it's actually freeing.
extension.annotatedText: And that's o<u>kay</u> — it's ac<u>tual</u>ly <u>free</u>ing.
extension.translation: 这没关系——实际上是一种解脱。

extension.text: You don't have to have all the answers, you just have to keep asking the right questions.
extension.annotatedText: You don't have to have <u>all</u> the answers, you just have to keep <u>ask</u>ing the right <u>ques</u>tions.
extension.translation: 你不必知道所有答案，只需持续提出正确的问题。

extension.text: Think about the last time you learned something new — how did it make you feel?
extension.annotatedText: Think about the <u>last</u> time you learned something <u>new</u> — how did it make you <u>feel</u>?
extension.translation: 想想你上次学到新东西的时候——那让你感觉如何？

extension.text: Probably a little uncomfortable, but also excited.
extension.annotatedText: Prob<u>ab</u>ly a little uncom<u>fort</u>able, but also ex<u>cit</u>ed.
extension.translation: 可能有点不舒服，但也兴奋。

extension.text: That's the sweet spot — where growth happens.
extension.annotatedText: That's the <u>sweet</u> spot — where <u>growth</u> happens.
extension.translation: 那就是最佳状态——成长发生的地方。

extension.text: So go ahead: read a book, take a course, or just have a conversation with someone who challenges you.
extension.annotatedText: So go a<u>head</u>: read a <u>book</u>, take a <u>course</u>, or just have a conversation with someone who chal<u>lenges</u> you.
extension.translation: 所以去吧：读一本书，上一门课，或者和能挑战你的人聊聊天。

practice.text: Toffler's idea of the illiterate has never been more relevant.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Tof</u>fler's i<u>de</u>a of the il<u>lit</u>erate has never been more <u>rel</u>evant.
practice.translation: 托夫勒关于文盲的观点从未如此贴切。

practice.text: We must unlearn old habits that no longer serve us.
practice.annotatedText: We must <u>un</u>learn old <u>hab</u>its that no longer <u>serve</u> us.
practice.translation: 我们必须抛弃不再有用的旧习惯。

practice.text: Relearning means staying adaptable in a fast-changing world.
practice.annotatedText: Re<u>learn</u>ing means staying a<u>dapt</u>able in a fast-<u>chang</u>ing world.
practice.translation: 重新学习意味着在快速变化的世界中保持适应能力。

practice.text: Continuous learning is the engine of personal growth.
practice.annotatedText: Con<u>tin</u>uous <u>learn</u>ing is the <u>en</u>gine of personal <u>growth</u>.
practice.translation: 持续学习是个人成长的引擎。

practice.text: Every setback is a lesson in disguise.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>set</u>back is a <u>les</u>son in dis<u>guise</u>.
practice.translation: 每一次挫折都是一堂伪装的课。

practice.text: Don't let fear of failure stop you from trying something new.
practice.annotatedText: Don't let <u>fear</u> of <u>fail</u>ure stop you from <u>try</u>ing something <u>new</u>.
practice.translation: 别让对失败的恐惧阻止你尝试新事物。

practice.text: The best learners are those who ask 'why' and 'what if'.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>best</u> learners are those who ask '<u>why</u>' and '<u>what</u> if'.
practice.translation: 最好的学习者会问“为什么”和“如果……会怎样”。

practice.text: Stay foolish means embracing vulnerability in the pursuit of knowledge.
practice.annotatedText: Stay <u>foo</u>lish means em<u>brac</u>ing <u>vul</u>nerability in the pursuit of <u>knowl</u>edge.
practice.translation: 保持愚钝意味着在追求知识时拥抱脆弱。

extension.text: The prime minister stressed that time is running out for meaningful change.
extension.annotatedText: The prime minister <u>stressed</u> that time is <u>running out</u> for meaningful change.
extension.translation: 首相强调，做出实质性改变的时间不多了。

extension.text: He urged all parties to put aside their differences and work together.
extension.annotatedText: He urged <u>all parties</u> to put aside their <u>differences</u> and work together.
extension.translation: 他敦促各方搁置分歧，共同努力。

extension.text: Meanwhile, environmental groups have voiced strong support for the plan.
extension.annotatedText: Meanwhile, environmental groups have voiced <u>strong support</u> for the plan.
extension.translation: 与此同时，环保组织对该计划表示强烈支持。

extension.text: But some critics argue the targets are not ambitious enough.
extension.annotatedText: But some critics argue the targets are <u>not ambitious enough</u>.
extension.translation: 但一些批评者认为目标还不够雄心勃勃。

extension.text: The debate is set to be heated, with both sides digging in their heels.
extension.annotatedText: The debate is set to be <u>heated</u>, with both sides <u>digging in their heels</u>.
extension.translation: 辩论预计会很激烈，双方都各持己见。

extension.text: A government spokesperson confirmed that the proposal has cross-party backing.
extension.annotatedText: A government spokesperson confirmed that the proposal has <u>cross-party backing</u>.
extension.translation: 一位政府发言人证实，该提案得到了跨党派支持。

extension.text: If approved, it would represent a major shift in national policy.
extension.annotatedText: If approved, it would represent a <u>major shift</u> in national policy.
extension.translation: 如果获批，它将代表国家政策的重大转变。

extension.text: We'll bring you more updates as the story develops.
extension.annotatedText: We'll bring you <u>more updates</u> as the story develops.
extension.translation: 我们将随着事态发展带来更多更新。

practice.text: Authorities have announced new measures to tackle climate change.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Authorities</u> have announced new <u>measures</u> to tackle climate change.
practice.translation: 当局宣布了应对气候变化的新措施。

practice.text: The initiative aims to reduce carbon emissions by forty percent.
practice.annotatedText: The initiative aims to <u>reduce</u> carbon emissions by <u>forty percent</u>.
practice.translation: 该倡议旨在将碳排放减少40%。

practice.text: This is a crucial step toward a sustainable future.
practice.annotatedText: This is a <u>crucial step</u> toward a <u>sustainable</u> future.
practice.translation: 这是迈向可持续未来的关键一步。

practice.text: The full report is expected to be published early next month.
practice.annotatedText: The full report is expected to be published <u>early next month</u>.
practice.translation: 完整报告预计下月初公布。

practice.text: Opposition leaders have called for more aggressive action.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Opposition</u> leaders have called for <u>more aggressive</u> action.
practice.translation: 反对派领导人呼吁采取更激进的行动。

practice.text: A final decision will be reached after the parliamentary debate.
practice.annotatedText: A final decision will be <u>reached</u> after the parliamentary <u>debate</u>.
practice.translation: 最终决定将在议会辩论后做出。

practice.text: The prime minister stressed that time is running out.
practice.annotatedText: The prime minister <u>stressed</u> that time is <u>running out</u>.
practice.translation: 首相强调时间不多了。

practice.text: Environmental groups have voiced strong support for the plan.
practice.annotatedText: Environmental groups have voiced <u>strong support</u> for the plan.
practice.translation: 环保组织对该计划表示强烈支持。

extension.text: Remember, success isn't about perfection — it's about progress.
extension.annotatedText: Remember, success isn't about perfection — it's about <u>pro</u>gress.
extension.translation: 记住，成功不在于完美——而在于进步。

extension.text: You've got the skills and the passion to change the world.
extension.annotatedText: You've got the skills and the <u>pas</u>sion to change the world.
extension.translation: 你们有技能，有热情，去改变世界。

extension.text: Stay curious, stay humble, and keep learning every single day.
extension.annotatedText: Stay <u>cu</u>rious, stay <u>hum</u>ble, and keep learning every single day.
extension.translation: 保持好奇，保持谦逊，每天都要学习。

extension.text: The friendships you've built here will last a lifetime — cherish them.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>friend</u>ships you've built here will last a lifetime — <u>cher</u>ish them.
extension.translation: 你们在这里建立的友谊会持续一生——珍惜它们。

extension.text: When doubt creeps in, look back at how far you've come.
extension.annotatedText: When doubt <u>creeps</u> in, look back at how <u>far</u> you've come.
extension.translation: 当怀疑袭来时，回头看看你们已经走了多远。

extension.text: Your journey doesn't end here — it's just getting started.
extension.annotatedText: Your <u>jour</u>ney doesn't end here — it's just <u>get</u>ting started.
extension.translation: 你们的旅程没有结束——才刚刚开始。

extension.text: Take risks, make mistakes, and learn from every experience.
extension.annotatedText: Take <u>risks</u>, make mis<u>takes</u>, and learn from every ex<u>pe</u>rience.
extension.translation: 敢于冒险，犯错，并从每一次经历中学习。

practice.text: Class of 2024, you've made us incredibly proud.
practice.annotatedText: Class of 2024, you've made us in<u>cred</u>ibly proud.
practice.translation: 2024届的毕业生们，你们让我们无比自豪。

practice.text: Never forget the late nights and the early mornings.
practice.annotatedText: Never for<u>get</u> the late nights and the early <u>morn</u>ings.
practice.translation: 永远不要忘记那些熬夜和早起的日子。

practice.text: Your hard work has paid off — congratulations!
practice.annotatedText: Your hard work has <u>paid</u> off — con<u>grat</u>ulations!
practice.translation: 你们的努力有了回报——恭喜！

practice.text: Keep pushing boundaries and challenging yourselves.
practice.annotatedText: Keep <u>push</u>ing boundaries and <u>chal</u>lenging yourselves.
practice.translation: 不断突破界限，挑战自我。

practice.text: The world needs your unique talents and perspectives.
practice.annotatedText: The world needs your u<u>nique</u> talents and per<u>spec</u>tives.
practice.translation: 世界需要你们独特的才华和视角。

practice.text: Don't let fear hold you back from pursuing your dreams.
practice.annotatedText: Don't let fear hold you back from pur<u>su</u>ing your dreams.
practice.translation: 不要让恐惧阻止你们追求梦想。

practice.text: Embrace uncertainty — it's where growth happens.
practice.annotatedText: Embrace un<u>cer</u>tainty — it's where <u>growth</u> happens.
practice.translation: 拥抱不确定性——那是成长发生的地方。

practice.text: You are the architects of your own future.
practice.annotatedText: You are the <u>ar</u>chitects of your own <u>fu</u>ture.
practice.translation: 你们是自己未来的建筑师。

extension.text: We're not just launching a product; we're starting a movement.
extension.annotatedText: We're not just <u>launching</u> a product; we're <u>starting</u> a <u>move</u>ment.
extension.translation: 我们不只是发布一个产品，而是在开启一场运动。

extension.text: From day one, we asked ourselves: how can we make people's lives actually better?
extension.annotatedText: From <u>day</u> one, we asked ourselves: how can we make people's lives <u>ac</u>tually <u>bet</u>ter?
extension.translation: 从第一天起，我们就问自己：我们如何才能真正改善人们的生活？

extension.text: And this device is the answer — it's intuitive, it's powerful, and it's for everyone.
extension.annotatedText: And this device is the <u>an</u>swer — it's in<u>tui</u>tive, it's <u>pow</u>erful, and it's for <u>ev</u>eryone.
extension.translation: 而这个设备就是答案——它直观、强大，而且人人可用。

extension.text: We've already tested it with thousands of users, and the feedback has been overwhelming.
extension.annotatedText: We've already <u>test</u>ed it with <u>thou</u>sands of users, and the feedback has been <u>o</u>verwhelming.
extension.translation: 我们已经在上千名用户中测试过，反馈非常热烈。

extension.text: They told us it changed the way they work, play, and connect.
extension.annotatedText: They told us it <u>changed</u> the way they <u>work</u>, <u>play</u>, and con<u>nect</u>.
extension.translation: 他们告诉我们，这改变了他们工作、娱乐和社交的方式。

extension.text: So today, I'm proud to say this is just the beginning.
extension.annotatedText: So to<u>day</u>, I'm <u>proud</u> to say this is just the be<u>gin</u>ning.
extension.translation: 所以今天，我很自豪地说，这仅仅是个开始。

extension.text: We're already working on version two — and trust me, it's going to blow your mind.
extension.annotatedText: We're already <u>work</u>ing on <u>ver</u>sion two — and trust me, it's going to <u>blow</u> your mind.
extension.translation: 我们已经开始研发第二代了——相信我，它会让你大吃一惊。

practice.text: Our new chip delivers unprecedented performance.
practice.annotatedText: Our new <u>chip</u> delivers <u>un</u>precedented per<u>for</u>mance.
practice.translation: 我们的新芯片带来了前所未有的性能。

practice.text: Battery life has been extended to 18 hours on a single charge.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Bat</u>tery life has been ex<u>tend</u>ed to 18 hours on a single <u>charge</u>.
practice.translation: 单次充电续航延长至18小时。

practice.text: The interface is so simple, a child could use it.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>in</u>terface is so <u>sim</u>ple, a child could <u>use</u> it.
practice.translation: 界面非常简单，连小孩都会用。

practice.text: We've partnered with top developers to create exclusive apps.
practice.annotatedText: We've <u>part</u>nered with top de<u>vel</u>opers to create ex<u>clu</u>sive apps.
practice.translation: 我们与顶级开发者合作，打造专属应用。

practice.text: Security is our top priority — your data stays private.
practice.annotatedText: Se<u>cu</u>rity is our top pri<u>or</u>ity — your data stays <u>pri</u>vate.
practice.translation: 安全是我们的首要任务——你的数据保持私密。

practice.text: Pre-orders start today, with shipping in four weeks.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Pre</u>-orders start to<u>day</u>, with <u>ship</u>ping in four weeks.
practice.translation: 今天开始预售，四周后发货。

practice.text: Early adopters get a special discount and a free accessory pack.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Early</u> a<u>dop</u>ters get a <u>spe</u>cial discount and a free ac<u>ces</u>sory pack.
practice.translation: 早期用户可享受特别折扣和免费配件包。

practice.text: This is the future, and it's here now.
practice.annotatedText: This is the <u>fu</u>ture, and it's <u>here</u> now.
practice.translation: 这就是未来，而且它已经到来。

extension.text: We don't have to save the planet alone — we can do it together.
extension.annotatedText: We don't have to <u>save</u> the planet <u>a</u>lone — we can do it to<u>geth</u>er.
extension.translation: 我们不需要独自拯救地球——我们可以一起做。

extension.text: Imagine if everyone in this room started one small habit.
extension.annotatedText: I<u>ma</u>gine if <u>ev</u>eryone in this room started one <u>small</u> habit.
extension.translation: 想象一下，如果这个房间里的每个人都开始一个小习惯。

extension.text: Maybe it's carrying a reusable bag or turning off the tap while brushing your teeth.
extension.annotatedText: Maybe it's <u>car</u>rying a re<u>us</u>able bag or <u>turn</u>ing off the tap while brushing your teeth.
extension.translation: 也许是带一个可重复使用的袋子，或者刷牙时关掉水龙头。

extension.text: These tiny acts might seem insignificant, but they're not.
extension.annotatedText: These <u>ti</u>ny acts might seem insig<u>ni</u>ficant, but <u>they're</u> not.
extension.translation: 这些微小的行为可能看起来微不足道，但它们不是。

extension.text: Because when you make a change, you inspire others to do the same.
extension.annotatedText: Be<u>cause</u> when you make a <u>change</u>, you in<u>spire</u> others to do the same.
extension.translation: 因为当你做出改变时，你会激励其他人也这样做。

extension.text: And that's how movements start — one person, one action, one moment at a time.
extension.annotatedText: And that's how <u>move</u>ments start — <u>one</u> person, <u>one</u> action, one <u>mo</u>ment at a time.
extension.translation: 这就是运动开始的方式——一个人，一个行动，一次一个时刻。

practice.text: Every ton of carbon we cut counts.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Ev</u>ery <u>ton</u> of <u>car</u>bon we cut <u>counts</u>.
practice.translation: 我们减少的每一吨碳都很重要。

practice.text: I've seen a village transform by simply planting trees.
practice.annotatedText: I've seen a <u>vil</u>lage trans<u>form</u> by <u>sim</u>ply <u>plant</u>ing trees.
practice.translation: 我见过一个村庄仅仅通过植树就发生了转变。

practice.text: Solar panels on a single school can power its lights and computers.
practice.annotatedText: <u>So</u>lar <u>pan</u>els on a <u>sin</u>gle school can <u>pow</u>er its lights and com<u>put</u>ers.
practice.translation: 一所学校屋顶上的太阳能板就能为其照明和电脑供电。

practice.text: Our oceans are choking on plastic, but we can stop the flow.
practice.annotatedText: Our <u>o</u>ceans are <u>chok</u>ing on <u>plas</u>tic, but we can <u>stop</u> the flow.
practice.translation: 我们的海洋正在被塑料窒息，但我们可以阻止这种流动。

practice.text: It's not about being perfect — it's about being better than yesterday.
practice.annotatedText: It's not a<u>bout</u> being per<u>fect</u> — it's about being <u>bet</u>ter than <u>yes</u>terday.
practice.translation: 这不是关于完美——而是关于比昨天更好。

practice.text: I challenge you to go one week without a single-use plastic item.
practice.annotatedText: I <u>chal</u>lenge you to go <u>one</u> week without a <u>sin</u>gle-use <u>plas</u>tic item.
practice.translation: 我挑战你一周不用一次性塑料制品。

practice.text: The future isn't something we wait for — we create it.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>fu</u>ture isn't something we <u>wait</u> for — we cre<u>ate</u> it.
practice.translation: 未来不是我们等待的东西——我们创造它。

practice.text: So let's roll up our sleeves and get to work.
practice.annotatedText: So let's <u>roll</u> up our <u>sleeves</u> and <u>get</u> to work.
practice.translation: 所以，让我们卷起袖子开始干吧。

extension.text: And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
extension.annotatedText: And most important, have the <u>courage</u> to follow your <u>heart</u> and intuition.
extension.translation: 最重要的是，要有勇气追随你的内心和直觉。

extension.text: They somehow already know what you truly want to become.
extension.annotatedText: They somehow <u>already</u> know what you <u>truly</u> want to become.
extension.translation: 它们其实已经知道你想成为什么样的人。

extension.text: Everything else is secondary.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Everything</u> else is <u>secondary</u>.
extension.translation: 其他一切都是次要的。

extension.text: I know I need to change something when the answer is 'no' for too many days in a row.
extension.annotatedText: I know I need to change something when the answer is <u>'no'</u> for too many days in a <u>row</u>.
extension.translation: 我知道当连续很多天答案都是“不”的时候，我就需要改变一些事情了。

extension.text: Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose.
extension.annotatedText: Remembering that you are going to <u>die</u> is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to <u>lose</u>.
extension.translation: 记住你终将死去，是我知道的避免患得患失的最好办法。

extension.text: You are already naked. There is no reason not to follow your heart.
extension.annotatedText: You are already <u>naked</u>. There is no reason not to follow your <u>heart</u>.
extension.translation: 你本来就一无所有，没理由不听从内心。

extension.text: So keep looking until you find it. Don't settle.
extension.annotatedText: So keep <u>looking</u> until you find it. Don't <u>settle</u>.
extension.translation: 所以继续寻找，直到找到为止。不要将就。

practice.text: Your time is limited, so don't waste it.
practice.annotatedText: Your time is <u>limited</u>, so don't <u>waste</u> it.
practice.translation: 你的时间有限，别浪费了。

practice.text: Don't let the noise drown out your own voice.
practice.annotatedText: Don't let the <u>noise</u> drown out your own <u>voice</u>.
practice.translation: 别让噪音淹没了你的声音。

practice.text: Trust that the dots will connect in your future.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Trust</u> that the dots will <u>connect</u> in your future.
practice.translation: 相信这些点会在未来连起来。

practice.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
practice.annotatedText: The only way to do <u>great</u> work is to <u>love</u> what you do.
practice.translation: 做伟大工作的唯一方法就是热爱你所做的。

practice.text: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Stay</u> hungry. <u>Stay</u> foolish.
practice.translation: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

practice.text: If today were the last day, would I want to do this?
practice.annotatedText: If today were the <u>last</u> day, would I want to do <u>this</u>?
practice.translation: 如果今天是最后一天，我还会想做这件事吗？

practice.text: Have the courage to follow your heart.
practice.annotatedText: Have the <u>courage</u> to follow your <u>heart</u>.

practice.text: Remembering you will die is the best way to avoid the trap.

practice.translation: 记住你会死是避免陷阱的最好办法。

extension.text: I have a dream that one day every valley shall be exalted.
extension.annotatedText: I have a <u>dream</u> that one day <u>every</u> valley shall be <u>exalted</u>.
extension.translation: 我有一个梦想，有一天每一个山谷都会被填平。

extension.text: And every hill and mountain shall be made low.
extension.annotatedText: And <u>every</u> hill and <u>mountain</u> shall be made <u>low</u>.
extension.translation: 每一座山丘和高山都会被夷为平地。

extension.text: The rough places will be made plain, and the crooked places will be made straight.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>rough</u> places will be made <u>plain</u>, and the <u>crooked</u> places will be made straight.
extension.translation: 崎岖之地将变得平坦，弯曲之地将变得笔直。

extension.text: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together.
extension.annotatedText: And the <u>glory</u> of the Lord shall be <u>revealed</u>, and all <u>flesh</u> shall see it together.
extension.translation: 主的荣耀将显现，全人类都将一同看见。

extension.text: This is our hope. This is the faith that I go back to the South with.
extension.annotatedText: <u>This</u> is our hope. <u>This</u> is the <u>faith</u> that I go back to the South with.
extension.translation: 这是我们的希望。这是我带着回到南方的信念。

extension.text: With this faith, we will be able to hew out of the mountain of despair a stone of hope.
extension.annotatedText: With this <u>faith</u>, we will be able to <u>hew</u> out of the mountain of <u>despair</u> a stone of hope.
extension.translation: 有了这个信念，我们就能从绝望之山中凿出一块希望之石。

extension.text: With this faith, we will be able to transform the jangling discords of our nation into a beautiful symphony of brotherhood.
extension.annotatedText: With this <u>faith</u>, we will be able to <u>transform</u> the <u>jangling</u> discords of our nation into a beautiful symphony of brotherhood.
extension.translation: 有了这个信念，我们就能把我们国家刺耳的不和谐音转化为一曲优美的兄弟情谊交响乐。

extension.text: With this faith, we will be able to work together, to pray together, to struggle together, to go to jail together, to stand up for freedom together, knowing that we will be free one day.
extension.annotatedText: With this <u>faith</u>, we will be able to <u>work</u> together, to <u>pray</u> together, to struggle together, to go to jail together, to stand up for freedom together, knowing that we will be <u>free</u> one day.
extension.translation: 有了这个信念，我们就能一起工作，一起祈祷，一起奋斗，一起坐牢，一起为自由挺身而出，因为我们知道总有一天我们会获得自由。

practice.text: I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up.

practice.translation: 我有一个梦想，有一天这个国家会站起来。

practice.text: Judged not by the color of their skin but by the content of their character.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Judged</u> not by the <u>color</u> of their skin but by the <u>content</u> of their character.
practice.translation: 评判他们不是看肤色，而是看品格的内涵。

practice.text: Let freedom ring from every hill and mountainside.

practice.translation: 让自由之声从每座山丘和山坡上响起。

practice.text: Free at last, free at last — thank God almighty, we are free at last.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Free</u> at last, <u>free</u> at last — thank God <u>almighty</u>, we are free at last.
practice.translation: 终于自由了，终于自由了——感谢全能的主，我们终于自由了。

practice.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every hill made low.
