practice.translation: 我的狗从昨天开始瘸了。

practice.text: He won't put weight on his back leg.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>won't</u> put weight on his <u>back</u> leg.
practice.translation: 他的后腿不敢着地。

practice.text: We'll take an X-ray to rule out anything serious.
practice.annotatedText: We'll take an <u>X-ray</u> to rule out <u>anything</u> serious.
practice.translation: 拍个X光排除严重问题。

practice.text: Keep him rested and avoid stairs.
practice.annotatedText: Keep him <u>rested</u> and <u>avoid</u> stairs.
practice.translation: 让他多休息，不要爬楼梯。

practice.text: It might be a sprain or something more serious.
practice.annotatedText: It might be a <u>sprain</u> or something <u>more</u> serious.
practice.translation: 可能是扭伤，也可能是更严重的问题。

practice.text: We'll call you with the results.
practice.annotatedText: We'll <u>call</u> you with the <u>results</u>.
practice.translation: 出结果了我们通知您。

practice.text: I'm a bit worried about my dog's leg.
practice.annotatedText: I'm a bit <u>worried</u> about my dog's <u>leg</u>.
practice.translation: 我有点担心我的狗的腿。

practice.text: You can have a seat in the waiting area.
practice.annotatedText: You can have a <u>seat</u> in the <u>waiting</u> area.
practice.translation: 您可以在等候区坐一会儿。

extension.text: Thanks. Could you tell me where gate B12 is?
extension.annotatedText: Thanks. Could you <u>tell</u> me where gate <u>B12</u> is?
extension.translation: 谢谢。请问B12登机口在哪里？

extension.text: Sure. Go straight and turn left after the duty-free shops. You'll see the signs.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Sure</u>. Go straight and turn <u>left</u> after the duty-free shops. You'll see the <u>signs</u>.
extension.translation: 好的。直走，过了免税店左转，你会看到指示牌。

extension.text: Got it. And is there a restroom nearby?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Got</u> it. And is there a <u>restroom</u> nearby?
extension.translation: 明白了。附近有洗手间吗？

extension.text: Yes, there's one right past security, just before the food court.
extension.annotatedText: Yes, there's one <u>right</u> past security, just before the <u>food court</u>.
extension.translation: 有的，过了安检就有一个，就在美食广场前面。

extension.text: Perfect. One more thing — is the flight on time?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Perfect</u>. One more thing — is the flight <u>on time</u>?
extension.translation: 太好了。还有一件事——航班准时吗？

extension.text: Let me check... Yes, it's scheduled to depart at 2pm sharp.
extension.annotatedText: Let me <u>check</u>... Yes, it's scheduled to depart at <u>2pm sharp</u>.
extension.translation: 我查一下……是的，计划下午2点整起飞。

extension.text: Great. Thanks for your help!
extension.annotatedText: <u>Great</u>. Thanks for your <u>help</u>!
extension.translation: 太好了。谢谢你的帮助！

extension.text: You're welcome. Have a nice flight!
extension.annotatedText: You're <u>welcome</u>. Have a <u>nice flight</u>!
extension.translation: 不客气。祝您旅途愉快！

practice.text: May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
practice.annotatedText: May I <u>see</u> your <u>passport</u> and booking reference, please?
practice.translation: 请出示您的护照和预订信息。

practice.text: I'm flying to London this afternoon.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>flying</u> to <u>London</u> this afternoon.
practice.translation: 我下午飞伦敦。

practice.text: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
practice.annotatedText: Would you like a <u>window</u> seat or an <u>aisle</u> seat?
practice.translation: 您要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？

practice.text: Do you have any luggage to check in?
practice.annotatedText: Do you have any <u>luggage</u> to <u>check in</u>?
practice.translation: 有托运行李吗？

practice.text: Just this one suitcase. It's within the weight limit, right?
practice.annotatedText: Just this one <u>suitcase</u>. It's within the <u>weight limit</u>, right?
practice.translation: 就这一个行李箱，没超重吧？

practice.text: Here's your boarding pass — gate B12, boarding at 2pm.
practice.annotatedText: Here's your <u>boarding pass</u> — gate <u>B12</u>, boarding at <u>2pm</u>.
practice.translation: 这是您的登机牌——B12登机口，下午2点登机。

practice.text: Go straight and turn left after the duty-free shops.
practice.annotatedText: Go <u>straight</u> and turn <u>left</u> after the duty-free shops.
practice.translation: 直走，过了免税店左转。

practice.text: Is the flight on time?
practice.annotatedText: Is the flight <u>on time</u>?
practice.translation: 航班准时吗？

extension.text: I'm really excited about the chance to work with your team on cutting-edge projects.
extension.annotatedText: I'm <u>really</u> excited about the <u>chance</u> to work with your team on cutting-edge projects.
extension.translation: 我真的很兴奋有机会和你们团队一起做前沿项目。

extension.text: That sounds great. We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running.
extension.annotatedText: That sounds <u>great</u>. We're looking for someone who can <u>hit</u> the ground running.
extension.translation: 听起来不错。我们想要一个能迅速上手的人。

extension.text: Absolutely. I've been preparing by taking online courses in machine learning.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Absolutely</u>. I've been preparing by taking online courses in <u>machine</u> learning.
extension.translation: 当然。我一直在上网课学机器学习来准备。

extension.text: Well, we'll be in touch soon. Thanks for your time.
extension.annotatedText: Well, we'll be in <u>touch</u> soon. <u>Thanks</u> for your time.
extension.translation: 好的，我们会尽快联系你。谢谢你的时间。

practice.text: I believe my background in data structures makes me a strong candidate.
practice.annotatedText: I believe my <u>back</u>ground in <u>data</u> structures makes me a strong <u>candi</u>date.
practice.translation: 我觉得我在数据结构方面的背景让我很有竞争力。

practice.text: Could you walk me through the typical career path for this role?
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>walk</u> me through the <u>typical</u> career path for this role?
practice.translation: 你能给我讲讲这个岗位的典型职业发展路径吗？

practice.text: I've used agile methodologies in my previous projects and enjoy collaborative environments.
practice.annotatedText: I've used <u>a</u>gile methodo<u>lo</u>gies in my previous projects and enjoy <u>col</u>laborative environments.
practice.translation: 我在之前的项目里用过敏捷方法，喜欢协作的环境。

practice.text: How does the company support professional development and learning?
practice.annotatedText: How does the <u>com</u>pany support <u>pro</u>fessional development and <u>learn</u>ing?
practice.translation: 公司怎么支持员工的职业发展和学习？

practice.text: I'm particularly proud of the recommendation algorithm I optimized for my last employer.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>par</u>ticularly proud of the <u>rec</u>ommendation <u>al</u>gorithm I optimized for my last employer.
practice.translation: 我特别自豪的是为上一家公司优化了一个推荐算法。

practice.text: Our team values creativity and initiative; do you have examples of that?
practice.annotatedText: Our team <u>val</u>ues <u>crea</u>tivity and initia<u>tive</u>; do you have examples of that?
practice.translation: 我们团队看重创造力和主动性；你有这方面的例子吗？

practice.text: Yes, I initiated a code review process that improved our deployment speed by 20%.
practice.annotatedText: Yes, I <u>ini</u>tiated a code <u>re</u>view process that improved our de<u>ploy</u>ment speed by twenty percent.
practice.translation: 有，我发起了代码审查流程，把部署速度提高了20%。

practice.text: We'll let you know our decision by the end of next week.
practice.annotatedText: We'll let you <u>know</u> our de<u>ci</u>sion by the end of <u>next</u> week.
practice.translation: 我们会在下周末前告诉你结果。

extension.text: Glad to hear that! Are you still living in the same area?
extension.annotatedText: Glad to <u>hear</u> that! Are you <u>still</u> living in the <u>same</u> area?
extension.translation: 听你这么说真高兴！你还住在同一个地方吗？

extension.text: Yeah, but I'm thinking of moving closer to work. The commute's killing me.
extension.annotatedText: Yeah, but I'm <u>thinking</u> of moving <u>closer</u> to work. The <u>com</u>mute's killing me.
extension.translation: 是啊，但我在想搬到离公司近点的地方。通勤快把我累死了。

extension.text: I hear you. My office is only ten minutes away, so I can't complain.
extension.annotatedText: I <u>hear</u> you. My <u>of</u>fice is only ten minutes away, so I can't com<u>plain</u>.
extension.translation: 我懂。我办公室才十分钟路程，所以没什么好抱怨的。

extension.text: Lucky you! Anyway, shall we order some wine to go with dinner?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Lucky</u> you! Anyway, shall we <u>or</u>der some wine to go with <u>din</u>ner?
extension.translation: 你真幸运！算了，我们点瓶酒配晚餐吧？

practice.text: This place is lovely — how did you find it?
practice.annotatedText: This place is <u>love</u>ly — how did you <u>find</u> it?
practice.translation: 这地方真不错——你怎么找到的？

practice.text: I'm definitely getting the carbonara. What about you?
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>def</u>initely getting the carbonara. <u>What</u> about you?
practice.translation: 我肯定要培根蛋面。你呢？

practice.text: I'm torn between the seafood risotto and the steak.
practice.annotatedText: I'm torn between the <u>sea</u>food risotto and the <u>steak</u>.
practice.translation: 我在海鲜烩饭和牛排之间犹豫。

practice.text: The risotto here is to die for — I'd go with that.
practice.annotatedText: The risotto here is to <u>die</u> for — I'd <u>go</u> with that.
practice.translation: 这里的烩饭好吃极了——选它没错。

practice.text: Honestly, it's been a steep learning curve but I'm really enjoying it.
practice.annotatedText: Honestly, it's been a <u>steep</u> learning curve but I'm <u>real</u>ly enjoying it.
practice.translation: 说实话，上手有挑战但真的很喜欢。

practice.text: Are you still living in the same area?
practice.annotatedText: Are you <u>still</u> living in the <u>same</u> area?
practice.translation: 你还住在同一个地方吗？

practice.text: I'm thinking of moving closer to work. The commute's killing me.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>think</u>ing of moving <u>closer</u> to work. The <u>com</u>mute's killing me.
practice.translation: 我在想搬到离公司近点的地方。通勤快把我累死了。

practice.text: Shall we order some wine to go with dinner?
practice.annotatedText: Shall we <u>or</u>der some wine to go with <u>din</u>ner?
practice.translation: 我们点瓶酒配晚餐吧？

extension.text: Alright, let me think about it. Can I take it to my mechanic for a quick inspection first?
extension.annotatedText: Alright, let me <u>think</u> about it. Can I <u>take</u> it to my <u>mechanic</u> for a quick inspection first?
extension.translation: 好吧，我考虑一下。我能先开去给我机修工看看吗？

extension.text: Sure, no problem. Just let me know when you want to do that.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Sure</u>, no problem. Just let me <u>know</u> when you want to do that.
extension.translation: 当然没问题。你想什么时候去就跟我说。

extension.text: Also, does it come with a warranty or any service records?
extension.annotatedText: Also, does it come with a <u>warranty</u> or any <u>service</u> records?
extension.translation: 还有，带保修或保养记录吗？

extension.text: It's sold as-is, but I have all the service records from the dealership.
extension.annotatedText: It's sold <u>as-is</u>, but I have <u>all</u> the service records from the dealership.
extension.translation: 按现状出售，但我有车行所有的保养记录。

extension.text: That sounds fair. How about we meet at my mechanic's shop tomorrow morning?
extension.annotatedText: That sounds <u>fair</u>. How about we <u>meet</u> at my mechanic's shop <u>tomorrow</u> morning?
extension.translation: 听起来挺合理。明天早上在我机修工的店里见怎么样？

extension.text: Sounds good. Text me the address and I'll be there at ten.
extension.annotatedText: Sounds <u>good</u>. Text me the <u>address</u> and I'll be there at <u>ten</u>.
extension.translation: 好的。把地址发给我，我十点到。

extension.text: Great, I'll send it over. And if everything checks out, we can talk price then.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Great</u>, I'll send it over. And if everything <u>checks out</u>, we can talk <u>price</u> then.
extension.translation: 太好了，我发给你。如果车况没问题，到时候再谈价格。

practice.text: I'm interested in the blue sedan you have for sale.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>interested</u> in the blue <u>sedan</u> you have for sale.
practice.translation: 我对你那辆蓝色轿车感兴趣。

practice.text: Would you like to come take it for a test drive?
practice.annotatedText: Would you like to come take it for a <u>test drive</u>?
practice.translation: 想过来试驾一下吗？

practice.text: How many miles does it have on it?
practice.annotatedText: How many <u>miles</u> does it have on it?
practice.translation: 跑了多少英里？

practice.text: It's got a clean history with one owner.
practice.annotatedText: It's got a <u>clean</u> history with <u>one</u> owner.
practice.translation: 无事故，一任车主。

practice.text: Is the price negotiable at all?
practice.annotatedText: Is the price <u>negotiable</u> at all?
practice.translation: 价钱还能商量吗？

practice.text: I can come down to twelve-five, but that's my bottom line.
practice.annotatedText: I can come down to <u>twelve-five</u>, but that's my <u>bottom line</u>.
practice.translation: 我能降到一万二千五，这是我的底价。

practice.text: Can I take it to my mechanic for an inspection?
practice.annotatedText: Can I <u>take</u> it to my <u>mechanic</u> for an inspection?
practice.translation: 我能开去给我机修工检查一下吗？

practice.text: It's sold as-is, but I have the service records.
practice.annotatedText: It's sold <u>as-is</u>, but I have the <u>service</u> records.
practice.translation: 按现状出售，但我有保养记录。

extension.text: Great, thanks. Do I need to fill out any forms?
extension.annotatedText: Great, thanks. Do I <u>need</u> to fill out any <u>forms</u>?
extension.translation: 好的，谢谢。我需要填什么表格吗？

extension.text: Yes, just this one with the sender and receiver info.
extension.annotatedText: Yes, just this <u>one</u> with the <u>sender</u> and <u>receiver</u> info.
extension.translation: 对，就这一张，写上寄件人和收件人的信息。

extension.text: Got it. And how long will express actually take to Shanghai?
extension.annotatedText: Got it. And how <u>long</u> will express actually <u>take</u> to Shanghai?
extension.translation: 明白了。加急到上海实际要多久？

extension.text: Typically 3 business days, sometimes 4 if there's a delay.
extension.annotatedText: Typically <u>3</u> business days, sometimes <u>4</u> if there's a <u>delay</u>.
extension.translation: 一般3个工作日，有时候延误的话4天。

extension.text: That works for me. Should I insure the package?
extension.annotatedText: That <u>works</u> for me. Should I <u>insure</u> the package?
extension.translation: 那行。我要给包裹上保险吗？

extension.text: If it's valuable, I'd recommend it. It's an extra $5 for up to $100 coverage.
extension.annotatedText: If it's <u>valuable</u>, I'd <u>recommend</u> it. It's an extra <u>$5</u> for up to $100 coverage.
extension.translation: 如果值钱的话，我建议保价。多加5美元保100美元。

extension.text: Alright, let's add insurance then. Here's my card.
extension.annotatedText: Alright, let's <u>add</u> insurance then. Here's my <u>card</u>.
extension.translation: 好吧，那加个保险。这是我的卡。

extension.text: Perfect. I'll process the payment now. Your total is $40.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Perfect</u>. I'll process the payment now. Your total is <u>$40</u>.
extension.translation: 太好了。我现在处理付款。一共40美元。

practice.text: I need to send this package to Shanghai.
practice.annotatedText: I <u>need</u> to <u>send</u> this <u>package</u> to Shanghai.
practice.translation: 我要寄这个包裹到上海。

practice.text: What are my shipping options?
practice.annotatedText: What are my <u>shipping</u> <u>options</u>?
practice.translation: 有什么寄送方式？

practice.text: Express takes 3 to 5 business days.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Express</u> takes <u>3</u> to <u>5</u> business days.
practice.translation: 加急需要3到5个工作日。

practice.text: Let me weigh it first.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>weigh</u> it <u>first</u>.
practice.translation: 我先称一下。

practice.text: Can I get a tracking number for this?
practice.annotatedText: Can I get a <u>tracking</u> <u>number</u> for this?
practice.translation: 这个有物流单号吗？

practice.text: Here's your receipt with the tracking number on top.
practice.annotatedText: Here's your <u>receipt</u> with the <u>tracking</u> number on <u>top</u>.
practice.translation: 这是收据，物流单号在顶部。

practice.text: Do I need to fill out any forms?
practice.annotatedText: Do I need to <u>fill</u> out <u>any</u> forms?
practice.translation: 我需要填表格吗？

practice.text: I'd recommend insurance if the package is valuable.
practice.annotatedText: I'd <u>recommend</u> insurance if the <u>package</u> is <u>valuable</u>.
practice.translation: 如果包裹值钱，我建议保价。

extension.text: Okay, I'll make sure to return them on time. Can I also check if you have any books on photography?
extension.annotatedText: Okay, I'll make <u>sure</u> to <u>re</u>turn them on <u>time</u>. Can I also check if you have any books on pho<u>tog</u>raphy?
extension.translation: 好的，我会记得按时还。能再查一下有没有摄影方面的书吗？

extension.text: Sure, let me look it up on our system. What kind of photography are you interested in?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Sure</u>, let me <u>look</u> it up on our system. What kind of pho<u>tog</u>raphy are you interested in?
extension.translation: 没问题，我在系统里查一下。你喜欢哪种摄影？

extension.text: Mostly landscape and nature photography. I'm a beginner, so something easy to follow.
extension.annotatedText: Mostly <u>land</u>scape and <u>na</u>ture photography. I'm a <u>begin</u>ner, so something <u>easy</u> to follow.
extension.translation: 主要是风景和自然摄影。我是新手，最好简单易懂的。

extension.text: We have a few titles in that section. Let me show you where they are.
extension.annotatedText: We have a <u>few</u> titles in that <u>sec</u>tion. Let me <u>show</u> you where they are.
extension.translation: 那个区域有几本相关书。我带你去看看。

extension.text: Thanks! Oh, and one more thing — do you have a photocopier I could use?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Thanks</u>! Oh, and <u>one</u> more thing — do you have a <u>pho</u>tocopier I could use?
extension.translation: 谢谢！对了，还有件事——这里可以复印吗？

extension.text: Yes, it's near the entrance. It costs 10 pence per black-and-white copy.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Yes</u>, it's near the <u>en</u>trance. It costs <u>ten</u> pence per black-and-white copy.
extension.translation: 有的，在入口附近。黑白复印每张10便士。

extension.text: Perfect, thanks for all your help. I think I'm all set now.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Per</u>fect, thanks for <u>all</u> your help. I think I'm <u>all</u> set now.
extension.translation: 太好了，多谢你帮忙。就这些了。

practice.text: I'd like to borrow these three books, please.
practice.annotatedText: I'd like to <u>bor</u>row these <u>three</u> books, please.
practice.translation: 我想借这三本书。

practice.text: Do you have your library card with you?
practice.annotatedText: Do you have your <u>li</u>brary card with you?
practice.translation: 带借书卡了吗？

practice.text: How long can I keep them for?
practice.annotatedText: How <u>long</u> can I <u>keep</u> them for?
practice.translation: 能借多久？

practice.text: You can renew them online if nobody else has reserved them.
practice.annotatedText: You can re<u>new</u> them on<u>line</u> if <u>no</u>body else has re<u>served</u> them.
practice.translation: 如果没人预约可以网上续借。

practice.text: Are there any late fees if I forget to bring them back?
practice.annotatedText: Are there any <u>late</u> fees if I for<u>get</u> to bring them back?
practice.translation: 过期了有罚款吗？

practice.text: Twenty pence per book per day.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Twen</u>ty pence per <u>book</u> per <u>day</u>.
practice.translation: 每本书每天20便士。

practice.text: We'll send you a reminder email first.
practice.annotatedText: We'll <u>send</u> you a re<u>mind</u>er e<u>mail</u> first.
practice.translation: 我们会先发提醒邮件。

practice.text: Let me look it up on our system.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>look</u> it up on our <u>sys</u>tem.
practice.translation: 我在系统里查一下。

extension.text: I'd like to think about it. Can I get the details in writing?
extension.annotatedText: I'd like to <u>think</u> about it. Can I get the <u>details</u> in writing?
extension.translation: 我想考虑一下。能把详细信息给我书面形式吗？

extension.text: Sure, here's a brochure. You can also check our app for more info.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, <u>here's</u> a brochure. You can also check our <u>app</u> for more info.
extension.translation: 当然，给您一本手册。您也可以在我们的应用上查看更多信息。

extension.text: What about the coverage? Is it good in rural areas?
extension.annotatedText: What about the <u>coverage</u>? Is it <u>good</u> in rural areas?
extension.translation: 信号覆盖怎么样？在农村地区信号好吗？

extension.text: We have excellent nationwide coverage, including most rural zones.
extension.annotatedText: We have <u>excellent</u> nationwide coverage, including <u>most</u> rural zones.
extension.translation: 我们全国信号覆盖非常好，包括大部分农村地区。

extension.text: Okay, that sounds good. And can I keep my current number?
extension.annotatedText: Okay, that <u>sounds</u> good. And can I <u>keep</u> my current number?
extension.translation: 好的，听起来不错。那我能保留现在的号码吗？

extension.text: Absolutely. We'll just transfer it over — no problem at all.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Absolutely</u>. We'll just <u>transfer</u> it over — no problem at all.
extension.translation: 当然可以。我们会直接转过来——完全没问题。

extension.text: Great. Let me check my schedule... I'll come back next week to sign up.
extension.annotatedText: Great. Let me check my <u>schedule</u>... I'll come back <u>next week</u> to sign up.
extension.translation: 太好了。让我看看我的日程……我下周再来办理。

practice.text: My contract is ending next month.
practice.annotatedText: My <u>contract</u> is ending next month.
practice.translation: 我的合约下个月到期。

practice.text: I'm looking for a better deal with more data.
practice.annotatedText: I'm looking for a <u>better</u> deal with <u>more</u> data.
practice.translation: 我在找流量更多的更划算的套餐。

practice.text: How much data do you typically use per month?
practice.annotatedText: How <u>much</u> data do you <u>typically</u> use per month?
practice.translation: 你每月通常用多少流量？

practice.text: Around twenty gigabytes — mostly for streaming and social media.
practice.annotatedText: Around <u>twenty</u> gigabytes — mostly for <u>streaming</u> and social media.
practice.translation: 大约20G——主要是看视频和刷社交媒体。

practice.text: Our unlimited data plan is forty-five dollars per month.
practice.annotatedText: Our <u>unlimited</u> data plan is <u>forty-five</u> dollars per month.
practice.translation: 我们的无限流量套餐是每月45美元。

practice.text: Does that include international calling?
practice.annotatedText: Does that <u>include</u> international calling?
practice.translation: 那包括国际通话吗？

practice.text: International calls are an extra five dollars per month.
practice.annotatedText: International calls are an <u>extra</u> <u>five</u> dollars per month.
practice.translation: 国际通话是额外每月5美元。

practice.text: Can I keep my current phone number?
practice.annotatedText: Can I <u>keep</u> my current phone <u>number</u>?
practice.translation: 我能保留现在的手机号码吗？

extension.text: Great, thanks. Could you also recommend a good restaurant nearby?
extension.annotatedText: Great, thanks. Could you <u>al</u>so recommend a <u>good</u> restaurant <u>near</u>by?
extension.translation: 好的，谢谢。你能推荐附近一家好的餐厅吗？

extension.text: Certainly. There's an Italian place just around the corner that's very popular.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Cer</u>tainly. There's an <u>Ita</u>lian place just around the <u>cor</u>ner that's very popular.
extension.translation: 当然。拐角处有一家意大利餐厅，很受欢迎。

extension.text: That sounds lovely. Do I need to book a table?
extension.annotatedText: That sounds <u>love</u>ly. Do I <u>need</u> to book a <u>ta</u>ble?
extension.translation: 听起来不错。我需要预订座位吗？

extension.text: It's best to book, especially on weekends. I can call them for you if you like.
extension.annotatedText: It's <u>best</u> to book, <u>es</u>pecially on weekends. I can <u>call</u> them for you if you like.
extension.translation: 最好预订，特别是周末。如果你愿意，我可以帮你打电话。

extension.text: That would be great, thanks. Could you book for 8pm tonight?
extension.annotatedText: That would be <u>great</u>, thanks. Could you <u>book</u> for 8pm to<u>night</u>?
extension.translation: 那太好了，谢谢。你能订今晚8点的吗？

extension.text: No problem. I'll do that now. Is there anything else I can help with?
extension.annotatedText: <u>No</u> problem. I'll do that <u>now</u>. Is there <u>an</u>ything else I can help with?
extension.translation: 没问题。我现在就订。还有其他需要帮忙的吗？

extension.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you very much.
extension.annotatedText: No, that's <u>all</u> for now. <u>Thank</u> you very much.
extension.translation: 没有了，就这些。非常感谢。

practice.text: I have a reservation under the name Chen.
practice.annotatedText: I have a reser<u>va</u>tion <u>un</u>der the name <u>Chen</u>.
practice.translation: 我用陈的名字预订了。

practice.text: Let me look that up in the system.
practice.annotatedText: Let me <u>look</u> that up in the <u>sys</u>tem.
practice.translation: 让我在系统里查一下。

practice.text: Is breakfast included in the rate?
practice.annotatedText: Is <u>break</u>fast in<u>clu</u>ded in the <u>rate</u>?
practice.translation: 房价含早餐吗？

practice.text: Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the ground floor dining room.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Break</u>fast is <u>served</u> from <u>seven</u> to ten in the ground floor dining room.
practice.translation: 早餐七点到十点在一楼餐厅供应。

practice.text: Checkout is at eleven, and here are your key cards.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Check</u>out is at e<u>le</u>ven, and here are your <u>key</u> cards.
practice.translation: 退房时间是十一点，这是您的房卡。

practice.text: Could you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>re</u>commend a <u>good</u> restaurant <u>near</u>by?
practice.translation: 你能推荐附近一家好的餐厅吗？

practice.text: Would you like me to book a table for you?
practice.annotatedText: Would you <u>like</u> me to <u>book</u> a table for <u>you</u>?
practice.translation: 需要我帮您订位吗？

practice.text: Please call me if you need any help with your stay.
practice.annotatedText: Please <u>call</u> me if you <u>need</u> any help with your <u>stay</u>.
practice.translation: 如果您入住期间需要任何帮助，请打电话给我。

extension.text: Okay, let's start the diagnostic. Could you leave it with me for a couple of hours?
extension.annotatedText: Okay, let's start the <u>diag</u>nostic. Could you leave it with me for a <u>cou</u>ple of hours?
extension.translation: 好的，我们开始诊断吧。你能把电脑留在我这里几个小时吗？

extension.text: Sure. Do you need my password or anything?
extension.annotatedText: Sure. Do you need my <u>pass</u>word or anything?
extension.translation: 当然。你需要我的密码什么的吗？

extension.text: Yeah, if you could type it in, that'd be great. We won't share it.
extension.annotatedText: Yeah, if you could type it in, that'd be <u>great</u>. We won't <u>share</u> it.
extension.translation: 是的，如果你能输进去的话就太好了。我们不会泄露的。

extension.text: Alright. And how much will this cost?
extension.annotatedText: Alright. And how much will this <u>cost</u>?
extension.translation: 好的。这个要多少钱？

extension.text: The diagnostic is free. If we need to replace the hard drive, it'll be about a hundred and fifty dollars for the part plus labor.
extension.annotatedText: The diagnostic is <u>free</u>. If we need to replace the hard drive, it'll be about a <u>hun</u>dred and <u>fif</u>ty dollars for the part plus labor.
extension.translation: 诊断是免费的。如果需要换硬盘，零件加人工大概一百五十美元。

extension.text: Okay. How long would the replacement take?
extension.annotatedText: Okay. How long would the <u>re</u>placement take?
extension.translation: 好的。换硬盘需要多久？

extension.text: Usually a day. We can get it done by tomorrow afternoon if we start now.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Us</u>ually a day. We can get it done by to<u>mor</u>row afternoon if we start now.
extension.translation: 通常一天。如果现在开始的话，明天下午之前能弄好。

extension.text: Great. Then I'll come back tomorrow. Thanks for your help.
extension.annotatedText: Great. Then I'll come back to<u>mor</u>row. Thanks for your <u>help</u>.
extension.translation: 太好了。那我明天再来。谢谢你的帮助。

practice.text: My laptop keeps freezing and the screen goes black randomly.
practice.annotatedText: My <u>lap</u>top keeps <u>freez</u>ing and the screen goes black <u>ran</u>domly.
practice.translation: 我的笔记本老是死机，屏幕会突然黑掉。

practice.text: How long has this been happening?
practice.annotatedText: How long has this been <u>hap</u>pening?
practice.translation: 出现这种情况多久了？

practice.text: Could be a failing hard drive. We'll run a diagnostic.
practice.annotatedText: Could be a <u>fail</u>ing hard drive. We'll run a <u>di</u>agnostic.
practice.translation: 可能是硬盘故障。我们会做个诊断。

practice.text: Will I lose any data if the hard drive needs replacing?
practice.annotatedText: Will I lose any <u>da</u>ta if the hard drive needs re<u>pla</u>cing?
practice.translation: 如果要换硬盘数据会丢吗？

practice.text: We'll do our best to back up your files first.
practice.annotatedText: We'll do our <u>best</u> to back up your <u>files</u> first.
practice.translation: 我们会尽量先备份你的文件。

practice.text: The diagnostic is free, but the replacement costs extra.
practice.annotatedText: The diagnostic is <u>free</u>, but the replacement costs <u>ex</u>tra.
practice.translation: 诊断是免费的，但换硬盘要额外收费。

practice.text: You can pick it up tomorrow afternoon.
practice.annotatedText: You can pick it up to<u>mor</u>row after<u>noon</u>.
practice.translation: 你明天下午就可以来取。

practice.text: Thanks for your help. I'll be back then.
practice.annotatedText: Thanks for your <u>help</u>. I'll be <u>back</u> then.
practice.translation: 谢谢你的帮助。我到时候再来。

extension.text: I've got a train to catch at 9:15. Think we'll make it?
extension.annotatedText: I've got a <u>train</u> to <u>catch</u> at 9:15. Think we'll <u>make</u> it?
extension.translation: 我要赶9点15的火车。你觉得赶得上吗？

extension.text: No worries, mate. We'll get you there in plenty of time.
extension.annotatedText: No <u>worries</u>, mate. We'll get you there in <u>plenty</u> of time.
extension.translation: 别担心，哥们儿。肯定能准时到。

extension.text: Do you take card or is it cash only?
extension.annotatedText: Do you take <u>card</u> or is it <u>cash</u> only?
extension.translation: 能刷卡还是只收现金？

extension.text: Card's fine. There's a machine right there by the gear stick.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Card's</u> fine. There's a machine right there by the <u>gear</u> stick.
extension.translation: 可以刷卡。挡杆旁边就有刷卡机。

extension.text: Brilliant. I always forget to carry cash these days.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Brilliant</u>. I always <u>forget</u> to carry cash these days.
extension.translation: 太好了。我这老忘带现金。

extension.text: Tell me about it. Everyone's going contactless now.
extension.annotatedText: Tell me about <u>it</u>. Everyone's going <u>contactless</u> now.
extension.translation: 可不是嘛。现在大家都用无接触支付。

extension.text: Do you mind if I open the window a crack? It's a bit stuffy back here.
extension.annotatedText: Do you <u>mind</u> if I open the window a <u>crack</u>? It's a bit <u>stuffy</u> back here.
extension.translation: 我能开点窗吗？后面有点闷。

extension.text: Go ahead. Sorry about that — the air con's been acting up.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Go</u> ahead. Sorry about that — the air con's been <u>acting</u> up.
extension.translation: 开吧。不好意思——空调最近有点毛病。

practice.text: Can you drop me right at the main entrance?
practice.annotatedText: Can you drop me <u>right</u> at the main <u>entrance</u>?
practice.translation: 能在正门口下吗？

practice.text: How long will it take at this time of day?
practice.annotatedText: How long will it <u>take</u> at this <u>time</u> of day?
practice.translation: 这个点大概多久？

practice.text: I've got a train to catch at 9:15. Think we'll make it?
practice.annotatedText: I've got a <u>train</u> to <u>catch</u> at 9:15. Think we'll <u>make</u> it?
practice.translation: 我要赶9点15的火车。你觉得赶得上吗？

practice.text: No worries, mate. We'll get you there in plenty of time.
practice.annotatedText: No <u>worries</u>, mate. We'll get you there in <u>plenty</u> of time.
practice.translation: 别担心，哥们儿。肯定能准时到。

practice.text: Do you take card or is it cash only?
practice.annotatedText: Do you take <u>card</u> or is it <u>cash</u> only?
practice.translation: 能刷卡还是只收现金？

practice.text: Do you mind if I open the window a crack? It's a bit stuffy back here.
practice.annotatedText: Do you <u>mind</u> if I open the window a <u>crack</u>? It's a bit <u>stuffy</u> back here.
practice.translation: 我能开点窗吗？后面有点闷。

practice.text: That'll be fifteen pounds fifty. Keep the change.
practice.annotatedText: That'll be <u>fifteen</u> pounds <u>fifty</u>. Keep the <u>change</u>.
practice.translation: 15.5英镑。不用找了。

practice.text: Card's fine. There's a machine right there by the gear stick.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Card's</u> fine. There's a machine right there by the <u>gear</u> stick.
practice.translation: 可以刷卡。挡杆旁边就有刷卡机。

extension.text: Thank you. Could you tell me if I need to provide any additional documents?
extension.annotatedText: Thank you. Could you <u>tell</u> me if I need to provide any <u>ad</u>ditional documents?
extension.translation: 谢谢。您能告诉我是否需要提供其他文件？

extension.text: Not at the moment. But please make sure your contact details are correct on the form.
extension.annotatedText: Not at the <u>mo</u>ment. But please make sure your <u>con</u>tact details are correct on the <u>form</u>.
extension.translation: 暂时不需要。不过请确保表格上的联系方式正确。

extension.text: Alright, I'll double-check everything before I leave.
extension.annotatedText: Alright, I'll <u>dou</u>ble-check everything before I <u>leave</u>.
extension.translation: 好的，我走之前再核对一遍。

extension.text: That's wise. Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
extension.annotatedText: That's <u>wise</u>. Is there anything else you'd like to <u>ask</u>?
extension.translation: 那很明智。还有什么想问的吗？

extension.text: No, that's all. Thank you for your help.
extension.annotatedText: No, that's <u>all</u>. Thank you for your <u>help</u>.
extension.translation: 没有了，谢谢您的帮助。

practice.text: I'm here for a two-week training program at the London School of Economics.
practice.annotatedText: I'm here for a <u>two-week training</u> program at the London School of <u>Eco</u>nomics.
practice.translation: 我来参加伦敦政经学院的两周培训项目。

practice.text: Do you have a letter of invitation from the institution?
practice.annotatedText: Do you have a <u>letter of invi</u>tation from the institution?
practice.translation: 你有机构的邀请函吗？

practice.text: Yes, here it is along with my enrollment confirmation.
practice.annotatedText: Yes, <u>here</u> it is along with my enrollment <u>confir</u>mation.
practice.translation: 有，这是邀请函和注册确认。

practice.text: How will you fund your stay during the two weeks?
practice.annotatedText: How will you <u>fund</u> your stay during the <u>two weeks</u>?
practice.translation: 这两周你怎么负担开销？

practice.text: I have sufficient savings and my company is covering the training fees.
practice.annotatedText: I have <u>suf</u>ficient savings and my company is <u>cov</u>ering the training fees.
practice.translation: 我有足够存款，公司也负担培训费。

practice.text: Here are my bank statements for the past three months.
practice.annotatedText: Here are my <u>bank state</u>ments for the past <u>three</u> months.
practice.translation: 这是我过去三个月的银行流水。

practice.text: Your application looks in order, you'll receive your visa within five working days.
practice.annotatedText: Your application looks in <u>or</u>der, you'll receive your visa within <u>five</u> working days.
practice.translation: 您的申请看起来没问题，五个工作日内会收到签证。

practice.text: Please make sure your contact details are correct on the form.
practice.annotatedText: Please make sure your <u>con</u>tact details are correct on the <u>form</u>.
practice.translation: 请确保表格上的联系方式正确。

extension.text: Okay, thanks. Do you have anything for my cough too?
extension.annotatedText: Okay, <u>thanks</u>. Do you have <u>any</u>thing for my <u>cough</u> too?
extension.translation: 好的，谢谢。有没有治咳嗽的药？

extension.text: Sure, we have a cough syrup that works well. It's right over here.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Sure</u>, we have a <u>cough</u> syrup that works well. It's right <u>over</u> here.
extension.translation: 有的，我们有款止咳糖浆效果不错。就在这边。

extension.text: Great. And can you tell me if this medicine makes you drowsy?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Great</u>. And can you tell me if this <u>medicine</u> makes you <u>drowsy</u>?
extension.translation: 太好了。请问这个药会让人犯困吗？

extension.text: No, it's non-drowsy, so you can take it during the day.
extension.annotatedText: No, it's <u>non-drowsy</u>, so you can <u>take</u> it during the <u>day</u>.
extension.translation: 不会，它不含助眠成分，白天也可以吃。

extension.text: Perfect. And do I need a prescription for any of these?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Perfect</u>. And do I need a <u>prescription</u> for any of <u>these</u>?
extension.translation: 太好了。这些需要处方吗？

extension.text: No, they're all over-the-counter. You can just buy them here.
extension.annotatedText: No, they're all <u>over-the-counter</u>. You can just <u>buy</u> them <u>here</u>.
extension.translation: 不用，都是非处方药。直接在这儿买就行。

extension.text: Alright, I'll take both. How much is that?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Alright</u>, I'll take <u>both</u>. How <u>much</u> is that?
extension.translation: 好的，我都要了。多少钱？

practice.text: I have a sore throat and a runny nose.
practice.annotatedText: I have a <u>sore</u> throat and a <u>runny</u> nose.
practice.translation: 我喉咙痛流鼻涕。

practice.text: Could you recommend something for my cough?
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>recommend</u> something for my <u>cough</u>?
practice.translation: 能推荐点治咳嗽的药吗？

practice.text: Take one tablet every six hours.
practice.annotatedText: Take <u>one</u> tablet <u>every</u> six hours.
practice.translation: 每六小时吃一片。

practice.text: Don't exceed four tablets in 24 hours.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>exceed</u> <u>four</u> tablets in 24 hours.
practice.translation: 24小时内不要超过四片。

practice.text: Is it safe to take on an empty stomach?
practice.annotatedText: Is it <u>safe</u> to take on an <u>empty</u> stomach?
practice.translation: 空腹吃安全吗？

practice.text: I'd recommend taking it with food.
practice.annotatedText: I'd <u>recommend</u> taking it with <u>food</u>.
practice.translation: 建议随餐服用。

practice.text: Does this medicine make you drowsy?
practice.annotatedText: Does this <u>medicine</u> make you <u>drowsy</u>?
practice.translation: 这个药会让人犯困吗？

practice.text: These are all over-the-counter medications.
practice.annotatedText: These are <u>all</u> <u>over-the-counter</u> medications.
practice.translation: 这些都是非处方药。

extension.text: Great, thanks. Also, the water pressure in the shower is really low. Could you check that too?
extension.annotatedText: Great, <u>thanks</u>. Also, the <u>water</u> pressure in the shower is really <u>low</u>. Could you check that too?
extension.translation: 好的，谢谢。还有淋浴的水压特别低。你能也看看吗？

extension.text: Sure, I'll make a note of it. Is there anything else?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Sure</u>, I'll make a note of it. Is there <u>any</u>thing else?
extension.translation: 行，我记下了。还有其他问题吗？

extension.text: No, that's all for now. Thanks for being so responsive.
extension.annotatedText: No, that's <u>all</u> for now. Thanks for being so <u>responsive</u>.
extension.translation: 没了，就这些。谢谢你反应这么快。

extension.text: Of course. I'll have the technician call you before he comes. Does that work?
extension.annotatedText: Of <u>course</u>. I'll have the technician <u>call</u> you before he comes. Does that <u>work</u>?
extension.translation: 应该的。我让维修工来之前先给你打个电话。这样可以吗？

extension.text: Perfect. I appreciate it. Talk to you later.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Perfect</u>. I <u>appreciate</u> it. Talk to you <u>later</u>.
extension.translation: 太好了。非常感谢。回头聊。
