practice.annotatedText: The <u>heating</u> in my apartment <u>isn't</u> working properly.
practice.translation: 我公寓的暖气坏了。

practice.text: When did you notice the problem?
practice.annotatedText: When did you <u>notice</u> the <u>prob</u>lem?
practice.translation: 你什么时候发现问题的？

practice.text: I tried adjusting the thermostat but nothing happened.
practice.annotatedText: I tried <u>adjusting</u> the <u>thermo</u>stat but <u>nothing</u> happened.
practice.translation: 我调了恒温器但没反应。

practice.text: I'll send a technician over this afternoon.
practice.annotatedText: I'll <u>send</u> a <u>techni</u>cian over this afternoon.
practice.translation: 我下午派个维修工过去。

practice.text: Is there an emergency number for after hours?
practice.annotatedText: Is there an <u>emer</u>gency <u>number</u> for after hours?
practice.translation: 有下班后的紧急联系电话吗？

practice.text: They usually respond within an hour.
practice.annotatedText: They <u>usual</u>ly <u>respond</u> within an hour.
practice.translation: 他们通常一小时内回复。

practice.text: The water pressure in the shower is really low.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>water</u> pressure in the <u>shower</u> is really <u>low</u>.
practice.translation: 淋浴的水压特别低。

practice.text: I'll have the technician call you before he comes.
practice.annotatedText: I'll have the <u>techni</u>cian <u>call</u> you before he comes.
practice.translation: 我让维修工来之前先给你打个电话。

extension.text: Can I have some cookies and milk?
extension.annotatedText: Can I have <u>some</u> <u>cookies</u> and milk?
extension.translation: 我能吃点饼干喝点牛奶吗？

extension.text: Sure, but just a few. We don't want to spoil your dinner.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, but <u>just</u> a few. We don't want to <u>spoil</u> your dinner.
extension.translation: 当然，但只能吃一点。我们不想影响你吃晚饭。

extension.text: Mom, guess what? Tommy brought his pet lizard to show-and-tell!
extension.annotatedText: Mom, guess <u>what</u>? Tommy brought his pet <u>lizard</u> to show-and-tell!
extension.translation: 妈妈，你猜怎么着？汤米把他的宠物蜥蜴带来展示了！

extension.text: Really? That sounds exciting! Did you get to hold it?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Really</u>? That sounds <u>exciting</u>! Did you get to hold it?
extension.translation: 真的吗？听起来好刺激！你抱它了吗？

extension.text: No, I was too scared. But it was cool to watch.
extension.annotatedText: No, I was <u>too</u> scared. But it was <u>cool</u> to watch.
extension.translation: 没有，我太害怕了。但是看着挺酷的。

extension.text: I understand. Maybe next time you'll be braver.
extension.annotatedText: I understand. Maybe next time <u>you'll</u> be <u>braver</u>.
extension.translation: 我理解。也许下次你会更勇敢一点。

extension.text: Okay, I'm ready for homework now. Can you help me with the dinosaur chapter?
extension.annotatedText: Okay, I'm <u>ready</u> for homework now. Can you help me with the <u>dinosaur</u> chapter?
extension.translation: 好了，我现在准备好做作业了。你能帮我读恐龙那一章吗？

extension.text: Of course! I love dinosaurs too. Let's see what you learned.
extension.annotatedText: Of course! I <u>love</u> dinosaurs too. Let's see what you <u>learned</u>.
extension.translation: 当然！我也喜欢恐龙。看看你学到了什么。

practice.text: How was school today?
practice.annotatedText: How was <u>school</u> <u>today</u>?
practice.translation: 今天在学校怎么样？

practice.text: Did you have any tests?
practice.annotatedText: Did you have <u>any</u> tests?
practice.translation: 有考试吗？

practice.text: What did you learn in math class?
practice.annotatedText: What did you <u>learn</u> in <u>math</u> class?
practice.translation: 数学课学了什么？

practice.text: Do you have a lot of homework tonight?
practice.annotatedText: Do you have a <u>lot</u> of homework <u>tonight</u>?
practice.translation: 今晚作业多吗？

practice.text: Let's finish your homework before dinner.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>finish</u> your homework before <u>dinner</u>.
practice.translation: 咱们在晚饭前把作业做完吧。

practice.text: Do you need any help with your reading assignment?
practice.annotatedText: Do you need <u>any</u> help with your <u>reading</u> assignment?
practice.translation: 阅读作业需要帮忙吗？

practice.text: I packed your favorite snack for after school.
practice.annotatedText: I <u>packed</u> your favorite <u>snack</u> for after school.
practice.translation: 我给你带了放学后最爱吃的零食。

practice.text: Don't forget to bring your permission slip tomorrow.
practice.annotatedText: Don't forget to bring your <u>permission</u> slip <u>tomorrow</u>.
practice.translation: 别忘了明天带上家长同意书。

extension.text: Great, I'll bring some snacks and water for us.
extension.annotatedText: Great, I'll <u>bring</u> some <u>snacks</u> and <u>water</u> for us.
extension.translation: 太好了，我会带些零食和水。

extension.text: Perfect. I've got a cooler we can use to keep things cold.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Perfect</u>. I've got a <u>cooler</u> we can use to keep things cold.
extension.translation: 完美。我有个冷藏箱，可以保持食物凉爽。

extension.text: Also, don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — the trail might be a bit rocky.
extension.annotatedText: Also, <u>don't</u> forget to wear <u>comfortable</u> shoes — the trail might be a bit <u>rocky</u>.
extension.translation: 还有，别忘了穿舒服的鞋子——山路可能有点崎岖。

extension.text: Good point. I'll wear my hiking boots. Should I bring a rain jacket just in case?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Good</u> point. I'll wear my <u>hiking</u> boots. Should I bring a <u>rain</u> jacket just in case?
extension.translation: 好主意。我会穿我的登山靴。我要不要带件雨衣以防万一？

extension.text: Probably not necessary, but better safe than sorry. I'll throw one in the car.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Probably</u> not necessary, but <u>better safe than sorry</u>. I'll throw one in the car.
extension.translation: 可能没必要，但有备无患。我会扔一件在车上。

extension.text: True. Oh, and I know a great spot for lunch after the hike — their burgers are amazing.
extension.annotatedText: <u>True</u>. Oh, and I know a <u>great</u> spot for lunch after the hike — their <u>burgers</u> are amazing.
extension.translation: 确实。哦，我知道爬山后有个吃午餐的好地方——他们的汉堡超好吃。

extension.text: You had me at burgers! Can't wait for Saturday.
extension.annotatedText: You <u>had</u> me at <u>burgers</u>! Can't <u>wait</u> for Saturday.
extension.translation: 你说汉堡我就心动了！等不及周六了。

extension.text: Alright, I'll pick you up at 6:45 then. See you!
extension.annotatedText: Alright, I'll <u>pick</u> you up at <u>6:45</u> then. <u>See</u> you!
extension.translation: 好，那我6点45接你。回头见！

practice.text: Any plans for the weekend?
practice.annotatedText: <u>Any</u> plans for the <u>weekend</u>?
practice.translation: 周末有什么计划吗？

practice.text: Thinking about going hiking if the weather holds up.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Thinking</u> about going <u>hiking</u> if the weather <u>holds up</u>.
practice.translation: 天气好的话想去爬山。

practice.text: Want to join?
practice.annotatedText: Want to <u>join</u>?
practice.translation: 一起吗？

practice.text: Where were you thinking of going?
practice.annotatedText: Where were you <u>thinking</u> of <u>going</u>?
practice.translation: 打算去哪？

practice.text: There's a trail up north about an hour's drive.
practice.annotatedText: There's a <u>trail</u> up <u>north</u> about an <u>hour's drive</u>.
practice.translation: 北边有一条步道，开车大概一小时。

practice.text: Let's aim for 7am to beat the crowds.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>aim</u> for <u>7am</u> to <u>beat</u> the crowds.
practice.translation: 争取7点出发避开人群。

practice.text: I'll bring some snacks and water.
practice.annotatedText: I'll <u>bring</u> some <u>snacks</u> and <u>water</u>.
practice.translation: 我会带些零食和水。

practice.text: Don't forget to wear comfortable shoes.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Don't</u> forget to wear <u>comfortable</u> shoes.
practice.translation: 别忘了穿舒服的鞋子。

extension.text: Absolutely. I'm glad I came out today.
extension.annotatedText: Absolutely. I'm <u>glad</u> I came out today.
extension.translation: 没错。我今天来对了。

extension.text: Me too. Hey, could you grab that plastic bottle over there?
extension.annotatedText: Me too. Hey, could you <u>grab</u> that plastic bottle over there?
extension.translation: 我也是。嘿，你能把那边那个塑料瓶捡起来吗？

extension.text: Sure. Wow, there's a lot of trash here.
extension.annotatedText: Sure. <u>Wow</u>, there's a lot of trash here.
extension.translation: 好的。哇，这里垃圾好多。

extension.text: Yeah, but we're making a real difference.
extension.annotatedText: Yeah, but we're making a <u>real</u> difference.
extension.translation: 是啊，但我们正在真正改变现状。

extension.text: I've never done this before. It's harder than it looks!
extension.annotatedText: I've <u>never</u> done this before. It's <u>harder</u> than it looks!
extension.translation: 我以前从来没做过。比看起来要累！

extension.text: You get used to it. Just pace yourself.
extension.annotatedText: You get <u>used</u> to it. Just <u>pace</u> yourself.
extension.translation: 慢慢就习惯了。悠着点来。

extension.text: Will we do this again next month?
extension.annotatedText: Will we do this <u>a</u>gain next month?
extension.translation: 我们下个月还会再来吗？

extension.text: I hope so. The more volunteers, the better.
extension.annotatedText: I <u>hope</u> so. The <u>more</u> volunteers, the better.
extension.translation: 希望如此。志愿者越多越好。

practice.text: I'm here for the community cleanup event.
practice.annotatedText: I'm here for the <u>com</u>munity <u>clean</u>up event.
practice.translation: 我是来参加社区清扫活动的。

practice.text: Don't forget to wear your gloves when picking up trash.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>for</u>get to wear your <u>gloves</u> when picking up trash.
practice.translation: 捡垃圾的时候别忘了戴手套。

practice.text: We're sorting recyclables from general waste.
practice.annotatedText: We're <u>sort</u>ing recyclables from <u>gen</u>eral waste.
practice.translation: 我们正在把可回收物和普通垃圾分类。

practice.text: Could you pass me another trash bag? This one's full.
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>pass</u> me another trash bag? This one's <u>full</u>.
practice.translation: 能再递我一个垃圾袋吗？这个满了。

practice.text: The riverbank looks so much cleaner already.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>riv</u>erbank looks so much <u>clean</u>er already.
practice.translation: 河岸看起来已经干净多了。

practice.text: Let's take a quick water break over there.
practice.annotatedText: Let's take a <u>quick</u> water break over there.
practice.translation: 我们去那边喝口水休息一下吧。

practice.text: I'm really proud of what we've accomplished today.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>real</u>ly proud of what we've <u>ac</u>complished today.
practice.translation: 我为我们今天所做的事情感到非常自豪。

practice.text: Sign me up for next month's volunteer day.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Sign</u> me up for next month's <u>vol</u>unteer day.
practice.translation: 下个月的志愿者日给我报名。

extension.text: Can you help me pack boxes this weekend? I've got tons of stuff to organize.
extension.annotatedText: Can you <u>help</u> me pack <u>boxes</u> this weekend? I've got <u>tons</u> of stuff to organize.
extension.translation: 这周末能帮我打包箱子吗？我有一大堆东西要整理。

extension.text: Sure, I can come by Saturday morning. Do you have enough boxes?
extension.annotatedText: Sure, I can come by <u>Saturday</u> morning. Do you have <u>enough</u> boxes?
extension.translation: 当然，周六上午我可以过来。你箱子够吗？

extension.text: I think so, but I might need a few more for the kitchen stuff.
extension.annotatedText: I <u>think</u> so, but I might need a <u>few more</u> for the kitchen stuff.
extension.translation: 我觉得够，但厨房用品可能还需要几个。

extension.text: No problem, I can grab some from the grocery store. They give them away for free.
extension.annotatedText: No problem, I can <u>grab</u> some from the grocery store. They give them away for <u>free</u>.
extension.translation: 没问题，我去杂货店拿一些。他们免费送。

extension.text: Awesome, thanks! Also, do you know any good moving companies?
extension.annotatedText: <u>Awesome</u>, thanks! Also, do you know any <u>good</u> moving companies?
extension.translation: 太棒了，谢谢！还有，你知道有什么好的搬家公司吗？

extension.text: I used one last year — they were pretty reliable. I can send you their number.
extension.annotatedText: I <u>used</u> one last year — they were pretty <u>reliable</u>. I can send you their number.
extension.translation: 我去年用过一家——挺靠谱的。我可以把号码发给你。

extension.text: That'd be great. I'll text you my new address once I'm settled.
extension.annotatedText: That'd be <u>great</u>. I'll <u>text</u> you my new address once I'm settled.
extension.translation: 那太好了。等我安顿好了就把新地址发给你。

practice.text: Moving day is coming up fast; I need to start packing tonight.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Moving</u> day is coming up <u>fast</u>; I need to start packing tonight.
practice.translation: 搬家日快到了，我今晚就得开始打包。

practice.text: Did you remember to label all the boxes with their contents?
practice.annotatedText: Did you remember to <u>label</u> all the boxes with their <u>contents</u>?
practice.translation: 你记得给所有箱子贴上标签写明里面是什么吗？

practice.text: I'll rent a dolly to make moving the heavy furniture easier.
practice.annotatedText: I'll <u>rent</u> a dolly to make moving the <u>heavy</u> furniture easier.
practice.translation: 我要租个小推车，搬重家具会轻松些。

practice.text: Don't forget to transfer your utilities before you move out.
practice.annotatedText: Don't forget to <u>transfer</u> your utilities <u>before</u> you move out.
practice.translation: 别忘了搬走前把水电煤气过户。

practice.text: The elevator in the new building is tiny; we might have to take the stairs for big items.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>elevator</u> in the new building is <u>tiny</u>; we might have to take the <u>stairs</u> for big items.
practice.translation: 新楼电梯很小，大件可能得走楼梯。

practice.text: Could you help me carry this sofa down three flights of stairs?
practice.annotatedText: Could you <u>help</u> me carry this <u>sofa</u> down three flights of stairs?
practice.translation: 你能帮我把这张沙发扛下三层楼吗？

practice.text: I'm planning to unpack the kitchen first because I need to cook dinner.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>planning</u> to unpack the <u>kitchen</u> first because I need to cook dinner.
practice.translation: 我打算先拆厨房的包，因为要做晚饭。

practice.text: After the move, let's have a housewarming party to break in the new place.
practice.annotatedText: After the <u>move</u>, let's have a housewarming <u>party</u> to break in the new place.
practice.translation: 搬完家后，咱们办个暖房派对吧，让新家热闹起来。

extension.text: Sure, let me show you a good hamstring stretch. Sit on the floor and extend one leg.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, let me <u>show</u> you a good <u>hamstring</u> stretch. Sit on the floor and extend one <u>leg</u>.
extension.translation: 当然，我给你示范一个很好的腿筋拉伸。坐在地板上，伸出一条腿。

extension.text: Like this? Okay, I feel the pull. How long should I stay here?
extension.annotatedText: Like this? <u>Okay</u>, I feel the <u>pull</u>. How <u>long</u> should I stay here?
extension.translation: 像这样吗？好的，我感觉到拉伸了。我应该保持多久？

extension.text: Hold for at least thirty seconds, then switch legs. Remember to breathe deeply.
extension.annotatedText: Hold for at least <u>thirty</u> seconds, then <u>switch</u> legs. Remember to breathe <u>deeply</u>.
extension.translation: 保持至少30秒，然后换腿。记得深呼吸。

extension.text: Got it. I also feel some tightness in my shoulders. Any stretches for that?
extension.annotatedText: Got it. I also feel some <u>tightness</u> in my <u>shoulders</u>. Any stretches for <u>that</u>?
extension.translation: 明白了。我肩膀也有点紧。有什么拉伸肩膀的动作吗？

extension.text: Sure, roll your shoulders back and down, then clasp your hands behind your back.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, <u>roll</u> your shoulders back and <u>down</u>, then <u>clasp</u> your hands behind your back.
extension.translation: 当然，把肩膀向后向下转动，然后双手在背后交握。

extension.text: Like this? That feels really good. I should do this more often.
extension.annotatedText: Like this? That feels <u>really</u> good. I should do this more <u>often</u>.
extension.translation: 像这样吗？感觉真不错。我应该多拉伸。

extension.text: Absolutely. Stretching after exercise helps prevent injuries and improves flexibility.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Absolutely</u>. Stretching after exercise helps prevent <u>injuries</u> and improves <u>flexibility</u>.
extension.translation: 绝对是的。运动后拉伸有助于防止受伤，还能提高柔韧性。

extension.text: Thanks for the tips. I'll make sure to stretch every time from now on.
extension.annotatedText: Thanks for the <u>tips</u>. I'll make sure to stretch <u>every</u> time from now <u>on</u>.
extension.translation: 谢谢你的建议。从现在开始我每次都会拉伸。

practice.text: Don't bounce when you stretch, just hold steady.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>bounce</u> when you stretch, just hold <u>steady</u>.
practice.translation: 拉伸时不要弹动，保持稳定。

practice.text: Hold each stretch for at least thirty seconds.
practice.annotatedText: Hold each stretch for at least <u>thirty</u> <u>seconds</u>.
practice.translation: 每个拉伸动作至少保持30秒。

practice.text: Breathe slowly and deeply while you stretch.
practice.annotatedText: Breathe <u>slowly</u> and <u>deeply</u> while you stretch.
practice.translation: 拉伸时缓慢深呼吸。

practice.text: Feel the stretch in your hamstrings, not your back.
practice.annotatedText: Feel the stretch in your <u>hamstrings</u>, not your <u>back</u>.
practice.translation: 感受腿筋的拉伸，而不是背部。

practice.text: Keep your legs straight when you touch your toes.
practice.annotatedText: Keep your <u>legs</u> straight when you touch your <u>toes</u>.
practice.translation: 触碰脚尖时保持双腿伸直。

practice.text: Roll your shoulders back and down to release tension.
practice.annotatedText: Roll your <u>shoulders</u> back and <u>down</u> to release <u>tension</u>.
practice.translation: 向后向下转动肩膀来释放紧张。

practice.text: Clasp your hands behind your back to open up your chest.
practice.annotatedText: Clasp your <u>hands</u> behind your back to <u>open</u> up your chest.
practice.translation: 双手在背后交握以打开胸腔。

practice.text: Stretching after exercise helps prevent injuries and improves flexibility.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Stretching</u> after exercise helps prevent <u>injuries</u> and improves <u>flexibility</u>.
practice.translation: 运动后拉伸有助于防止受伤并提高柔韧性。

extension.text: We can't just stand by and watch this happen.
extension.annotatedText: We <u>can't</u> just <u>stand by</u> and watch this happen.
extension.translation: 我们不能袖手旁观，眼睁睁看着这一切发生。

extension.text: Simple changes in our daily habits can make a huge difference.
extension.annotatedText: Simple changes in our <u>daily</u> habits can make a <u>huge</u> difference.
extension.translation: 日常习惯的小改变就能带来巨大的影响。

extension.text: From refusing single-use plastics to supporting ocean-friendly policies, every action counts.
extension.annotatedText: From <u>refusing</u> single-use plastics to supporting <u>ocean-friendly</u> policies, every <u>action</u> counts.
extension.translation: 从拒绝一次性塑料到支持保护海洋的政策，每一个行动都很重要。

extension.text: Companies must also take responsibility for their packaging and production methods.
extension.annotatedText: Companies must also take <u>responsibility</u> for their packaging and <u>production</u> methods.
extension.translation: 企业也必须对其包装和生产方式负责。

extension.text: Imagine a world where our beaches are clean and marine life thrives.
extension.annotatedText: Imagine a world where our beaches are <u>clean</u> and marine life <u>thrives</u>.
extension.translation: 想象一下一个海滩干净、海洋生物繁盛的世界。

extension.text: That future is possible if we start today.
extension.annotatedText: That <u>future</u> is possible if we <u>start today</u>.
extension.translation: 那个未来是可能的，只要我们今天就行动起来。

extension.text: Let's not leave this problem for the next generation to solve.
extension.annotatedText: Let's <u>not</u> leave this problem for the <u>next generation</u> to solve.
extension.translation: 我们不要把这个问题留给下一代去解决。

practice.text: Plastic pollution is choking our oceans.
practice.annotatedText: Plastic <u>pollution</u> is <u>choking</u> our oceans.
practice.translation: 塑料污染正在扼杀我们的海洋。

practice.text: We need to reduce our reliance on disposable items.
practice.annotatedText: We need to <u>reduce</u> our reliance on <u>disposable</u> items.
practice.translation: 我们需要减少对一次性物品的依赖。

practice.text: Recycling alone won't solve this crisis.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Recycling</u> alone won't <u>solve</u> this crisis.
practice.translation: 仅靠回收解决不了这场危机。

practice.text: Government regulations are crucial to curb plastic production.
practice.annotatedText: Government <u>regulations</u> are crucial to <u>curb</u> plastic production.
practice.translation: 政府监管对于遏制塑料生产至关重要。

practice.text: Each of us can be part of the solution.
practice.annotatedText: Each of us can be <u>part</u> of the <u>solution</u>.
practice.translation: 我们每个人都可以成为解决方案的一部分。

practice.text: Let's choose reusable bottles over plastic ones.
practice.annotatedText: Let's choose <u>reusable</u> bottles over <u>plastic</u> ones.
practice.translation: 让我们选择可重复使用的瓶子而不是塑料瓶。

practice.text: The ocean provides over half of the world's oxygen.
practice.annotatedText: The ocean provides over <u>half</u> of the world's <u>oxygen</u>.
practice.translation: 海洋提供了世界上超过一半的氧气。

practice.text: Protecting the ocean means protecting ourselves.
practice.annotatedText: Protecting the <u>ocean</u> means protecting <u>ourselves</u>.
practice.translation: 保护海洋就是保护我们自己。

extension.text: It's about taking that first step, even when the path is unclear.
extension.annotatedText: It's about <u>taking</u> that <u>first</u> step, even when the path is <u>unclear</u>.
extension.translation: 这关乎迈出第一步，即使前路不明。

extension.text: You gotta be comfortable being uncomfortable; that's where growth happens.
extension.annotatedText: You <u>gotta</u> be comfortable being <u>uncomfortable</u>; that's where <u>growth</u> happens.
extension.translation: 你得习惯不舒服，那才是成长发生的地方。

extension.text: Surround yourself with people who challenge you, not just people who agree with you.
extension.annotatedText: Surround yourself with people who <u>challenge</u> you, not just people who <u>agree</u> with you.
extension.translation: 和那些挑战你的人在一起，而不仅仅是那些赞同你的人。

extension.text: Speed is your friend. The faster you iterate, the faster you learn.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Speed</u> is your friend. The <u>faster</u> you iterate, the <u>faster</u> you learn.
extension.translation: 速度是你的朋友。迭代越快，学得越快。

extension.text: Don't wait for permission. Just build it and see what happens.
extension.annotatedText: Don't wait for <u>permission</u>. Just <u>build</u> it and see what <u>happens</u>.
extension.translation: 别等许可。直接做出来看看会发生什么。

extension.text: The biggest risk is not taking any risk. In a world that's changing fast, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>biggest</u> risk is not taking any <u>risk</u>. In a world that's changing <u>fast</u>, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.
extension.translation: 最大的风险就是不冒任何风险。在快速变化的世界里，唯一注定失败的战略就是不冒险。

extension.text: So go ahead, disrupt yourself before someone else does.
extension.annotatedText: So go <u>ahead</u>, <u>disrupt</u> yourself before someone else <u>does</u>.
extension.translation: 所以，大胆去做，在别人颠覆你之前先颠覆自己。

practice.text: Innovation thrives on constructive conflict.
practice.annotatedText: Innovation <u>thrives</u> on <u>constructive</u> conflict.
practice.translation: 创新在建设性冲突中蓬勃发展。

practice.text: Your biggest competitor is your own inertia.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>biggest</u> competitor is your own <u>inertia</u>.
practice.translation: 你最大的竞争对手是自己的惰性。

practice.text: Don't polish your prototype; test it with real users.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>polish</u> your prototype; <u>test</u> it with real users.
practice.translation: 别打磨原型；用真实用户测试它。

practice.text: A great idea without execution is just a hallucination.
practice.annotatedText: A great idea without <u>execution</u> is just a <u>hallucination</u>.
practice.translation: 没有执行的好想法只是幻觉。

practice.text: The best founders are obsessed with problems, not solutions.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>best</u> founders are <u>obsessed</u> with problems, not solutions.
practice.translation: 最好的创始人对问题着迷，而不是解决方案。

practice.text: Customer feedback is a gift. Use it to pivot or persevere.
practice.annotatedText: Customer <u>feedback</u> is a <u>gift</u>. Use it to <u>pivot</u> or persevere.
practice.translation: 客户反馈是礼物。用它来调整方向或坚持。

practice.text: Don't just build what people say they want; build what they can't live without.
practice.annotatedText: Don't just build what people say they <u>want</u>; build what they can't live <u>without</u>.
practice.translation: 不要只做人们说想要的东西；做他们离不开的东西。

practice.text: The most successful innovations often feel inevitable in hindsight.
practice.annotatedText: The most <u>successful</u> innovations often feel <u>inevitable</u> in hindsight.
practice.translation: 最成功的创新事后看来往往觉得是必然的。

extension.text: We owe our success to the <u>cur</u>iosity that drives us to ask 'why' and 'what if'.
extension.annotatedText: We owe our success to the <u>cur</u>iosity that drives us to ask 'why' and 'what if'.
extension.translation: 我们的成功归功于好奇心，它驱使我们问'为什么'和'如果呢'。

extension.text: But let's be honest — the path wasn't al<u>ways</u> clear.
extension.annotatedText: But let's be honest — the path wasn't al<u>ways</u> clear.
extension.translation: 但说实话，这条路并不总是清晰的。

extension.text: There were <u>count</u>less failures, experiments that didn't work, and data that made no sense.
extension.annotatedText: There were <u>count</u>less failures, experiments that didn't work, and data that made no sense.
extension.translation: 有无数次的失败，行不通的实验，以及毫无意义的数据。

extension.text: Yet, each setback taught us more than any suc<u>cess</u> could.
extension.annotatedText: Yet, each setback taught us more than any suc<u>cess</u> could.
extension.translation: 然而，每一次挫折教会我们的比任何成功都多。

extension.text: I re<u>mem</u>ber late nights in the lab, staring at a screen, waiting for a result that never came.
extension.annotatedText: I re<u>mem</u>ber late nights in the lab, staring at a screen, waiting for a result that never came.
extension.translation: 我记得实验室里的深夜，盯着屏幕，等待一个永远不会出现的结果。

extension.text: But then, a <u>break</u>through — small at first, but it sparked a chain reaction of ideas.
extension.annotatedText: But then, a <u>break</u>through — small at first, but it sparked a chain reaction of ideas.
extension.translation: 但后来有了突破——起初很小，但它引发了一系列想法的连锁反应。

extension.text: That's the <u>beau</u>ty of science: the moment when confusion turns into clarity.
extension.annotatedText: That's the <u>beau</u>ty of science: the moment when confusion turns into clarity.
extension.translation: 这就是科学的美妙之处：从困惑到清晰的瞬间。

extension.text: Let's continue to push <u>bound</u>aries, not just for ourselves, but for the next generation.
extension.annotatedText: Let's continue to push <u>bound</u>aries, not just for ourselves, but for the next generation.
extension.translation: 让我们继续突破界限，不仅为了我们自己，也为了下一代。

practice.text: The Nobel Prize is not a solo achievement.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>No</u>bel Prize is not a <u>so</u>lo achievement.
practice.translation: 诺贝尔奖不是一个人的成就。

practice.text: I share this honor with every researcher who worked alongside me.
practice.annotatedText: I share this <u>ho</u>nor with <u>eve</u>ry researcher who worked alongside me.
practice.translation: 我与每一位与我并肩工作的研究人员分享这份荣誉。

practice.text: Our discovery was the result of years of patience and perseverance.
practice.annotatedText: Our dis<u>co</u>very was the result of years of <u>pa</u>tience and <u>per</u>severance.
practice.translation: 我们的发现是多年耐心和坚持不懈的结果。

practice.text: We faced skepticism, but we believed in the data.
practice.annotatedText: We faced <u>skep</u>ticism, but we <u>be</u>lieved in the data.
practice.translation: 我们面临怀疑，但我们相信数据。

practice.text: Funding and support are crucial for basic research.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Fun</u>ding and sup<u>port</u> are <u>cru</u>cial for basic research.
practice.translation: 资金和支持对基础研究至关重要。

practice.text: I urge governments to invest in science education.
practice.annotatedText: I <u>urge</u> govern<u>ments</u> to invest in science education.
practice.translation: 我敦促各国政府投资于科学教育。

practice.text: Curiosity-driven research often leads to unexpected breakthroughs.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Cu</u>riosity-driven re<u>search</u> often leads to unexpected <u>break</u>throughs.
practice.translation: 好奇心驱动的研究常常带来意想不到的突破。

practice.text: Let us never stop asking questions.
practice.annotatedText: Let us <u>ne</u>ver stop <u>as</u>king questions.
practice.translation: 让我们永远不要停止提问。

extension.text: I still remember the day I got the call. I was sitting in my kitchen, and I just cried.
extension.annotatedText: I still remember the day I got the <u>call</u>. I was sitting in my <u>kitchen</u>, and I just <u>cried</u>.
extension.translation: 我还记得接到电话那天。我坐在厨房里，就哭了。

extension.text: My heart was pounding so hard I thought it would jump out of my chest.
extension.annotatedText: My heart was <u>pounding</u> so hard I thought it would jump out of my <u>chest</u>.
extension.translation: 我的心跳得那么厉害，我觉得都要跳出胸口了。

extension.text: This film taught me that storytelling can heal. It can bring people together.
extension.annotatedText: This film taught me that <u>storytelling</u> can <u>heal</u>. It can bring people <u>together</u>.
extension.translation: 这部电影让我明白，讲故事可以治愈人心，可以把人们凝聚在一起。

extension.text: I want to thank my incredible cast and crew. You guys are my family now.
extension.annotatedText: I want to thank my <u>incredible</u> cast and <u>crew</u>. You guys are my <u>family</u> now.
extension.translation: 我要感谢我出色的剧组成员。你们现在就是我的家人。

extension.text: And to my agent, who never stopped fighting for me — I owe you more than I can say.
extension.annotatedText: And to my <u>agent</u>, who never stopped <u>fighting</u> for me — I owe you more than I can <u>say</u>.
extension.translation: 还有我的经纪人，你一直在为我争取——我欠你的太多了。

extension.text: I look at this statuette and I think about all the little girls and boys watching at home.
extension.annotatedText: I look at this <u>statuette</u> and I think about all the little <u>girls</u> and <u>boys</u> watching at home.
extension.translation: 我看着这座奖杯，想到所有在家观看的小女孩和小男孩。

extension.text: If you have a dream, don't let anyone tell you it's impossible. Hold onto it tight.
extension.annotatedText: If you have a <u>dream</u>, don't let anyone tell you it's <u>impossible</u>. Hold onto it <u>tight</u>.
extension.translation: 如果你有梦想，别让任何人告诉你不可能。紧紧抓住它。

extension.text: Thank you all so much. This means the world to me. Good night!
extension.annotatedText: Thank you all so <u>much</u>. This means the <u>world</u> to me. Good <u>night</u>!
extension.translation: 非常感谢大家。这对我意义重大。晚安！

practice.text: I'd like to thank the Academy for this incredible honor.
practice.annotatedText: I'd like to thank the <u>Academy</u> for this <u>incredible</u> <u>honor</u>.
practice.translation: 我想感谢学院给予这个殊荣。

practice.text: I didn't prepare a speech because I never thought I'd win.
practice.annotatedText: I didn't pre<u>pare</u> a <u>speech</u> because I never thought I'd <u>win</u>.
practice.translation: 我没准备演讲稿，因为从没想过会赢。

practice.text: Standing here holding this Oscar is a dream come true.
practice.annotatedText: Standing here <u>holding</u> this <u>Oscar</u> is a dream come <u>true</u>.
practice.translation: 站在这里拿着奥斯卡奖杯，梦想成真了。

practice.text: I want to dedicate this award to my family back home.
practice.annotatedText: I want to <u>dedicate</u> this award to my <u>family</u> back <u>home</u>.
practice.translation: 我想把这个奖献给我的家人。

practice.text: This role was the most challenging thing I've ever done.
practice.annotatedText: This <u>role</u> was the most <u>challenging</u> thing I've ever <u>done</u>.
practice.translation: 这个角色是我做过最具挑战性的事情。

practice.text: Thank you to everyone who took a chance on me.
practice.annotatedText: Thank you to <u>everyone</u> who took a <u>chance</u> on <u>me</u>.
practice.translation: 感谢所有在我身上冒险的人。

practice.text: I share this with every person who believed in this film.
practice.annotatedText: I <u>share</u> this with every <u>person</u> who believed in this <u>film</u>.
practice.translation: 我与每一个相信这部电影的人分享这个奖。

practice.text: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how hard it gets.
practice.annotatedText: Never give <u>up</u> on your <u>dreams</u>, no matter how <u>hard</u> it gets.
practice.translation: 永远不要放弃你的梦想，无论多么艰难。

extension.text: Don't doubt your own ability. You have what it takes to lead.
extension.annotatedText: Don't doubt your <u>own</u> a<u>bili</u>ty. You have what it <u>takes</u> to lead.
extension.translation: 别怀疑自己的能力。你有领导所需的素质。

extension.text: When you step up, you inspire others to do the same.
extension.annotatedText: When you step <u>up</u>, you in<u>spire</u> others to do the <u>same</u>.
extension.translation: 当你站出来时，你激励了其他人也这样做。

extension.text: We need to create spaces where women's voices are heard and valued.
extension.annotatedText: We need to create <u>spaces</u> where women's <u>voices</u> are heard and <u>valued</u>.
extension.translation: 我们需要创造让女性的声音被听到和重视的空间。

extension.text: Mentorship is key. Lift others up as you climb.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Men</u>torship is <u>key</u>. Lift <u>others</u> up as you climb.
extension.translation: 导师制很关键。在攀登时也要拉别人一把。

extension.text: Let's break the glass ceiling together, one step at a time.
extension.annotatedText: Let's break the <u>glass ceiling</u> to<u>gether</u>, one step at a <u>time</u>.
extension.translation: 让我们一起打破玻璃天花板，一步一步来。

extension.text: Your unique perspective is your superpower. Use it.
extension.annotatedText: Your unique per<u>spec</u>tive is your <u>super</u>power. <u>Use</u> it.
extension.translation: 你独特的视角就是你的超能力。好好利用它。

extension.text: The future is inclusive, and we're building it now.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>future</u> is in<u>clu</u>sive, and we're <u>building</u> it now.
extension.translation: 未来是包容的，我们正在建设它。

practice.text: Lead with confidence, not arrogance.
practice.annotatedText: Lead with <u>con</u>fidence, not <u>ar</u>rogance.
practice.translation: 自信领导，而非傲慢。

practice.text: Collaboration over competition brings better results.
practice.annotatedText: Collabo<u>ra</u>tion over compe<u>ti</u>tion brings <u>bet</u>ter results.
practice.translation: 合作胜于竞争，能带来更好的结果。

practice.text: Supporting each other is how we grow stronger.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Sup</u>porting each <u>oth</u>er is how we grow <u>strong</u>er.
practice.translation: 互相支持是我们变得更强大的方式。

practice.text: Don't shrink yourself to make others comfortable.
practice.annotatedText: Don't <u>shrink</u> yourself to make others <u>com</u>fortable.
practice.translation: 不要为了让他人舒服而贬低自己。

practice.text: Your voice matters, even when it shakes.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>voice</u> matters, even when it <u>shakes</u>.
practice.translation: 你的声音很重要，即使它在颤抖。

practice.text: We're not asking for a seat; we're creating our own table.
practice.annotatedText: We're not <u>ask</u>ing for a <u>seat</u>; we're creating our <u>own</u> table.
practice.translation: 我们不是要一个座位；我们在创造自己的桌子。

practice.text: Diverse teams make smarter decisions.
practice.annotatedText: Di<u>verse</u> teams make <u>smart</u>er decisions.
practice.translation: 多元团队能做出更明智的决策。

practice.text: Empower others, and you empower yourself.
practice.annotatedText: Em<u>pow</u>er others, and you em<u>pow</u>er your<u>self</u>.
practice.translation: 赋能他人，也是在赋能自己。

extension.text: And we've found that people who are more socially connected are happier and physically healthier.
extension.annotatedText: And we've found that people who are <u>more</u> socially <u>connected</u> are happier and physically healthier.
extension.translation: 我们发现，社交联系更紧密的人更快乐，身体也更健康。

extension.text: Those who are more isolated than they want to be are less happy, and their health declines earlier.
extension.annotatedText: Those who are <u>more</u> isolated than they want to be are <u>less</u> happy, and their health declines earlier.
extension.translation: 那些比预期更孤独的人更不快乐，健康状况也衰退得更早。

extension.text: But it's not just about having relationships—it's about the quality of those relationships.
extension.annotatedText: But it's <u>not</u> just about having relationships—it's about the <u>quality</u> of those relationships.
extension.translation: 但这不只是有关系就行，而是关系质量的问题。

extension.text: High-conflict marriages, for example, are worse for our health than divorce.
extension.annotatedText: High-conflict <u>marriages</u>, for example, are <u>worse</u> for our health than divorce.
extension.translation: 比如，冲突不断的婚姻对健康的危害比离婚还大。

extension.text: Living in the midst of good relationships doesn't just protect our bodies; it protects our brains.
extension.annotatedText: Living in the midst of good relationships doesn't <u>just</u> protect our bodies; it protects our <u>brains</u>.
extension.translation: 生活在良好关系中不仅保护身体，还保护大脑。

extension.text: The people who were most satisfied in their relationships at age 50 were the healthiest at age 80.
extension.annotatedText: The people who were <u>most</u> satisfied in their relationships at age <u>50</u> were the healthiest at age <u>80</u>.
extension.translation: 50岁时对关系最满意的人，到80岁时最健康。

practice.text: The Harvard Study of Adult Development has followed these men for decades.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>Harvard</u> Study of Adult Development has followed these men for <u>decades</u>.
practice.translation: 哈佛成人发展研究追踪了这些人几十年。

practice.text: Good relationships don't just make us happier; they keep us healthier.
practice.annotatedText: Good relationships don't <u>just</u> make us happier; they keep us <u>healthier</u>.
practice.translation: 良好关系不仅让我们更快乐，还让我们更健康。

practice.text: Loneliness is toxic, and it's as powerful as smoking or alcoholism.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Loneliness</u> is <u>toxic</u>, and it's as powerful as smoking or alcoholism.
practice.translation: 孤独是有毒的，危害不亚于吸烟或酗酒。

practice.text: It's not the number of friends that matters, but the quality of close relationships.
practice.annotatedText: It's <u>not</u> the number of friends that matters, but the <u>quality</u> of close relationships.
practice.translation: 重要的不是朋友数量，而是亲密关系的质量。

practice.text: High-conflict marriages are actually worse for health than divorce.
practice.annotatedText: High-conflict <u>marriages</u> are actually <u>worse</u> for health than divorce.
practice.translation: 冲突不断的婚姻实际上比离婚还伤身体。

practice.text: At age 80, those with warm relationships had sharper memories.
practice.annotatedText: At age <u>80</u>, those with warm relationships had <u>sharper</u> memories.
practice.translation: 80岁时，拥有温暖关系的人记忆力更敏锐。

practice.text: The key is to actively invest in your relationships, not just coast along.
practice.annotatedText: The key is to <u>actively</u> invest in your relationships, not just <u>coast</u> along.
practice.translation: 关键在于主动投资你的关系，而不是随便应付。

practice.text: This message is simple, but it's profoundly important for our lives.
practice.annotatedText: This message is <u>simple</u>, but it's profoundly <u>important</u> for our lives.
practice.translation: 这个道理很简单，但对我们的生活极其重要。

extension.text: We can't afford to wait any longer. The time for half-measures is over.
extension.annotatedText: We can't afford to wait any <u>lon</u>ger. The time for half-<u>mea</u>sures is <u>o</u>ver.
extension.translation: 我们不能再等了。半途而废的时代已经结束了。

extension.text: Look at the wildfires, the floods, the storms — this is not a drill.
extension.annotatedText: Look at the <u>wild</u>fires, the <u>floods</u>, the <u>storms</u> — this is not a drill.
extension.translation: 看看那些野火、洪水和风暴——这不是演习。

extension.text: We have the technology, we have the resources — what we need is the will.
extension.annotatedText: We have the tech<u>nol</u>ogy, we have the <u>re</u>sources — what we need is the <u>will</u>.
extension.translation: 我们有技术，有资源——我们需要的是决心。

extension.text: Every nation must step up, not next year, not next decade — now.
extension.annotatedText: Every <u>na</u>tion must step up, not next <u>year</u>, not next <u>dec</u>ade — now.
extension.translation: 每个国家都必须行动起来，不是明年，不是下一个十年——而是现在。

extension.text: The fossil fuel industry has misled us for too long. We must hold them accountable.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>fos</u>sil fuel industry has misled us for too <u>long</u>. We must hold them ac<u>count</u>able.
extension.translation: 化石燃料行业误导我们太久了。我们必须追究他们的责任。

extension.text: But this is not about blame — it's about building a better future together.
extension.annotatedText: But this is not about <u>blame</u> — it's about <u>build</u>ing a better <u>fu</u>ture together.
extension.translation: 但这不怪谁——而是共同建设一个更美好的未来。

extension.text: So let's get to work. Let's make history — the right kind of history.
extension.annotatedText: So let's get to <u>work</u>. Let's make <u>his</u>tory — the right kind of <u>his</u>tory.
extension.translation: 所以，让我们开始行动吧。让我们创造历史——正确的那种历史。

practice.text: Climate change is the defining challenge of our time.
practice.annotatedText: Climate <u>change</u> is the de<u>fin</u>ing challenge of our <u>time</u>.
practice.translation: 气候变化是我们时代决定性的挑战。

practice.text: We must reduce carbon emissions drastically this decade.
practice.annotatedText: We must re<u>duce</u> carbon e<u>mis</u>sions <u>dras</u>tically this decade.
practice.translation: 我们必须在这个十年大幅减少碳排放。

practice.text: Renewable energy is cheaper and cleaner than ever before.
practice.annotatedText: Re<u>new</u>able energy is <u>chea</u>per and <u>clean</u>er than ever before.
practice.translation: 可再生能源比以往任何时候都更便宜、更清洁。

practice.text: The Amazon rainforest is a vital part of our planet's lungs.
practice.annotatedText: The A<u>ma</u>zon rainforest is a <u>vi</u>tal part of our <u>plan</u>et's lungs.
practice.translation: 亚马逊雨林是我们地球之肺的重要部分。

practice.text: We need to invest in green technology and sustainable agriculture.
practice.annotatedText: We need to in<u>vest</u> in green tech<u>nol</u>ogy and sustain<u>a</u>ble agriculture.
practice.translation: 我们需要投资绿色科技和可持续农业。

practice.text: The Paris Agreement gave us a roadmap, but we have to follow it.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>Pa</u>ris Agreement gave us a <u>road</u>map, but we have to <u>fol</u>low it.
practice.translation: 《巴黎协定》给了我们路线图，但我们必须遵守。

practice.text: Every ton of CO2 we avoid makes a difference.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>ton</u> of CO2 we a<u>void</u> makes a <u>dif</u>ference.
practice.translation: 我们避免的每一吨二氧化碳都会产生影响。

practice.text: Future generations will judge us by the actions we take today.
practice.annotatedText: Future <u>gen</u>erations will <u>judge</u> us by the <u>ac</u>tions we take today.
practice.translation: 未来几代人会根据我们今天采取的行动来评判我们。

extension.text: It's about choosing to be brave even when your hands are shaking.
extension.annotatedText: It's about <u>choosing</u> to be <u>brave</u> even when your hands are <u>shaking</u>.
extension.translation: 就是在双手发抖时也选择勇敢。

extension.text: Every time you step into the unknown, you build a little more courage.
extension.annotatedText: Every time you <u>step</u> into the unknown, you <u>build</u> a little more <u>courage</u>.
extension.translation: 每次你踏入未知，都会积累一点勇气。

extension.text: Don't wait until you're ready — because you'll never feel ready.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Don't</u> wait until you're <u>ready</u> — because you'll <u>never</u> feel ready.
extension.translation: 别等到准备好了——因为你永远不会觉得准备好。

extension.text: Start before you're confident. Confidence comes after you act.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Start</u> before you're <u>confident</u>. Confidence comes <u>after</u> you act.
extension.translation: 在自信之前就开始。自信是在行动之后才来的。

extension.text: And when you fall — and you will — remember that falling is just part of learning.
extension.annotatedText: And when you <u>fall</u> — and you <u>will</u> — remember that <u>falling</u> is just part of learning.
extension.translation: 当你跌倒——你一定会跌倒——记住跌倒只是学习的一部分。

extension.text: Get back up, dust yourself off, and try again with what you've learned.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Get back</u> up, <u>dust</u> yourself off, and <u>try again</u> with what you've learned.
extension.translation: 站起来，拍拍土，用你学到的东西再试一次。

extension.text: That's what real courage looks like: not a perfect record, but a willingness to keep showing up.
extension.annotatedText: That's what <u>real</u> courage looks like: not a <u>perfect</u> record, but a <u>willingness</u> to keep showing up.
extension.translation: 这才是真正的勇气：不是完美的记录，而是愿意继续出现的意愿。

practice.text: I'm scared but I'm doing it anyway.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>scared</u> but I'm <u>doing</u> it <u>anyway</u>.
practice.translation: 我很害怕但我还是去做。

practice.text: She showed up even though she didn't know what would happen.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>showed up</u> even though she didn't know what would <u>happen</u>.
practice.translation: 她出现了，即使她不知道会发生什么。

practice.text: Vulnerability isn't a weakness — it's a sign of strength.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Vulnerability</u> isn't a <u>weakness</u> — it's a sign of <u>strength</u>.
practice.translation: 脆弱不是弱点——它是力量的标志。

practice.text: You can't be brave without being afraid first.
practice.annotatedText: You <u>can't</u> be <u>brave</u> without being <u>afraid</u> first.
practice.translation: 没有恐惧，就不会有勇敢。

practice.text: Dare greatly, fail often, and rise every time.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Dare</u> greatly, <u>fail</u> often, and <u>rise</u> every time.
practice.translation: 大胆去闯，经常失败，每次再站起来。

practice.text: He took a deep breath and stepped onto the stage anyway.
practice.annotatedText: He took a <u>deep</u> breath and <u>stepped</u> onto the stage <u>anyway</u>.
practice.translation: 他深吸一口气，还是走上了舞台。

practice.text: It's okay to be vulnerable — that's how we connect.
practice.annotatedText: It's <u>okay</u> to be <u>vulnerable</u> — that's how we <u>connect</u>.
practice.translation: 脆弱没关系——我们就是这样连接的。

practice.text: Courage is a muscle — you have to exercise it.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Courage</u> is a <u>muscle</u> — you have to <u>exercise</u> it.
practice.translation: 勇气是肌肉——你得锻炼它。

extension.text: I've seen it happen in villages where children had nothing but hope.
extension.annotatedText: I've <u>seen</u> it <u>hap</u>pen in villages where children had <u>noth</u>ing but hope.
extension.translation: 我亲眼看到它在那些只有希望的村庄里发生。

extension.text: A single book, a single lesson — it can spark a fire that never goes out.
extension.annotatedText: A <u>sin</u>gle book, a <u>sin</u>gle lesson — it can spark a <u>fire</u> that never goes out.
extension.translation: 一本书，一堂课，就能点燃永不熄灭的火焰。

extension.text: We must break the cycle of poverty, and education is the key.
extension.annotatedText: We must <u>break</u> the cycle of <u>pov</u>erty, and education is the <u>key</u>.
extension.translation: 我们必须打破贫困的循环，教育就是关键。

extension.text: It's not just about passing exams; it's about opening minds.
extension.annotatedText: It's not <u>just</u> about passing ex<u>ams</u>; it's about <u>o</u>pening minds.
extension.translation: 这不只是通过考试，而是打开眼界。

extension.text: I've walked into classrooms where the roof leaked and the floor was dirt, but the students' eyes were full of light.
extension.annotatedText: I've walked into <u>class</u>rooms where the roof <u>leaked</u> and the floor was <u>dirt</u>, but the students' eyes were full of light.
extension.translation: 我走进过屋顶漏雨、地面是泥土的教室，但学生的眼睛里充满光芒。

extension.text: That light is the future, and we cannot afford to let it fade.
extension.annotatedText: That <u>light</u> is the <u>fu</u>ture, and we cannot afford to let it <u>fade</u>.
extension.translation: 那光芒就是未来，我们不能让它熄灭。

extension.text: So let's invest in teachers, in schools, in the dream of every child.
extension.annotatedText: So <u>let's</u> invest in <u>tea</u>chers, in schools, in the <u>dream</u> of every child.
extension.translation: 所以让我们投资老师，投资学校，投资每个孩子的梦想。

extension.text: Because when you change a life with education, you change the world.
extension.annotatedText: Because when you <u>change</u> a life with ed<u>u</u>cation, you change the <u>world</u>.
extension.translation: 因为当你用教育改变一个生命时，你就在改变世界。

practice.text: Education is the most powerful weapon we have against inequality.
practice.annotatedText: Edu<u>ca</u>tion is the most <u>pow</u>erful <u>wea</u>pon we have against inequality.
practice.translation: 教育是我们对抗不平等最强大的武器。

practice.text: Every child, no matter their background, deserves a quality education.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Eve</u>ry child, no <u>mat</u>ter their <u>back</u>ground, deserves a quality education.
practice.translation: 每个孩子，无论什么背景，都该得到优质教育。

practice.text: It breaks my heart to see kids who can't go to school because of poverty.
practice.annotatedText: It <u>breaks</u> my <u>heart</u> to see kids who can't go to school because of <u>pov</u>erty.
practice.translation: 看到孩子因贫困无法上学，我心都碎了。

practice.text: We need more schools in rural areas, and we need them now.
practice.annotatedText: We <u>need</u> more schools in <u>ru</u>ral areas, and we need them <u>now</u>.
practice.translation: 我们在农村需要更多学校，而且现在就要。

practice.text: A scholarship can be a lifeline for a talented student with no means.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>schol</u>arship can be a <u>life</u>line for a <u>tal</u>ented student with no means.
practice.translation: 一份奖学金可以成为有才华但没钱学生的救命稻草。

practice.text: Let's give every child a desk, a chair, and a chance to dream.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>give</u> every child a <u>desk</u>, a chair, and a <u>chance</u> to dream.
practice.translation: 让我们给每个孩子一张书桌、一把椅子和一个做梦的机会。

practice.text: The best investment we can make is in a teacher's training.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>best</u> invest<u>ment</u> we can make is in a <u>tea</u>cher's training.
practice.translation: 我们能做的最好的投资就是培训老师。

practice.text: Education lifts people out of darkness and into the light.
practice.annotatedText: Edu<u>ca</u>tion lifts people out of <u>dark</u>ness and into the <u>light</u>.
practice.translation: 教育把人从黑暗带向光明。

extension.text: So, let's talk about what that means for us, right here and right now.
extension.annotatedText: So, let's <u>talk</u> about what that means for us, right <u>here</u> and right <u>now</u>.
extension.translation: 那么，我们来谈谈这对我们，此时此刻，意味着什么。

extension.text: Every single one of us has a role to play in shaping this future.
extension.annotatedText: Every <u>single</u> one of us has a <u>role</u> to play in shaping this future.
extension.translation: 我们每一个人在塑造这个未来中都扮演着角色。

extension.text: It's not just about programmers or engineers; it's about teachers, nurses, artists, and you.
extension.annotatedText: It's not just about <u>program</u>mers or engineers; it's about <u>teach</u>ers, nurses, <u>art</u>ists, and you.
extension.translation: 这不只是程序员或工程师的事；它关乎老师、护士、艺术家，还有你。

extension.text: We need to start asking the hard questions now, before the technology outpaces our ability to control it.
extension.annotatedText: We need to start asking the <u>hard</u> questions now, before the technology out<u>paces</u> our ability to con<u>trol</u> it.
extension.translation: 我们现在就需要开始问那些尖锐的问题，在技术超越我们的控制能力之前。

extension.text: For example, who decides what values are programmed into these systems?
extension.annotatedText: For <u>ex</u>ample, who de<u>cides</u> what values are programmed into these systems?
extension.translation: 比如，谁来决定这些系统被输入了什么样的价值观？

extension.text: And how do we prevent bias from being baked into the algorithms?
extension.annotatedText: And how do we pre<u>vent</u> bias from being <u>baked</u> into the algorithms?
extension.translation: 我们又如何防止偏见被嵌入算法之中？

extension.text: These aren't just technical problems — they're ethical ones that demand our attention.
extension.annotatedText: These aren't just <u>tech</u>nical problems — they're <u>eth</u>ical ones that de<u>mand</u> our attention.
extension.translation: 这些不仅仅是技术问题——它们是伦理问题，需要我们关注。

extension.text: So, let's embrace the change, but let's do it with our eyes wide open.
extension.annotatedText: So, let's em<u>brace</u> the change, but let's do it with our eyes <u>wide</u> open.
extension.translation: 所以，让我们拥抱变化，但要睁大眼睛去做。

practice.text: AI is not a distant future — it's our present reality.
practice.annotatedText: AI is not a <u>dis</u>tant future — it's our <u>pres</u>ent reality.
practice.translation: 人工智能不是遥远的未来——它是我们当前的现实。

practice.text: We must teach our children to work alongside machines, not fear them.
practice.annotatedText: We must teach our <u>chil</u>dren to work a<u>long</u>side machines, not <u>fear</u> them.
practice.translation: 我们必须教我们的孩子与机器并肩工作，而不是害怕它们。

practice.text: The real danger is losing our humanity in the process.
practice.annotatedText: The real <u>dan</u>ger is <u>los</u>ing our humanity in the process.
practice.translation: 真正的危险是在这个过程中失去我们的人性。

practice.text: Think about it: would you trust a self-driving car with your life?
practice.annotatedText: Think about it: would you <u>trust</u> a self-driving car with your <u>life</u>?
practice.translation: 想想看：你会把自己的生命托付给一辆自动驾驶汽车吗？

practice.text: That's the level of trust we're building with AI every day.
practice.annotatedText: That's the <u>level</u> of trust we're <u>build</u>ing with AI every day.
practice.translation: 这就是我们每天与人工智能建立的信任程度。

practice.text: We need to make sure AI respects our privacy and our rights.
practice.annotatedText: We need to make <u>sure</u> AI respects our <u>pri</u>vacy and our <u>rights</u>.
practice.translation: 我们需要确保人工智能尊重我们的隐私和权利。

practice.text: Otherwise, we'll end up serving the very tools we created.
practice.annotatedText: Otherwise, we'll end up <u>serv</u>ing the very tools we <u>cre</u>ated.
practice.translation: 否则，我们最终会服务于我们自己创造的工具。

practice.text: So, the choice is ours: shape AI or be shaped by it.
practice.annotatedText: So, the <u>choice</u> is ours: <u>shape</u> AI or be shaped by it.
practice.translation: 所以，选择在我们：塑造人工智能，还是被它塑造。

extension.text: After he died, the shop stayed closed for months, and the street felt strangely quiet.
extension.annotatedText: After he <u>died</u>, the shop stayed <u>closed</u> for months, and the street felt <u>strangely</u> quiet.
extension.translation: 他去世后，书店关了几个月，那条街变得异常安静。

extension.text: Then one day, a young woman named Lily — Mr. Aldridge's granddaughter — arrived with a key.
extension.annotatedText: Then one <u>day</u>, a young woman named <u>Lily</u> — Mr. Aldridge's granddaughter — arrived with a <u>key</u>.
extension.translation: 有一天，一个叫莉莉的年轻女子——奥尔德里奇先生的孙女——拿着钥匙来了。

extension.text: She had inherited the bookshop, but she wasn't sure if she could run it herself.
extension.annotatedText: She had <u>inherited</u> the bookshop, but she wasn't <u>sure</u> if she could <u>run</u> it herself.
extension.translation: 她继承了这家书店，但不确定自己能不能经营好。

extension.text: The shelves were dusty, and the old wooden floor creaked under her feet.
extension.annotatedText: The shelves were <u>dusty</u>, and the old wooden floor <u>creaked</u> under her feet.
extension.translation: 书架上积满了灰尘，旧木地板在她脚下吱吱作响。

extension.text: But as she looked around, she found a worn notebook full of her grandfather's handwriting.
extension.annotatedText: But as she looked <u>around</u>, she found a worn note<u>book</u> full of her grandfather's hand<u>writing</u>.
extension.translation: 但她环顾四周时，发现了一本破旧的笔记本，里面写满了她祖父的字迹。

extension.text: It was a record of every story he had ever told the children — and the children's names.
extension.annotatedText: It was a <u>record</u> of every story he had ever told the <u>children</u> — and the children's <u>names</u>.
extension.translation: 那是他给孩子们讲过的每一个故事的记录——还有孩子们的名字。

extension.text: Lily smiled and decided to reopen the shop, continuing her grandfather's tradition.
extension.annotatedText: Lily <u>smiled</u> and decided to re<u>open</u> the shop, continuing her grandfather's <u>tradition</u>.
extension.translation: 莉莉笑了，决定重新开张这家店，延续她祖父的传统。

extension.text: Now the bookshop is alive again, and a new generation of children come to hear Lily's stories.
extension.annotatedText: Now the bookshop is a<u>live</u> again, and a new generation of <u>children</u> come to hear <u>Lily's</u> stories.
extension.translation: 现在书店又有了生气，新一代的孩子们来听莉莉讲故事。

practice.text: The bookshop has been there for over a century.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>bookshop</u> has been there for over a <u>century</u>.
practice.translation: 这家书店已经存在了一个多世纪。

practice.text: Mr. Aldridge knew every customer by name.
practice.annotatedText: Mr. <u>Aldridge</u> knew <u>every</u> customer by <u>name</u>.
practice.translation: 奥尔德里奇先生认识每一位顾客的名字。

practice.text: Children came after school to listen to his stories.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Children</u> came after <u>school</u> to listen to his <u>stories</u>.
practice.translation: 孩子们放学后来听他讲故事。

practice.text: He was more than a bookseller; he was a keeper of memories.
practice.annotatedText: He was <u>more</u> than a <u>bookseller</u>; he was a <u>keeper</u> of memories.
practice.translation: 他不只是个卖书的，更是记忆的守护者。

practice.text: After he passed away, the town mourned deeply.
practice.annotatedText: After he passed a<u>way</u>, the town <u>mourned</u> deeply.
practice.translation: 他去世后，全镇人深切哀悼。

practice.text: Lily inherited the bookshop from her grandfather.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Lily</u> in<u>herited</u> the bookshop from her <u>grandfather</u>.
practice.translation: 莉莉从她祖父那里继承了这家书店。

practice.text: She found a notebook full of his handwriting.
practice.annotatedText: She found a <u>notebook</u> full of his <u>handwriting</u>.
practice.translation: 她发现了一本满是他的笔迹的笔记本。

practice.text: Now a new generation of children come to hear stories.
practice.annotatedText: Now a <u>new</u> generation of <u>children</u> come to hear <u>stories</u>.
practice.translation: 现在新一代的孩子们来听故事。

extension.text: They'd ask him about the storms he weathered and the ships he saved.
extension.annotatedText: They'd <u>ask</u> him about the <u>storms</u> he weathered and the <u>ships</u> he saved.
extension.translation: 他们会问他经历过怎样的风暴，救过哪些船。

extension.text: But Thomas would just smile and say, 'I just did what I had to do.'
extension.annotatedText: But Thomas would just <u>smile</u> and say, 'I just did what I had to <u>do</u>.'
extension.translation: 但Thomas只会笑笑说：‘我只是做了该做的事。’

extension.text: He knew every creak of the wooden stairs and every whisper of the wind.
extension.annotatedText: He <u>knew</u> every <u>creak</u> of the wooden stairs and every <u>whisper</u> of the wind.
extension.translation: 他熟悉木梯的每一声吱呀，风的每一声低语。

extension.text: Sometimes he'd watch the ships pass by and remember the faces of the sailors he'd met.
extension.annotatedText: Sometimes he'd <u>watch</u> the ships pass by and <u>remember</u> the faces of the sailors he'd <u>met</u>.
extension.translation: 有时他会看着船只经过，想起曾见过的水手们的面孔。

extension.text: Now, when the foghorn blows, it sounds like a long goodbye.
extension.annotatedText: Now, when the <u>foghorn</u> blows, it sounds like a long <u>goodbye</u>.
extension.translation: 如今雾号响起时，听起来像一声长长的告别。

extension.text: But the light still shines, even though no one's there to tend it.
extension.annotatedText: But the <u>light</u> still shines, even though <u>no one's</u> there to tend it.
extension.translation: 但灯光依然亮着，即使无人照料。

practice.text: The lighthouse keeper's life was one of solitude and duty.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>lighthouse</u> keeper's life was one of <u>solitude</u> and <u>duty</u>.
practice.translation: 灯塔看守人的生活是孤独和责任。

practice.text: He climbed the spiral stairs every evening at dusk.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>climbed</u> the <u>spiral</u> stairs every evening at <u>dusk</u>.
practice.translation: 他每天黄昏爬上旋转楼梯。

practice.text: The lamp's beam cut through the thickest fog.
practice.annotatedText: The lamp's <u>beam</u> cut through the <u>thickest</u> fog.
practice.translation: 灯光穿透最浓的雾。

practice.text: Thomas knew the coastline like the back of his hand.
practice.annotatedText: Thomas <u>knew</u> the <u>coastline</u> like the back of his <u>hand</u>.
practice.translation: Thomas对这片海岸线了如指掌。

practice.text: His job became obsolete when automated beacons took over.
practice.annotatedText: His job became <u>obsolete</u> when <u>automated</u> beacons took <u>over</u>.
practice.translation: 自动灯塔启用后，他的工作就过时了。

practice.text: The tower stands silent, a monument to a bygone era.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>tower</u> stands <u>silent</u>, a <u>monument</u> to a bygone era.
practice.translation: 塔楼静静地矗立着，是逝去时代的纪念碑。

practice.text: Visitors wonder what it was like to live so isolated.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Visitors</u> wonder what it was like to live so <u>isolated</u>.
practice.translation: 游客们好奇住在如此与世隔绝的地方是什么感觉。

practice.text: The foghorn's moan echoes across the empty sea.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>foghorn's</u> moan <u>echoes</u> across the <u>empty</u> sea.
practice.translation: 雾号的呜咽在空旷的海面上回荡。

extension.text: The family had almost given up hope, but little Tommy never stopped looking.
extension.annotatedText: The family had almost given up hope, but little <u>Tom</u>my never stopped <u>look</u>ing.
extension.translation: 全家人都几乎放弃了希望，但小汤米从没停止寻找。

extension.text: He remembered seeing something shiny near the tulip bed a few days before.
extension.annotatedText: He remembered <u>see</u>ing something <u>shi</u>ny near the tulip bed a few days before.
extension.translation: 他记得几天前在郁金香花坛附近看到过什么闪闪发光的东西。

extension.text: He went out early in the morning, when the sunlight hit the garden just right.
extension.annotatedText: He went out <u>ear</u>ly in the morning, when the <u>sun</u>light hit the garden just <u>right</u>.
extension.translation: 他一大早出去，那时阳光正好照在花园上。

extension.text: And there it was — a tiny sparkle among the orange petals.
extension.annotatedText: And <u>there</u> it was — a tiny <u>spar</u>kle among the orange petals.
extension.translation: 就在那儿——橙色花瓣间一个小小的闪光点。

extension.text: He carefully picked it up and ran inside shouting, "Grandma, I found it!"
extension.annotatedText: He <u>care</u>fully picked it up and ran inside <u>shout</u>ing, "<u>Grand</u>ma, I found it!"
extension.translation: 他小心地捡起来，跑进屋里大喊：“奶奶，我找到了！”

extension.text: Martha hugged him tight and whispered, "You're my little treasure hunter."
extension.annotatedText: Martha hugged him <u>tight</u> and whispered, "You're my little <u>trea</sure> <u>hun</u>ter."
extension.translation: 玛莎紧紧抱住他，轻声说：“你是我的小寻宝家。”

extension.text: That evening, she told the story of the lost ring to her grandchildren at dinner.
extension.annotatedText: That <u>eve</u>ning, she told the story of the lost ring to her grandchildren at <u>din</u>ner.
extension.translation: 那天晚上，她在晚餐时给孙辈们讲了丢失戒指的故事。

extension.text: And she added, "This ring has been through a lot — just like our family."
extension.annotatedText: And she <u>ad</u>ded, "This ring has been through a <u>lot</u> — just like our <u>fam</u>ily."
extension.translation: 她又补充说：“这枚戒指经历了很多——就像我们家一样。”

practice.text: She felt a piece of her heart missing when the ring was gone.
practice.annotatedText: She felt a <u>piece</u> of her heart <u>miss</u>ing when the ring was gone.
practice.translation: 戒指不见时她觉得心缺了一块。

practice.text: Her grandchildren searched under every piece of furniture.
practice.annotatedText: Her grandchildren searched <u>un</u>der every <u>piece</u> of furniture.
practice.translation: 孙辈们翻遍了每一件家具下面。

practice.text: Tommy found it glinting in the garden where she planted tulips.
practice.annotatedText: Tommy found it <u>glin</u>ting in the garden where she <u>plan</u>ted tulips.
practice.translation: 汤米在花园里找到了它，就在她种郁金香的地方闪闪发光。

practice.text: She slipped the ring back on her finger and smiled.
practice.annotatedText: She slipped the ring back <u>on</u> her finger and <u>smiled</u>.
practice.translation: 她把戒指戴回手指上，笑了。

practice.text: Some things are meant to stay with you forever.
practice.annotatedText: Some things are <u>meant</u> to stay with you for<u>ev</u>er.
practice.translation: 有些东西注定要陪你一辈子。

practice.text: He remembered seeing something shiny near the tulip bed.
practice.annotatedText: He remembered <u>see</u>ing something <u>shi</u>ny near the tulip bed.
practice.translation: 他记得在郁金香花坛附近看到过什么闪闪发光的东西。

practice.text: She hugged him tight and whispered, "You're my little treasure hunter."
practice.annotatedText: She hugged him <u>tight</u> and whispered, "You're my little <u>trea</sure> <u>hun</u>ter."
practice.translation: 她紧紧抱住他，轻声说：“你是我的小寻宝家。”

practice.text: This ring has been through a lot — just like our family.
practice.annotatedText: This ring has been through a <u>lot</u> — just like our <u>fam</u>ily.
practice.translation: 这枚戒指经历了很多——就像我们家一样。

extension.text: The neighbours who found him said he looked like he was just dreaming — a faint smile still on his lips.
extension.annotatedText: The neighbours who <u>found</u> him said he looked like he was just <u>dreaming</u> — a faint smile still on his lips.
extension.translation: 发现他的邻居说他看起来就像在做梦——嘴角还挂着一丝微笑。

extension.text: They gathered around the canvas, not quite sure what to make of it.
extension.annotatedText: They <u>gathered</u> around the canvas, not quite sure what to <u>make</u> of it.
extension.translation: 他们围在画布旁，不太明白那画的是什么。

extension.text: It was a garden — but not any garden they'd ever seen. The flowers seemed to glow from within.
extension.annotatedText: It was a <u>garden</u> — but not any garden they'd ever <u>seen</u>. The flowers seemed to <u>glow</u> from within.
extension.translation: 那是一座花园——但不是他们见过的任何花园。花朵仿佛从内部发光。

extension.text: A little girl whispered, 'Grandpa painted heaven.'
extension.annotatedText: A little girl <u>whispered</u>, '<u>Grandpa</u> painted <u>heaven</u>.'
extension.translation: 一个小女孩轻声说：‘爷爷画了天堂。’

extension.text: Her mother wiped her eyes and nodded. 'Maybe he did, sweetheart. Maybe he did.'
extension.annotatedText: Her mother <u>wiped</u> her eyes and <u>nodded</u>. 'Maybe he <u>did</u>, sweetheart. Maybe he did.'
extension.translation: 她妈妈擦了擦眼睛，点点头：‘也许是的，宝贝。也许是的。’

extension.text: The painting now hangs in the local gallery, and people come from miles around just to see it.
extension.annotatedText: The painting now <u>hangs</u> in the local <u>gallery</u>, and people come from <u>miles</u> around just to see it.
extension.translation: 那幅画现在挂在当地的美术馆，人们从四面八方赶来只为看它一眼。

extension.text: They say there's something in the light, a warmth that makes you feel like you've come home.
extension.annotatedText: They say there's <u>something</u> in the <u>light</u>, a <u>warmth</u> that makes you feel like you've come home.
extension.translation: 他们说那光里有某种东西，一种让你感觉像回到家一样的温暖。

extension.text: And maybe that's what art is supposed to do — show us a beauty that doesn't fade, even when we do.
extension.annotatedText: And maybe that's what <u>art</u> is supposed to do — show us a <u>beauty</u> that doesn't fade, even when we <u>do</u>.
extension.translation: 也许这就是艺术的意义——向我们展示一种不会褪色的美，即使我们终将逝去。

practice.text: The old painter's hands trembled as he held the brush for the last time.
practice.annotatedText: The old <u>painter's</u> hands <u>trembled</u> as he held the brush for the <u>last</u> time.
practice.translation: 老画家最后一次握着画笔时手在颤抖。

practice.text: He painted from memory — a garden full of light and life.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>painted</u> from <u>memory</u> — a garden full of <u>light</u> and life.
practice.translation: 他凭记忆作画——一个充满光与生命的花园。

practice.text: The colours were so vivid they seemed to breathe on the canvas.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>colours</u> were so <u>vivid</u> they seemed to <u>breathe</u> on the canvas.
practice.translation: 色彩如此鲜艳，仿佛在画布上呼吸。

practice.text: It was his masterpiece — and it was also his last.
practice.annotatedText: It was his <u>masterpiece</u> — and it was <u>also</u> his <u>last</u>.
practice.translation: 那是他的杰作——也是他最后的作品。

practice.text: He passed peacefully that night with a paint-stained smile.
practice.annotatedText: He passed <u>peacefully</u> that night with a <u>paint-stained</u> smile.
practice.translation: 那晚他带着沾满颜料的笑意安详地走了。

practice.text: The little girl said, 'Grandpa painted heaven.'
practice.annotatedText: The little girl <u>said</u>, '<u>Grandpa</u> painted <u>heaven</u>.'
practice.translation: 小女孩说：‘爷爷画了天堂。’

practice.text: People come from miles around just to see that painting.
practice.annotatedText: People come from <u>miles</u> around just to <u>see</u> that <u>painting</u>.
practice.translation: 人们从四面八方赶来只为看那幅画。

practice.text: Art shows us a beauty that doesn't fade, even when we do.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Art</u> shows us a <u>beauty</u> that doesn't fade, even when we <u>do</u>.
practice.translation: 艺术向我们展示一种不会褪色的美，即使我们终将逝去。

extension.text: She never even knew she was being watched, but that little girl came back every single day for months.
extension.annotatedText: She never even <u>knew</u> she was being <u>watched</u>, but that little girl came back <u>every single day</u> for months.
extension.translation: 她根本不知道有人在看她，但那个小女孩一连好几个月每天都来。

extension.text: One day the violinist noticed her and smiled. The girl blushed and hid behind her mother's coat.
extension.annotatedText: One day the violinist <u>noticed</u> her and <u>smiled</u>. The girl <u>blushed</u> and hid behind her mother's coat.
extension.translation: 有一天小提琴手注意到了她，笑了笑。小女孩脸红了，躲在妈妈的大衣后面。

extension.text: From then on the musician would always look for that little face in the crowd.
extension.annotatedText: From <u>then</u> on the musician would <u>always</u> look for that little face in the crowd.
extension.translation: 从那以后，音乐家总是在人群中寻找那张小脸。

extension.text: Years passed and the violinist's career took off. She played in concert halls around the world.
extension.annotatedText: Years <u>passed</u> and the violinist's career <u>took off</u>. She played in <u>concert halls</u> around the world.
extension.translation: 几年过去了，小提琴手的事业腾飞了。她在世界各地的音乐厅演奏。

extension.text: But she never forgot the subway station. She kept her old violin case as a reminder of where she started.
extension.annotatedText: But she <u>never forgot</u> the subway station. She kept her <u>old violin case</u> as a reminder of where she <u>started</u>.
extension.translation: 但她从未忘记那个地铁站。她留着旧琴盒提醒自己从哪里开始的。

extension.text: One day she got a letter. It was from the little girl — now a young woman studying music at a prestigious school.
extension.annotatedText: One day she got a <u>letter</u>. It was from the little girl — now a young woman studying music at a <u>prestigious school</u>.
extension.translation: 有一天她收到一封信。是那个小女孩寄来的——现在她是个年轻女子，在一所名校学音乐。

extension.text: The letter said, 'You were my first inspiration. Thank you for playing every morning.'
extension.annotatedText: The letter said, '<u>You</u> were my first <u>inspiration</u>. <u>Thank you</u> for playing every morning.'
extension.translation: 信上说：“你是我最初的灵感。谢谢你每天早上演奏。”

extension.text: Now they sometimes play a duet together in that same subway station, just for old times' sake.
extension.annotatedText: Now they sometimes play a <u>duet</u> together in that same subway station, just for <u>old times' sake</u>.
extension.translation: 现在她们有时会在同一个地铁站一起演奏二重奏，只是为了怀旧。

practice.text: She played her violin every morning at 8:15 in the subway station.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>played</u> her <u>violin</u> every morning at <u>8:15</u> in the subway station.
practice.translation: 她每天早上8点15分在地铁站拉小提琴。

practice.text: Commuters rushed past without even noticing the music.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Commuters</u> rushed past without even <u>noticing</u> the music.
practice.translation: 通勤者匆匆走过，甚至没注意到音乐。

practice.text: One little girl always stopped to listen, fascinated by the sound.
practice.annotatedText: One <u>little girl</u> always stopped to <u>listen</u>, fascinated by the <u>sound</u>.
practice.translation: 一个小女孩总是停下来听，被声音迷住了。

practice.text: Years later that girl became a professional violinist herself.
practice.annotatedText: Years <u>later</u> that girl became a <u>professional</u> violinist <u>herself</u>.
practice.translation: 多年后，那个女孩自己也成了职业小提琴家。

practice.text: She never knew she was being watched by a future musician.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>never knew</u> she was being watched by a <u>future musician</u>.
practice.translation: 她不知道有个未来的音乐家在看着她。

practice.text: The subway musician changed a life just by doing what she loved.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>subway musician</u> changed a <u>life</u> just by doing what she <u>loved</u>.
practice.translation: 地铁音乐家仅仅通过做自己喜欢的事就改变了一个人生。

practice.text: Now they sometimes play a duet together in the same station.
practice.annotatedText: Now they sometimes play a <u>duet</u> together in the <u>same station</u>.
practice.translation: 现在她们有时会在同一个车站一起演奏二重奏。

practice.text: You never know whose life you are changing by sharing your passion.

practice.translation: 你永远不知道分享你的热情会改变谁的人生。

extension.text: His neighbor Mrs. Chen started a tradition of leaving fresh flowers on the counter each morning.

extension.text: The baker's shop became a gathering place where stories were swapped over warm croissants.

extension.text: Now every Sunday the baker bakes a special batch of sourdough just for the neighborhood.

practice.text: Mrs. Chen's flowers brightened everyone's morning.

practice.text: Neighbors shared more than just ingredients; they shared laughter.

extension.text: She traced the return address on the envelope, a small coastal town in Cornwall.

practice.text: Sometimes a message takes decades, but it's worth the wait.

extension.text: They started climbing without a word, just a smile and a nod.

extension.text: The path was steep and rocky, but they kept going.

extension.text: They didn't need to talk — the silence felt comfortable.

extension.text: They sat on the edge, watching the sun rise over the clouds.

extension.text: The kids cried with joy and hugged her tight.
