extension.translation: 她的咕噜声听起来像一台平稳运转的小引擎。

extension.text: They gave her a warm bath and brushed out the tangles in her fur.
extension.annotatedText: They gave her a <u>warm</u> bath and <u>brushed</u> out the tangles in her fur.
extension.translation: 他们给她洗了个热水澡，刷掉了毛里的结。

extension.text: She ate a whole can of tuna and licked the bowl clean.
extension.annotatedText: She ate a <u>whole</u> can of tuna and licked the bowl <u>clean</u>.
extension.translation: 她吃了一整罐金枪鱼，把碗舔得干干净净。

extension.text: That night, Luna slept on the little girl's bed, tucked under the blanket.
extension.annotatedText: That night, Luna <u>slept</u> on the little girl's bed, tucked under the <u>blanket</u>.
extension.translation: 那天晚上，Luna睡在小女孩的床上，缩在毯子底下。

extension.text: In the morning, she followed the father to the kitchen, meowing for breakfast.
extension.annotatedText: In the morning, she <u>followed</u> the father to the kitchen, <u>meowing</u> for breakfast.
extension.translation: 早上，她跟着爸爸去厨房，喵喵叫着要早饭。

practice.text: Luna the cat had been missing for six months.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Luna</u> the cat had been <u>missing</u> for six months.
practice.translation: 猫咪Luna失踪了六个月。

practice.text: She appeared on the doorstep covered in dust.
practice.annotatedText: She appeared on the <u>doorstep</u> covered in <u>dust</u>.
practice.translation: 她出现在门阶上，浑身是灰。

practice.text: The family had given up hope of ever seeing her again.
practice.annotatedText: The family had given up <u>hope</u> of ever <u>seeing</u> her again.
practice.translation: 家人已经不抱希望了。

practice.text: She walked in as if she had never left.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>walked</u> in as if she had <u>never</u> left.
practice.translation: 她走进来，好像从未离开过。

practice.text: Nobody knows where she went.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Nobody</u> knows <u>where</u> she went.
practice.translation: 没人知道她去了哪里。

practice.text: Home is wherever you are loved.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Home</u> is wherever you are <u>loved</u>.
practice.translation: 家就是有人爱你的地方。

practice.text: The kids cried with joy and hugged her tight.
practice.annotatedText: The kids <u>cried</u> with <u>joy</u> and hugged her tight.
practice.translation: 孩子们高兴得哭了起来，紧紧抱住了她。

practice.text: She ate a whole can of tuna and licked the bowl clean.
practice.annotatedText: She ate a <u>whole</u> can of <u>tuna</u> and licked the bowl clean.
practice.translation: 她吃了一整罐金枪鱼，把碗舔得干干净净。

extension.text: She tried her grandmother's famous apple pie first — the one with the secret pinch of cinnamon.
extension.annotatedText: She tried her grandmother's <u>famous</u> apple pie first — the one with the <u>secret</u> pinch of cinnamon.
extension.translation: 她先试了祖母最拿手的苹果派——那个加了秘密一撮肉桂的。

extension.text: The kitchen filled with that familiar warm smell, and Alice couldn't help but smile.
extension.annotatedText: The kitchen filled with that <u>familiar</u> warm smell, and Alice <u>couldn't</u> help but smile.
extension.translation: 厨房里弥漫着那股熟悉的温暖香味，Alice忍不住笑了。

extension.text: She noticed little things — like how her grandmother always added a bit more butter than the recipe said.
extension.annotatedText: She noticed <u>little</u> things — like how her grandmother <u>always</u> added a bit more butter than the recipe said.
extension.translation: 她注意到一些小细节——比如祖母总是比菜谱多放一点黄油。

extension.text: It was those tiny adjustments that made each dish uniquely hers.
extension.annotatedText: It was those <u>tiny</u> adjustments that made each dish <u>uniquely</u> hers.
extension.translation: 正是那些微小的调整让每道菜都独具她的风格。

extension.text: Alice started adding her own twists too — a dash of ginger here, a sprinkle of lemon zest there.
extension.annotatedText: Alice started adding her own <u>twists</u> too — a dash of ginger here, a sprinkle of <u>lemon zest</u> there.
extension.translation: Alice也开始加入自己的创意——这里加一点姜，那里撒一点柠檬皮。

extension.text: She realized the notebook wasn't just a collection of recipes; it was a conversation across time.
extension.annotatedText: She realized the notebook wasn't just a collection of <u>recipes</u>; it was a <u>conversation</u> across time.
extension.translation: 她意识到这本笔记本不只是菜谱集；它是一场跨越时空的对话。

extension.text: And when she served her family Sunday dinner, she saw her grandmother's love reflected in their smiling faces.
extension.annotatedText: And when she served her family <u>Sunday</u> dinner, she saw her grandmother's love reflected in their <u>smiling</u> faces.
extension.translation: 当她为家人端上周日大餐时，她从他们笑脸上看到了祖母的爱。

practice.text: The notebook was filled with her grandmother's handwriting.
practice.annotatedText: The notebook was <u>filled</u> with her grandmother's <u>handwriting</u>.
practice.translation: 笔记本上满是祖母的字迹。

practice.text: She baked her grandmother's secret chocolate cake for the first time.
practice.annotatedText: She baked her grandmother's <u>secret</u> chocolate cake for the <u>first</u> time.
practice.translation: 她第一次烤了祖母的秘密巧克力蛋糕。

practice.text: Every recipe told a story of family gatherings and holiday feasts.
practice.annotatedText: Every recipe told a <u>story</u> of family <u>gatherings</u> and <u>holiday</u> feasts.
practice.translation: 每一道菜谱都讲述着家庭聚会和节日盛宴的故事。

practice.text: The old cookbook smelled of vanilla and memories.
practice.annotatedText: The old cookbook smelled of <u>vanilla</u> and <u>memories</u>.
practice.translation: 那本旧食谱散发着香草和回忆的味道。

practice.text: She added a pinch of salt just like her grandmother always did.
practice.annotatedText: She added a <u>pinch</u> of salt just like her grandmother <u>always</u> did.
practice.translation: 她加了一撮盐，就像祖母一直做的那样。

practice.text: Alice discovered a note in the margin that said 'more love.'
practice.annotatedText: Alice discovered a <u>note</u> in the margin that said 'more <u>love</u>.'
practice.translation: Alice在页边发现一条手记，写着“更多爱”。

practice.text: Cooking her grandmother's recipes made Alice feel connected to the past.
practice.annotatedText: Cooking her grandmother's recipes made Alice feel <u>connected</u> to the <u>past</u>.
practice.translation: 做祖母的菜谱让Alice感到与过去相连。

practice.text: She passed the recipe book to her own daughter with a hug.
practice.annotatedText: She passed the recipe book to her own daughter with a <u>hug</u>.
practice.translation: 她把菜谱书传给了自己的女儿，并给了她一个拥抱。

extension.text: Now a young woman walks through that valley every morning, and she remembers the old man.
extension.annotatedText: Now a young woman <u>walks</u> through that valley every <u>morning</u>, and she <u>remembers</u> the old man.
extension.translation: 现在有个年轻女人每天早上穿过那片山谷，她想起了那位老人。

extension.text: She never met him, but she sees his legacy in every leaf and every bird song.
extension.annotatedText: She never <u>met</u> him, but she sees his <u>legacy</u> in every leaf and every <u>bird song</u>.
extension.translation: 她从没见过他，但她在每片叶子和每声鸟鸣中看到了他的遗产。

extension.text: One day she decides to plant a few trees herself, right next to his.
extension.annotatedText: One day she <u>decides</u> to plant a few trees herself, right next to <u>his</u>.
extension.translation: 有一天她决定自己种几棵树，就种在他的树旁边。

extension.text: Her neighbors think she's crazy, but she just smiles and keeps digging.
extension.annotatedText: Her neighbors think <u>she's crazy</u>, but she just <u>smiles</u> and keeps <u>digging</u>.
extension.translation: 邻居们觉得她疯了，但她只是笑笑继续挖坑。

extension.text: She plants a small oak sapling and waters it every day, rain or shine.
extension.annotatedText: She plants a small <u>oak</u> sapling and <u>waters</u> it every day, rain or <u>shine</u>.
extension.translation: 她种了一棵小橡树苗，每天浇水，风雨无阻。

extension.text: Years pass, and that sapling grows into a strong tree, standing tall among the old man's trees.
extension.annotatedText: Years <u>pass</u>, and that sapling grows into a <u>strong</u> tree, standing <u>tall</u> among the old man's trees.
extension.translation: 多年过去了，那棵小苗长成了大树，在老人的树林中高高耸立。

extension.text: Now more people join her, and the valley becomes a forest of hope.
extension.annotatedText: Now more people <u>join</u> her, and the valley becomes a <u>forest of hope</u>.
extension.translation: 现在更多人加入了她，山谷变成了一片希望的森林。

practice.text: The old man planted trees when nobody believed.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>old man</u> planted trees when <u>nobody believed</u>.
practice.translation: 老人种树的时候没人相信。

practice.text: He spent twenty years turning a barren valley green.
practice.annotatedText: He spent <u>twenty years</u> turning a <u>barren valley</u> green.
practice.translation: 他花了二十年把荒谷变绿。

practice.text: People called him foolish, but he kept planting.
practice.annotatedText: People called him <u>foolish</u>, but he kept <u>planting</u>.
practice.translation: 人们说他傻，但他一直种。

practice.text: He smiled and kept digging, day after day.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>smiled</u> and kept <u>digging</u>, day after <u>day</u>.
practice.translation: 他笑着继续挖，日复一日。

practice.text: Twenty years later, the valley was full of birds.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Twenty years</u> later, the valley was <u>full of birds</u>.
practice.translation: 二十年后，山谷里满是鸟儿。

practice.text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>best time</u> to plant a tree was <u>twenty years ago</u>.
practice.translation: 种树最好的时间是二十年前。

practice.text: The second best time is now, so start today.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>second best</u> time is <u>now</u>, so <u>start today</u>.
practice.translation: 其次是现在，所以今天就开始吧。

practice.text: A young woman continues his work, planting hope.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>young woman</u> continues his work, planting <u>hope</u>.
practice.translation: 一个年轻女人继续他的工作，种下希望。

extension.text: And that stranger, the one she never knew, changed her life in a way he never imagined.
extension.annotatedText: And <u>that</u> stranger, the one she <u>never</u> knew, changed her life in a way he <u>nev</u>er imagined.
extension.translation: 而那个陌生人，她从未认识的陌生人，以一种他从未想象过的方式改变了她的生活。

extension.text: She started looking for people who looked sad or lonely, and she'd offer them a smile or a kind word.
extension.annotatedText: She <u>start</u>ed looking for people who looked sad or <u>lone</u>ly, and she'd <u>of</u>fer them a smile or a kind word.
extension.translation: 她开始留意那些看起来悲伤或孤独的人，然后给他们一个微笑或一句暖心的话。

extension.text: Sometimes just sitting with someone in silence is enough to let them know they're not alone.
extension.annotatedText: Sometimes just <u>sit</u>ting with someone in <u>si</u>lence is e<u>nough</u> to let them know they're not a<u>lone</u>.
extension.translation: 有时候，只是静静地陪着一个人，就足以让他们知道自己并不孤单。

extension.text: Years later, she found herself on that same station bench, but this time she was the one handing out tissues.
extension.annotatedText: Years <u>la</u>ter, she found herself on that <u>same</u> station bench, but this time she was the one <u>hand</u>ing out tissues.
extension.translation: 多年后，她发现自己又坐在了那个站台的长椅上，但这次，她是那个递纸巾的人。

extension.text: A young woman was crying, and she remembered how she felt that day.
extension.annotatedText: A <u>young</u> woman was <u>cry</u>ing, and she remembered how she <u>felt</u> that day.
extension.translation: 一个年轻女人在哭泣，她想起了自己那天的心情。

extension.text: She sat down, handed her a tissue, and said, 'Whatever it is, it will pass.'
extension.annotatedText: She sat <u>down</u>, handed her a <u>tis</u>sue, and said, '<u>What</u>ever it is, it will <u>pass</u>.'
extension.translation: 她坐下来，递上一张纸巾，说：‘不管是什么，都会过去的。’

extension.text: The young woman looked up, surprised, and whispered a thank you.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>young</u> woman looked <u>up</u>, sur<u>prised</u>, and whispered a <u>thank</u> you.
extension.translation: 年轻女人抬起头，很惊讶，轻声说了句谢谢。

extension.text: And in that moment, she knew the kindness had come full circle.
extension.annotatedText: And in that <u>mo</u>ment, she knew the <u>kind</u>ness had come <u>full</u> circle.
extension.translation: 而在那一刻，她知道这份善意已经形成了一个完整的循环。

practice.text: She was crying on a train station bench.
practice.annotatedText: She was <u>cry</u>ing on a <u>train</u> station bench.
practice.translation: 她在火车站的长椅上哭泣。

practice.text: The stranger handed her a tissue without saying a word.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>stran</u>ger handed her a <u>tis</u>sue without <u>say</u>ing a word.
practice.translation: 那个陌生人没说一句话，递给她一张纸巾。

practice.text: Whatever it is, it will pass.
practice.annotatedText: <u>What</u>ever it is, it will <u>pass</u>.
practice.translation: 不管是什么，都会过去的。

practice.text: She never learned his name.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>nev</u>er learned his <u>name</u>.
practice.translation: 她始终不知道他的名字。

practice.text: Years later, she saw someone in tears.
practice.annotatedText: Years <u>la</u>ter, she saw <u>some</u>one in <u>tears</u>.
practice.translation: 多年后，她看到有人在哭。

practice.text: She sat down and passed them a tissue.
practice.annotatedText: She sat <u>down</u> and passed them a <u>tis</u>sue.
practice.translation: 她坐下来，递上一张纸巾。

practice.text: The smallest acts of kindness ripple outward.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>small</u>est acts of <u>kind</u>ness rip<u>ple</u> outward.
practice.translation: 最小的善举会向外扩散。

practice.text: A single tissue can change a life.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>sin</u>gle <u>tis</u>sue can change a <u>life</u>.
practice.translation: 一张纸巾可以改变一生。

extension.text: Some say the chef was a former businessman who lost everything and found his way back through cooking.
extension.annotatedText: Some say the chef was a former <u>business</u>man who lost <u>every</u>thing and found his way back through <u>cook</u>ing.
extension.translation: 有人说厨师以前是个生意人，失去一切后通过烹饪找回了自我。

extension.text: He'd listen to customers' stories while they ate, and somehow the next bowl always tasted a little different.
extension.annotatedText: He'd <u>lis</u>ten to customers' stories while they ate, and somehow the next bowl always tasted a little <u>diff</u>erent.
extension.translation: 他会边听顾客讲故事边做面，下一碗的味道总会有点不一样。

extension.text: One regular, an old taxi driver, came every night after his shift and always ordered the same thing: spicy miso ramen with extra pork.
extension.annotatedText: One <u>reg</u>ular, an old taxi driver, came every night after his shift and always ordered the same thing: spicy <u>mi</u>so ramen with extra <u>pork</u>.
extension.translation: 有位老出租车司机常客，每晚下班后都来，总点同一份：辣味噌拉面加双份肉。

extension.text: Then one night he brought a woman — his daughter, whom he hadn't seen in years.
extension.annotatedText: Then one night he brought a <u>wo</u>man — his <u>daugh</u>ter, whom he hadn't seen in <u>years</u>.
extension.translation: 有天晚上他带来一个女人——他多年未见的女儿。

extension.text: They didn't talk much, but they shared a bowl of tonkotsu ramen, and the chef saw tears in both their eyes.
extension.annotatedText: They didn't talk much, but they shared a bowl of <u>ton</u>kotsu ramen, and the chef saw <u>tears</u> in both their <u>eyes</u>.
extension.translation: 两人话不多，但共享了一碗豚骨拉面，厨师看到他们眼里都有泪光。

extension.text: That was the night the chef decided to close the shop — because he knew his work was done.
extension.annotatedText: That was the night the chef decided to <u>close</u> the shop — because he knew his work was <u>done</u>.
extension.translation: 那晚厨师决定关店——因为他知道他的使命完成了。

extension.text: The little alley is quiet now, but if you listen closely, you can still hear the clatter of bowls and the whispers of old stories.
extension.annotatedText: The little <u>al</u>ley is quiet now, but if you listen <u>close</u>ly, you can still hear the <u>clat</u>ter of bowls and the whispers of old stories.
extension.translation: 小巷现在很安静，但如果你仔细听，还能听到碗碟的碰撞声和旧故事的耳语。

practice.text: The ramen shop was hidden in a back alley.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>ra</u>men shop was hidden in a <u>back</u> alley.
practice.translation: 拉面店藏在小巷里。

practice.text: It opened only from midnight till dawn.
practice.annotatedText: It opened <u>on</u>ly from <u>mid</u>night till <u>dawn</u>.
practice.translation: 它只在午夜到黎明营业。

practice.text: The chef never spoke much, but his bowls told stories.
practice.annotatedText: The chef never <u>spoke</u> much, but his bowls told <u>sto</u>ries.
practice.translation: 厨师话不多，但他的碗会讲故事。

practice.text: Lost love, second chances, and roads not taken.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Lost</u> love, <u>sec</u>ond chances, and roads not <u>tak</u>en.
practice.translation: 失去的爱、第二次机会和未走的路。

practice.text: Taxi drivers, nurses, and heartbroken poets all found solace there.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Tax</u>i drivers, <u>nurs</u>es, and <u>heart</u>broken poets all found solace there.
practice.translation: 出租车司机、护士和心碎的诗人都在那里找到慰藉。

practice.text: The ramen tasted like home.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>ra</u>men tasted like <u>home</u>.
practice.translation: 那碗拉面尝起来像家的味道。

practice.text: He listened to customers' stories while they ate.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>lis</u>tened to <u>cus</u>tomers' stories while they <u>ate</u>.
practice.translation: 他边吃边听顾客的故事。

practice.text: The shop closed years ago, but the memories remain.
practice.annotatedText: The shop <u>closed</u> years a<u>go</u>, but the <u>mem</u>ories remain.
practice.translation: 那家店多年前就关了，但记忆犹存。

extension.text: So the new owner, a young man named Tom, decided to keep the light burning.
extension.annotatedText: So the <u>new</u> owner, a <u>young</u> man named Tom, decided to keep the light burning.
extension.translation: 于是新主人，一个叫汤姆的年轻人，决定让那盏灯继续亮着。

extension.text: He didn't know the old woman, but he heard the story from the neighbors.
extension.annotatedText: He <u>didn't</u> know the old woman, but he <u>heard</u> the story from the neighbors.
extension.translation: 他不认识那位老妇人，但从邻居那里听说了这个故事。

extension.text: It touched his heart, and he felt a connection to the house's past.
extension.annotatedText: It <u>touched</u> his heart, and he <u>felt</u> a connection to the house's past.
extension.translation: 这触动了他的心，他感到与房子的过去有了联系。

extension.text: Every evening, before going to bed, he'd check that the light was on.
extension.annotatedText: Every <u>eve</u>ning, before going to bed, he'd <u>check</u> that the light was on.
extension.translation: 每天晚上睡觉前，他都会确认灯是亮着的。

extension.text: One night, a storm knocked out the power, and the light went off.
extension.annotatedText: One <u>night</u>, a <u>storm</u> knocked out the power, and the light went off.
extension.translation: 一天晚上，暴风雨切断了电源，灯灭了。

extension.text: Tom rushed to get candles and a flashlight, determined to keep the window lit.
extension.annotatedText: Tom <u>rushed</u> to get candles and a <u>flash</u>light, <u>deter</u>mined to keep the window lit.
extension.translation: 汤姆赶紧拿来蜡烛和手电筒，决心要让窗户亮着。

extension.text: The next day, the neighbors thanked him for keeping the tradition alive.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>next</u> day, the neighbors <u>thanked</u> him for keeping the tradition alive.
extension.translation: 第二天，邻居们感谢他延续了这个传统。

extension.text: And so, the light continues to shine, a beacon of hope and memory in the old lane.
extension.annotatedText: And so, the light <u>con</u>tinues to shine, a <u>bea</u>con of hope and memory in the old lane.
extension.translation: 于是，那盏灯继续亮着，成为老街上一座希望与记忆的灯塔。

practice.text: The light in the window never went out, not even once.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>light</u> in the window <u>nev</u>er went out, not <u>e</u>ven once.
practice.translation: 窗户里的灯从未熄灭过，一次都没有。

practice.text: She waited for her son for fifty long years.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>wait</u>ed for her son for <u>fif</u>ty long years.
practice.translation: 她等儿子等了漫长的五十年。

practice.text: The old house stood silent, but the light spoke of love.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>old</u> house stood <u>si</u>lent, but the light spoke of <u>love</u>.
practice.translation: 老房子静默伫立，但灯光诉说着爱。

practice.text: Tom kept the light on because he believed in hope.
practice.annotatedText: Tom <u>kept</u> the light on because he <u>be</u>lieved in hope.
practice.translation: 汤姆让灯亮着是因为他相信希望。

practice.text: The neighbors saw the light and felt a sense of comfort.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>neigh</u>bors saw the light and <u>felt</u> a sense of <u>com</u>fort.
practice.translation: 邻居们看到那盏灯，感到一种安慰。

practice.text: During the storm, Tom fought to keep the light alive.
practice.annotatedText: During the <u>storm</u>, Tom <u>fought</u> to keep the light alive.
practice.translation: 暴风雨中，汤姆竭力保持灯亮着。

practice.text: A beacon in the night, the light guided no one home, but it meant everything.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>bea</u>con in the night, the light guided <u>no</u> one home, but it <u>meant</u> everything.
practice.translation: 夜晚的灯塔，那盏灯没有指引任何人回家，但它意味一切。

practice.text: Some traditions are too precious to let go.
practice.annotatedText: Some <u>tra</u>ditions are too <u>pre</u>cious to let go.
practice.translation: 有些传统太珍贵了，不能放弃。

extension.text: Remember why you started playing this game. It wasn't for the fame or the money. It was for the love of it.
extension.annotatedText: Remember <u>why</u> you started playing this <u>game</u>. It wasn't for the fame or the money. It was for the <u>love</u> of it.
extension.translation: 记住你们当初为什么踢球。不是为了名声或金钱，而是因为热爱。

extension.text: I've seen you train harder than any team I've ever coached. That doesn't just disappear because of one bad half.
extension.annotatedText: I've <u>seen</u> you train <u>harder</u> than any team I've ever coached. That doesn't just disappear because of one <u>bad</u> half.
extension.translation: 我见过你们训练比任何我带过的球队都刻苦。不会因为上半场踢得差就没了。

extension.text: They're tired too. They're human just like you. So dig deep and find that extra gear.
extension.annotatedText: They're <u>tired</u> too. They're human just like you. So <u>dig deep</u> and find that extra gear.
extension.translation: 他们也累了。他们和你们一样也是人。所以打起精神，再拼一把。

extension.text: Don't let fear of making a mistake hold you back. I'd rather see you try something bold and fail than play safe and regret it.
extension.annotatedText: Don't let fear of making a <u>mistake</u> hold you back. I'd rather see you try something <u>bold</u> and fail than play <u>safe</u> and regret it.
extension.translation: 别怕犯错。我宁愿看你们大胆尝试然后失败，也不愿看你们保守踢法然后后悔。

extension.text: We've come back from worse. Remember the cup final last season? We were down two goals at half time and we won.
extension.annotatedText: We've come back from <u>worse</u>. Remember the cup final last season? We were down <u>two goals</u> at half time and we <u>won</u>.
extension.translation: 我们逆转过更糟的局面。还记得上赛季的杯赛决赛吗？我们半场落后两球，最后赢了。

extension.text: This is your moment. The next forty-five minutes can define your season. Make them count.
extension.annotatedText: This is your <u>moment</u>. The next forty-five minutes can define your <u>season</u>. Make them <u>count</u>.
extension.translation: 这是你们的时刻。接下来的45分钟可能决定整个赛季。别浪费了。

extension.text: When you step onto that pitch, I want to see fire in your eyes. No more looking down. Heads up, chests out.
extension.annotatedText: When you step onto that pitch, I want to see <u>fire</u> in your eyes. No more looking <u>down</u>. Heads up, chests out.
extension.translation: 当你们踏上球场，我要看到眼里的火焰。别垂头丧气。抬头挺胸。

practice.text: We're going to press higher and win the ball back quickly.
practice.annotatedText: We're going to <u>press higher</u> and win the ball back <u>quickly</u>.
practice.translation: 我们要高位逼抢，快速夺回球权。

practice.text: Fullbacks, push up and support the wingers. Don't leave them isolated.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Fullbacks</u>, push up and support the <u>wingers</u>. Don't leave them <u>isolated</u>.
practice.translation: 边后卫压上支援边锋，别让他们孤立无援。

practice.text: Midfielders, close down the space. Don't let them turn and play forward.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Midfielders</u>, close down the <u>space</u>. Don't let them turn and play <u>forward</u>.
practice.translation: 中场球员压缩空间，别让他们转身向前传球。

practice.text: Strikers, make runs in behind. Stretch their defensive line.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Strikers</u>, make runs in behind. Stretch their <u>defensive line</u>.
practice.translation: 前锋跑身后，拉开他们的防线。

practice.text: We need to be more aggressive in the tackle. Second balls are crucial.
practice.annotatedText: We need to be more <u>aggressive</u> in the tackle. <u>Second balls</u> are crucial.
practice.translation: 拼抢要更凶狠，第二落点至关重要。

practice.text: If you lose the ball, sprint back and recover. No walking.
practice.annotatedText: If you <u>lose</u> the ball, <u>sprint back</u> and recover. No <u>walking</u>.
practice.translation: 丢球就全速回追，别走着。

practice.text: Keep the tempo high. Quick passes, one or two touches maximum.
practice.annotatedText: Keep the <u>tempo</u> high. Quick passes, one or two touches <u>maximum</u>.
practice.translation: 保持高节奏，快速传球，最多一两脚触球。

practice.text: Believe in each other. We win as a team, we lose as a team.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Believe</u> in each other. We <u>win</u> as a team, we lose as a <u>team</u>.
practice.translation: 互相信任。赢一起赢，输一起输。

extension.text: And yet, we often forget that peace is not a destination; it's a daily practice.
extension.annotatedText: And yet, we often forget that peace is <u>not</u> a <u>destination</u>; it's a <u>daily</u> practice.
extension.translation: 然而，我们常常忘记和平不是一个终点；它是一种日常的实践。

extension.text: It's in the small gestures — a smile, a helping hand, a moment of silence when words fail.
extension.annotatedText: It's in the <u>small</u> gestures — a <u>smile</u>, a helping hand, a moment of <u>silence</u> when words fail.
extension.translation: 它体现在微小的举动中——一个微笑，一次援手，当言语无法表达时的片刻沉默。

extension.text: We don't have to agree on everything to live together in peace; we just need to respect each other's humanity.
extension.annotatedText: We don't have to agree on <u>everything</u> to live together in peace; we just need to <u>respect</u> each other's <u>humanity</u>.
extension.translation: 我们不必在所有事情上都达成一致才能和平共处；我们只需要尊重彼此的人性。

extension.text: That's the hard part, isn't it? Seeing the person behind the enemy, the story behind the anger.
extension.annotatedText: That's the <u>hard</u> part, <u>isn't</u> it? Seeing the person behind the enemy, the story behind the <u>anger</u>.
extension.translation: 这就是最难的部分，不是吗？看到敌人背后的人，愤怒背后的故事。

extension.text: But I've seen it happen — in communities torn apart by war, people choosing to forgive, choosing to rebuild together.
extension.annotatedText: But I've <u>seen</u> it happen — in communities torn apart by war, people <u>choosing</u> to forgive, choosing to <u>rebuild</u> together.
extension.translation: 但我见过它发生——在被战争撕裂的社区里，人们选择原谅，选择一起重建。

extension.text: Forgiveness doesn't mean forgetting; it means refusing to let the past hold the future hostage.
extension.annotatedText: Forgiveness doesn't mean <u>forgetting</u>; it means refusing to let the past hold the <u>future</u> <u>hostage</u>.
extension.translation: 原谅并不意味着忘记；它意味着拒绝让过去挟持未来。

extension.text: So let us be builders of bridges, not walls. Let us be gardeners of hope, not sowers of fear.
extension.annotatedText: So let us be <u>builders</u> of bridges, not walls. Let us be <u>gardeners</u> of hope, not <u>sowers</u> of fear.
extension.translation: 所以让我们成为桥梁的建设者，而非高墙的堆砌者。让我们成为希望的园丁，而非恐惧的播种者。

extension.text: And remember: peace begins with each one of us, right here, right now.
extension.annotatedText: And remember: peace begins with each <u>one</u> of us, right <u>here</u>, right <u>now</u>.
extension.translation: 请记住：和平始于我们每一个人，就在此时，就在此地。

practice.text: Peace is not the absence of conflict, but the ability to handle it with grace.
practice.annotatedText: Peace is not the <u>absence</u> of conflict, but the <u>ability</u> to handle it with <u>grace</u>.
practice.translation: 和平不是没有冲突，而是有能力优雅地处理冲突。

practice.text: True peace requires courage to face uncomfortable truths.
practice.annotatedText: True peace requires <u>courage</u> to face uncomfortable <u>truths</u>.
practice.translation: 真正的和平需要勇气去面对不舒服的真相。

practice.text: We must listen to those who suffer, even when their words are hard to hear.
practice.annotatedText: We must <u>listen</u> to those who <u>suffer</u>, even when their words are hard to <u>hear</u>.
practice.translation: 我们必须倾听那些受苦的人，即使他们的话很难听进去。

practice.text: In the end, peace is a choice — a choice to see our common humanity.
practice.annotatedText: In the end, peace is a <u>choice</u> — a choice to see our <u>common</u> <u>humanity</u>.
practice.translation: 归根结底，和平是一种选择——选择看到我们共同的人性。

practice.text: Every act of kindness plants a seed of peace.
practice.annotatedText: Every act of <u>kindness</u> plants a <u>seed</u> of <u>peace</u>.
practice.translation: 每一个善举都种下一颗和平的种子。

practice.text: We can disagree without being disagreeable.
practice.annotatedText: We can <u>disagree</u> without being <u>disagreeable</u>.
practice.translation: 我们可以不同意而不令人讨厌。

practice.text: Building peace is like tending a garden; it takes patience, care, and constant effort.
practice.annotatedText: Building peace is like <u>tending</u> a garden; it takes <u>patience</u>, care, and <u>constant</u> effort.
practice.translation: 建设和平就像照料花园；需要耐心、关心和持续的努力。

practice.text: Let us not wait for leaders to bring peace; let us be the peace we wish to see.
practice.annotatedText: Let us not wait for <u>leaders</u> to bring peace; let us be the <u>peace</u> we <u>wish</u> to see.
practice.translation: 我们不要等待领导人带来和平；让我们成为我们希望看到的和平。

extension.text: Don't be afraid to take the road less traveled.
extension.annotatedText: Don't be a<u>fraid</u> to take the road <u>less</u> trav<u>eled</u>.
extension.translation: 不要害怕走少有人走的路。

extension.text: It's okay to stumble and fall — that's how you learn to stand up stronger.
extension.annotatedText: It's o<u>kay</u> to stumble and <u>fall</u> — that's how you learn to stand up <u>strong</u>er.
extension.translation: 跌倒也没关系——那是你学会更坚强站起来的方式。

extension.text: Your dreams might seem big, but you're bigger than any dream.
extension.annotatedText: Your dreams might seem <u>big</u>, but you're <u>big</u>ger than any <u>dream</u>.
extension.translation: 你的梦想可能看起来很大，但你比任何梦想都大。

extension.text: Keep the friendships you've made here — they'll be your anchor in stormy seas.
extension.annotatedText: Keep the <u>friend</u>ships you've made here — they'll be your <u>an</u>chor in <u>storm</u>y seas.
extension.translation: 珍惜在这里建立的友谊——它们将成为你风浪中的锚。

extension.text: And when you feel lost, remember this moment: the feeling of starting fresh.
extension.annotatedText: And when you feel <u>lost</u>, remember this <u>mo</u>ment: the feeling of <u>start</u>ing fresh.
extension.translation: 当你感到迷茫时，记住这一刻：重新开始的感觉。

extension.text: Graduation isn't an ending — it's a beginning with infinite possibilities.
extension.annotatedText: Gradu<u>a</u>tion isn't an <u>end</u>ing — it's a be<u>gin</u>ning with infinite possi<u>bili</u>ties.
extension.translation: 毕业不是终点——而是充满无限可能的起点。

practice.text: Class of 2024, you're ready for whatever comes next.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Class</u> of <u>2024</u>, you're <u>read</u>y for whatever comes <u>next</u>.
practice.translation: 2024届的同学们，你们已经为接下来的一切做好了准备。

practice.text: Some of you will travel the world, others will stay close to home.
practice.annotatedText: Some of you will <u>trav</u>el the world, <u>oth</u>ers will stay close to <u>home</u>.
practice.translation: 你们中有人会周游世界，有人会留在离家近的地方。

practice.text: Every single one of you has something unique to offer.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>sin</u>gle one of you has something u<u>nique</u> to <u>of</u>fer.
practice.translation: 你们每一个人都有独特的东西可以贡献。

practice.text: Don't let fear of failure stop you from trying.
practice.annotatedText: Don't let <u>fear</u> of <u>fail</u>ure stop you from <u>try</u>ing.
practice.translation: 不要让对失败的恐惧阻止你尝试。

practice.text: The world needs your passion, your ideas, your courage.
practice.annotatedText: The world needs your <u>pas</u>sion, your i<u>deas</u>, your <u>cour</u>age.
practice.translation: 世界需要你们的热情、你们的想法、你们的勇气。

practice.text: Go out there and make mistakes — that's how you grow.
practice.annotatedText: Go out <u>there</u> and make mis<u>takes</u> — that's how you <u>grow</u>.
practice.translation: 走出去，犯错——那就是你成长的方式。

practice.text: Your story is just beginning; write it boldly.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>sto</u>ry is just be<u>gin</u>ning; write it <u>bold</u>ly.
practice.translation: 你的故事才刚刚开始；大胆地书写它。

practice.text: Congratulations, graduates — now go build your future.
practice.annotatedText: Congratu<u>la</u>tions, <u>grad</u>uates — now go <u>build</u> your <u>fu</u>ture.
practice.translation: 恭喜你们，毕业生们——现在去创造你们的未来吧。

extension.text: We're not just engineers anymore; we're architects of society's future.
extension.annotatedText: We're not just <u>en</u>gineers anymore; we're <u>ar</u>chitects of society's <u>fu</u>ture.
extension.translation: 我们不只是工程师了；我们是社会未来的建筑师。

extension.text: The choices we make today will echo for generations, shaping how people live, love, and work.
extension.annotatedText: The choices we make to<u>day</u> will <u>e</u>cho for generations, shaping how people <u>live</u>, love, and work.
extension.translation: 我们今天的选择会在未来几代人中回响，塑造人们如何生活、相爱和工作。

extension.text: Think about facial recognition: it can find missing kids, but it can also invade privacy on a massive scale.
extension.annotatedText: Think about <u>fa</u>cial recognition: it can find <u>miss</u>ing kids, but it can also invade <u>pri</u>vacy on a massive scale.
extension.translation: 想想人脸识别：它能找到失踪儿童，但也能大规模侵犯隐私。

extension.text: We need to embed ethics into our design process from the very start, not as an afterthought.
extension.annotatedText: We need to embed <u>e</u>thics into our design process from the very <u>start</u>, not as an <u>af</u>terthought.
extension.translation: 我们需要从一开始就把伦理嵌入设计流程，而不是事后才想。

extension.text: It's about asking tough questions when nobody's watching — that's where true integrity lives.
extension.annotatedText: It's about asking <u>tough</u> questions when nobody's <u>watch</u>ing — that's where true <u>in</u>tegrity lives.
extension.translation: 这关乎在没人在看时问出尖锐的问题——这才是真正的诚信所在。

practice.text: Autonomous vehicles must balance safety with the reality of unavoidable accidents.
practice.annotatedText: Autonomous vehicles must <u>bal</u>ance <u>safe</u>ty with the reality of unavoidable <u>ac</u>cidents.
practice.translation: 自动驾驶汽车必须在安全与无法避免的事故之间取得平衡。

practice.text: Algorithms that decide who gets a loan can perpetuate systemic bias if we're not careful.
practice.annotatedText: Algorithms that decide who gets a <u>loan</u> can perpetuate <u>sys</u>temic bias if we're not <u>care</u>ful.
practice.translation: 决定谁能贷款的算法如果不小心，可能会延续系统性偏见。

practice.text: Deepfakes aren't just funny memes; they threaten our trust in video evidence.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Deep</u>fakes aren't just <u>fun</u>ny memes; they threaten our trust in <u>vid</u>eo evidence.
practice.translation: 深度伪造不只是搞笑表情包；它们威胁我们对视频证据的信任。

practice.text: Data privacy isn't about hiding things — it's about who gets to see your life.
practice.annotatedText: Data <u>pri</u>vacy isn't about <u>hid</u>ing things — it's about who gets to see your <u>life</u>.
practice.translation: 数据隐私不是要隐藏什么——而是谁有权看到你的生活。

practice.text: We must ensure AI doesn't widen the gap between the rich and the poor.
practice.annotatedText: We must en<u>sure</u> AI doesn't <u>wid</u>en the gap between the rich and the <u>poor</u>.
practice.translation: 我们必须确保人工智能不会扩大贫富差距。

practice.text: What happens when your smart speaker records a private conversation by mistake?
practice.annotatedText: What <u>hap</u>pens when your smart <u>speak</u>er records a private conversation by mis<u>take</u>?
practice.translation: 当你的智能音箱不小心录下了私人对话会怎样？

practice.text: The next time you develop an app, ask: who could be harmed by this?
practice.annotatedText: The next time you de<u>vel</u>op an <u>app</u>, ask: who could be <u>harmed</u> by this?
practice.translation: 下次你开发应用时，问问：谁可能会因此受到伤害？

practice.text: Ethical tech isn't a luxury; it's a necessity for a just and sustainable future.
practice.annotatedText: Ethical tech isn't a <u>lux</u>ury; it's a necessity for a <u>just</u> and sustainable <u>fu</u>ture.
practice.translation: 合乎伦理的科技不是奢侈品；它是公正可持续未来的必需品。

extension.text: Every time I stumble, I ask myself: what can I learn from this?
extension.annotatedText: Every time I <u>stum</u>ble, I ask myself: what can I <u>learn</u> from this?
extension.translation: 每次跌倒，我都会问自己：我能从中学到什么？

extension.text: It's not about avoiding failure, but about how you respond to it.
extension.annotatedText: It's not about a<u>void</u>ing failure, but about how you <u>re</u>spond to it.
extension.translation: 重点不是避免失败，而是你如何回应它。

extension.text: I've learned that the most successful people have the most failures.
extension.annotatedText: I've <u>learned</u> that the most <u>suc</u>cessful people have the most <u>fail</u>ures.
extension.translation: 我明白了最成功的人失败次数最多。

extension.text: They just don't let those failures define them.
extension.annotatedText: They just <u>don't</u> let those failures de<u>fine</u> them.
extension.translation: 他们只是不让那些失败定义自己。

extension.text: So the next time you fail, don't hide from it—embrace it.
extension.annotatedText: So the <u>next time</u> you fail, don't <u>hide</u> from it—em<u>brace</u> it.
extension.translation: 所以下次你失败时，不要逃避——拥抱它。

extension.text: Failure is just a stepping stone on the path to greatness.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Fail</u>ure is just a <u>step</u>ping stone on the path to <u>great</u>ness.
extension.translation: 失败只是通往伟大的垫脚石。

extension.text: And remember: the only true failure is the failure to try.
extension.annotatedText: And re<u>mem</u>ber: the only <u>true</u> failure is the failure to <u>try</u>.
extension.translation: 记住：唯一的失败是不去尝试。

practice.text: I've failed so many times, but each one taught me something valuable.
practice.annotatedText: I've <u>failed</u> so many times, but each one <u>taught</u> me something <u>valu</u>able.
practice.translation: 我失败了很多次，但每一次都教会了我宝贵的东西。

practice.text: Don't be afraid to fail; be afraid of not learning from it.
practice.annotatedText: Don't be a<u>fraid</u> to fail; be a<u>fraid</u> of not <u>learn</u>ing from it.
practice.translation: 不要害怕失败；要害怕不从中学习。

practice.text: My biggest failures led to my biggest breakthroughs.
practice.annotatedText: My <u>big</u>gest failures led to my <u>big</u>gest <u>break</u>throughs.
practice.translation: 我最大的失败带来了最大的突破。

practice.text: Let's redefine failure as feedback, not final judgment.
practice.annotatedText: Let's re<u>define</u> failure as <u>feed</u>back, not <u>fi</u>nal judgment.
practice.translation: 让我们把失败重新定义为反馈，而不是最终判决。

practice.text: If you haven't failed recently, you're probably not pushing hard enough.
practice.annotatedText: If you <u>haven't</u> failed recently, you're <u>prob</u>ably not <u>push</u>ing hard enough.
practice.translation: 如果你最近没失败过，那你可能不够努力。

practice.text: Every failure is a chance to grow stronger and wiser.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>fail</u>ure is a chance to grow <u>strong</u>er and <u>wis</u>er.
practice.translation: 每次失败都是变得更强大、更聪明的机会。

practice.text: Stop calling yourself a failure just because you failed at something.
practice.annotatedText: Stop <u>call</u>ing yourself a <u>fail</u>ure just because you <u>failed</u> at something.
practice.translation: 别因为某件事失败了就称自己为失败者。

practice.text: The moment you give up is the moment you truly fail.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>mo</u>ment you give <u>up</u> is the moment you <u>tru</u>ly fail.
practice.translation: 放弃的那一刻才是真正的失败。

extension.text: She taught me that patience is the secret to a beautiful garden.
extension.annotatedText: She <u>taught</u> me that <u>patience</u> is the secret to a beautiful garden.
extension.translation: 她教会我耐心是美丽花园的秘诀。

extension.text: Every time I dig in the dirt, I feel closer to her.
extension.annotatedText: Every time I <u>dig</u> in the dirt, I feel <u>closer</u> to her.
extension.translation: 每次我在泥土里挖土，我都感觉离她更近了。

extension.text: She visits every spring and brings new seeds from her garden.
extension.annotatedText: She <u>visits</u> every spring and brings <u>new seeds</u> from her garden.
extension.translation: 每年春天她都来看我，从她的花园带来新种子。

extension.text: We laugh together when my daughter tries to water the roses with her toy watering can.
extension.annotatedText: We <u>laugh</u> together when my daughter tries to water the roses with her toy watering can.
extension.translation: 当女儿用她的玩具洒水壶浇玫瑰时，我们一起笑了。

extension.text: My mother says the garden is never finished, just like love.
extension.annotatedText: My mother says the garden is <u>never finished</u>, just like love.
extension.translation: 我妈妈说花园永远没有完工的时候，就像爱一样。

practice.text: My mother's garden was her sanctuary.

practice.text: She sent me a cutting from her favorite rose bush.

extension.text: I never even got her name, but I think about her every time it rains.

extension.text: Sometimes I wonder where that umbrella is right now.

extension.text: I've passed it on three times myself, and each time I tell the same story.

extension.text: They all promise to keep it going, and I believe them.

practice.text: Kindness travels farther than any of us can see.

extension.text: After he died, the regulars insisted that his ghost still wandered the aisles at closing time.

extension.text: He'd say, 'A flower doesn't compete with the one next to it; it just blooms.'
