extension.text: So let's stop arguing about whether climate change is real. Let's start building the future.
extension.annotatedText: So let's <u>stop</u> arguing about whether <u>cli</u>mate change is <u>real</u>. Let's <u>start</u> <u>build</u>ing the <u>fu</u>ture.
extension.translation: 所以，别再争论气候变化是不是真的了。让我们开始建设未来吧。

practice.text: The stone age didn't end because we ran out of stones.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>stone</u> age <u>didn't</u> end because we <u>ran</u> out of stones.
practice.translation: 石器时代不是因为没有石头而结束的。

practice.text: The oil age will end when we find something better.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>oil</u> age will <u>end</u> when we find something <u>bet</u>ter.
practice.translation: 石油时代会在我们找到更好的东西时结束。

practice.text: We have found something better — clean, renewable, infinite energy.
practice.annotatedText: We have <u>found</u> something <u>bet</u>ter — <u>clean</u>, re<u>new</u>able, <u>in</u>finite <u>en</u>ergy.
practice.translation: 我们已经找到了更好的东西——清洁、可再生、无穷无尽的能源。

practice.text: The transition to green energy is the greatest economic opportunity of our lifetime.
practice.annotatedText: The transi<u>tion</u> to <u>green</u> <u>en</u>ergy is the <u>great</u>est <u>econ</u>omic oppor<u>tunity</u> of our lifetime.
practice.translation: 向绿色能源的转型是我们一生中最大的经济机遇。

practice.text: Solar and wind are cheaper than coal and gas now.
practice.annotatedText: <u>So</u>lar and <u>wind</u> are <u>chea</u>per than <u>coal</u> and <u>gas</u> now.
practice.translation: 太阳能和风能现在比煤和天然气便宜。

practice.text: Every solar panel and wind turbine creates local jobs.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Eve</u>ry <u>so</u>lar panel and <u>wind</u> turbine cre<u>ates</u> <u>lo</u>cal <u>jobs</u>.
practice.translation: 每一块太阳能板和每一台风力涡轮机都创造本地就业。

practice.text: We're revolutionizing transportation, heating, and manufacturing.
practice.annotatedText: We're <u>rev</u>olutionizing <u>trans</u>portation, <u>heat</u>ing, and manu<u>fac</u>turing.
practice.translation: 我们正在彻底改变交通、供暖和制造业。

practice.text: Let's stop arguing and start building the future.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>stop</u> arguing and <u>start</u> <u>build</u>ing the <u>fu</u>ture.
practice.translation: 别再争论了，开始建设未来吧。

extension.text: Let's keep building this dream together.
extension.annotatedText: Let's keep <u>build</u>ing this <u>dream</u> together.
extension.translation: 让我们一起继续构筑这个梦想。

extension.text: I've seen each of you go above and beyond this year.
extension.annotatedText: I've seen each of you go a<u>bove</u> and <u>be</u>yond this year.
extension.translation: 今年我看到了你们每个人都超越了自我。

extension.text: We've faced challenges, but you never backed down.
extension.annotatedText: We've faced <u>chal</u>lenges, but you never <u>backed</u> down.
extension.translation: 我们面临过挑战，但你们从未退缩。

extension.text: Our growth is a testament to your hard work and dedication.
extension.annotatedText: Our growth is a <u>tes</u>tament to your hard work and <u>dedi</u>cation.
extension.translation: 我们的成长证明了你们的辛勤工作和奉献。

extension.text: I want you to know that your efforts are seen and valued.
extension.annotatedText: I want you to know that your <u>ef</u>forts are seen and <u>val</u>ued.
extension.translation: 我想让你们知道，你们的努力被看在眼里，受到重视。

extension.text: This coming year we'll take even bigger risks and reach even higher.
extension.annotatedText: This coming year we'll take even <u>big</u>ger risks and reach even <u>high</u>er.
extension.translation: 来年，我们将冒更大的风险，达到更高的目标。

extension.text: I'm excited to see what we can achieve together.
extension.annotatedText: I'm ex<u>cit</u>ed to see what we can a<u>chieve</u> together.
extension.translation: 我很期待看到我们能一起取得什么成就。

practice.text: We didn't just build a company; we built a family.
practice.annotatedText: We didn't just <u>build</u> a company; we built a <u>fam</u>ily.
practice.translation: 我们不仅建立了一家公司，还建立了一个家庭。

practice.text: Every late night and early morning was worth it.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>late</u> night and <u>ear</u>ly morning was worth it.
practice.translation: 每一个深夜和清晨都值得。

practice.text: Our customers trust us because you deliver excellence.
practice.annotatedText: Our customers <u>trust</u> us because you de<u>liv</u>er excellence.
practice.translation: 客户信任我们，是因为你们提供了卓越的服务。

practice.text: Innovation comes from every corner of this office.
practice.annotatedText: Innovation comes from <u>ev</u>ery <u>cor</u>ner of this office.
practice.translation: 创新来自这个办公室的每个角落。

practice.text: Your passion fuels our progress.
practice.annotatedText: Your <u>pas</u>sion fuels our <u>prog</u>ress.
practice.translation: 你们的热情推动着我们的进步。

practice.text: Let's celebrate our wins, big and small.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>cel</u>ebrate our wins, <u>big</u> and small.
practice.translation: 让我们庆祝我们的胜利，无论大小。

practice.text: I'm proud of every single one of you.
practice.annotatedText: I'm <u>proud</u> of <u>ev</u>ery single one of you.
practice.translation: 我为你们每一个人感到骄傲。

practice.text: The best is yet to come.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>best</u> is yet to <u>come</u>.
practice.translation: 最好的还在后面。

extension.text: We need to stop treating all students the same and start celebrating their differences.
extension.annotatedText: We need to <u>stop</u> treating all students the <u>same</u> and start <u>celebrating</u> their differences.
extension.translation: 我们得停止用同样的方式对待所有学生，开始去欣赏他们的不同。

extension.text: Imagine a classroom where children learn at their own pace and follow their passions.
extension.annotatedText: Imagine a <u>classroom</u> where children learn at their own <u>pace</u> and follow their <u>passions</u>.
extension.translation: 想象一下，孩子能按自己的节奏学习、追随自己热情的课堂。

extension.text: That's the kind of education that produces innovators, not just test-takers.
extension.annotatedText: That's the <u>kind</u> of education that produces <u>innovators</u>, not just test-<u>takers</u>.
extension.translation: 那种教育才能培养出创新者，而不只是会考试的人。

extension.text: We have to ask ourselves: are we really preparing our kids for the future?
extension.annotatedText: We have to ask <u>ourselves</u>: are we really <u>preparing</u> our kids for the <u>future</u>?
extension.translation: 我们得问问自己：我们真的在为孩子的未来做准备吗？

extension.text: The world is changing fast, but our schools are stuck in the past.
extension.annotatedText: The world is changing <u>fast</u>, but our schools are <u>stuck</u> in the past.
extension.translation: 世界变化飞快，可我们的学校还停留在过去。

extension.text: Let's give children the tools to think critically and solve real problems.
extension.annotatedText: Let's give children the <u>tools</u> to think <u>critically</u> and solve <u>real</u> problems.
extension.translation: 让我们给孩子工具，让他们能批判思考、解决真正的问题。

extension.text: Because when we nurture each child's unique talents, everyone benefits.
extension.annotatedText: Because when we <u>nurture</u> each child's <u>unique</u> talents, <u>everyone</u> benefits.
extension.translation: 因为当我们培养每个孩子的独特天赋时，所有人都能受益。

practice.text: A one-size-fits-all education doesn't work for anyone.
practice.annotatedText: A one-size-<u>fits</u>-all education doesn't <u>work</u> for anyone.
practice.translation: 一刀切的教育对谁都没用。

practice.text: We must move away from standardized testing and toward personalized learning.
practice.annotatedText: We must <u>move</u> away from <u>standardized</u> testing and toward <u>personalized</u> learning.
practice.translation: 我们必须摆脱标准化考试，走向个性化学习。

practice.text: Creativity is just as important as literacy in the modern world.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Creativity</u> is just as important as <u>literacy</u> in the modern world.
practice.translation: 在当今世界，创造力和读写能力同样重要。

practice.text: Students should be encouraged to explore subjects that excite them.
practice.annotatedText: Students should be <u>encouraged</u> to explore subjects that <u>excite</u> them.
practice.translation: 应该鼓励学生去探索让他们兴奋的科目。

practice.text: The current system kills curiosity and rewards conformity.
practice.annotatedText: The current system <u>kills</u> curiosity and rewards <u>conformity</u>.
practice.translation: 现行体制扼杀好奇心，奖励顺从。

practice.text: We need teachers who act as guides, not just lecturers.
practice.annotatedText: We need teachers who act as <u>guides</u>, not just <u>lecturers</u>.
practice.translation: 我们需要的是做引导者的老师，而不仅仅是讲台上的讲师。

practice.text: Let's redesign schools to be places of discovery and joy.
practice.annotatedText: Let's <u>redesign</u> schools to be places of <u>discovery</u> and <u>joy</u>.
practice.translation: 让我们重新设计学校，让它成为发现和快乐的地方。

practice.text: Every child deserves an education that lets them shine.
practice.annotatedText: Every child <u>deserves</u> an education that lets them <u>shine</u>.
practice.translation: 每个孩子都值得接受能让他们闪闪发光的教育。

extension.text: And the beauty of it is that anyone can do it.
extension.annotatedText: And the <u>beau</u>ty of it is that <u>a</u>nyone can do it.
extension.translation: 而且它的美妙之处在于任何人都能做到。

extension.text: You don't need any special skills or a lot of time.
extension.annotatedText: You don't need <u>a</u>ny special skills or a <u>lot</u> of time.
extension.translation: 你不需要任何特殊技能或很多时间。

extension.text: It's just about shifting your focus from what's missing to what's present.
extension.annotatedText: It's just about <u>shif</u>ting your focus from what's <u>mis</u>sing to what's <u>pre</u>sent.
extension.translation: 就是把你关注点从缺少的东西转移到拥有的东西上。

extension.text: I've seen it work with people who were going through really tough times.
extension.annotatedText: I've seen it work with people who were going through <u>rea</u>lly tough times.
extension.translation: 我见过那些正经历艰难时期的人通过这个改变了。

extension.text: Gratitude doesn't ignore problems; it just helps us see the bigger picture.
extension.annotatedText: Gratitude doesn't ig<u>nore</u> problems; it just helps us see the <u>big</u>ger picture.
extension.translation: 感恩不是忽视问题，而是帮我们看到更广阔的画面。

extension.text: So start small, be consistent, and watch your happiness grow.
extension.annotatedText: So start <u>small</u>, be con<u>sis</u>tent, and watch your <u>hap</u>piness grow.
extension.translation: 所以从小处开始，坚持做，看着你的幸福增长。

practice.text: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
practice.annotatedText: Gra<u>ti</u>tude turns what we have into e<u>nough</u>.
practice.translation: 感恩能让我们拥有的变成足够。

practice.text: It is the simplest and most powerful happiness habit.
practice.annotatedText: It is the <u>sim</u>plest and most <u>pow</u>erful <u>hap</u>piness habit.
practice.translation: 它是最简单也最强大的幸福习惯。

practice.text: Every morning I write down three things I'm grateful for.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Eve</u>ry <u>mor</u>ning I write down three things I'm <u>gra</u>teful for.
practice.translation: 每天早上我写下三件让我感恩的事。

practice.text: It takes two minutes and changes everything.
practice.annotatedText: It takes <u>two</u> minutes and <u>chan</u>ges everything.
practice.translation: 只需两分钟却能改变一切。

practice.text: Try it for a week and watch your entire outlook on life transform.
practice.annotatedText: Try it for a <u>week</u> and watch your entire <u>out</u>look on life trans<u>form</u>.
practice.translation: 试一个星期你会看到你对生活的整个观点都会改变。

practice.text: And the beauty of it is that anyone can do it.
practice.annotatedText: And the <u>beau</u>ty of it is that <u>a</u>nyone can do it.
practice.translation: 而且它的美妙之处在于任何人都能做到。

practice.text: It's just about shifting your focus from what's missing to what's present.
practice.annotatedText: It's just about <u>shif</u>ting your focus from what's <u>mis</u>sing to what's <u>pre</u>sent.
practice.translation: 就是把你关注点从缺少的东西转移到拥有的东西上。

practice.text: So start small, be consistent, and watch your happiness grow.
practice.annotatedText: So start <u>small</u>, be con<u>sis</u>tent, and watch your <u>hap</u>piness grow.
practice.translation: 所以从小处开始，坚持做，看着你的幸福增长。

extension.text: Years later, he took his own son to fly a kite on a windy day.
extension.annotatedText: Years <u>later</u>, he took his <u>own</u> son to fly a kite on a <u>windy</u> day.
extension.translation: 多年以后，他带着自己的儿子在一个刮风的日子去放风筝。

extension.text: The boy's kite flew high, and the father smiled, remembering his grandpa.
extension.annotatedText: The boy's kite flew <u>high</u>, and the father <u>smiled</u>, remembering his grandpa.
extension.translation: 男孩的风筝飞得很高，父亲笑了，想起了他的祖父。

extension.text: Suddenly, the string snapped again, and the kite drifted away.
extension.annotatedText: Suddenly, the string <u>snapped</u> again, and the kite <u>drifted</u> away.
extension.translation: 突然，线又断了，风筝飘走了。

extension.text: The little boy began to cry, just like his father had done long ago.
extension.annotatedText: The little boy began to <u>cry</u>, just like his father had done <u>long</u> ago.
extension.translation: 小男孩哭了起来，就像他父亲很久以前那样。

extension.text: The father knelt down and said, 'Don't worry, son. That kite is free now.'
extension.annotatedText: The father <u>knelt</u> down and said, 'Don't <u>worry</u>, son. That kite is <u>free</u> now.'
extension.translation: 父亲蹲下来说：“别担心，儿子。那只风筝现在自由了。”

extension.text: He pointed to the sky. 'See how it dances? Someone will find it and be happy.'
extension.annotatedText: He pointed to the sky. 'See how it <u>dances</u>? Someone will find it and be <u>happy</u>.'
extension.translation: 他指着天空说：“看它跳得多欢？会有人找到它，并感到开心。”

extension.text: The boy wiped his tears and watched the kite become a tiny dot in the blue.
extension.annotatedText: The boy wiped his <u>tears</u> and watched the kite become a <u>tiny</u> dot in the <u>blue</u>.
extension.translation: 男孩擦干眼泪，看着风筝变成蓝天中的一个小点。

extension.text: That evening, the father told his son the story of his own grandpa and the kite.
extension.annotatedText: That <u>evening</u>, the father told his son the story of his own <u>grandpa</u> and the kite.
extension.translation: 那天晚上，父亲给儿子讲了他自己的祖父和风筝的故事。

practice.text: The kite soared into the clouds and disappeared.
practice.annotatedText: The kite <u>soared</u> into the clouds and <u>disap</u>peared.
practice.translation: 风筝飞入云层，消失了。

practice.text: He didn't cry when the string broke because he remembered what his dad said.
practice.annotatedText: He didn't <u>cry</u> when the string <u>broke</u> because he remembered what his dad said.
practice.translation: 线断了他没哭，因为他记得爸爸说的话。

practice.text: Letting go is hard, but sometimes it's the kindest thing to do.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Letting</u> go is <u>hard</u>, but sometimes it's the <u>kindest</u> thing to do.
practice.translation: 放手很难，但有时这是最善良的做法。

practice.text: The wind carried the kite far away, over the hills and trees.
practice.annotatedText: The wind <u>carried</u> the kite far a<u>way</u>, over the hills and trees.
practice.translation: 风把风筝吹到很远的地方，越过山丘和树林。

practice.text: He looked up and saw the kite dancing in the sky.
practice.annotatedText: He looked <u>up</u> and saw the kite <u>dancing</u> in the sky.
practice.translation: 他抬头看到风筝在空中跳舞。

practice.text: That spring afternoon taught him a lesson he never forgot.
practice.annotatedText: That <u>spring</u> afternoon taught him a <u>lesson</u> he never forgot.
practice.translation: 那个春天的下午给他上了一课，他从未忘记。

practice.text: Sometimes the most beautiful gift is setting something free.
practice.annotatedText: Sometimes the most <u>beautiful</u> gift is <u>setting</u> something free.
practice.translation: 有时候最美的礼物就是让某样东西自由。

practice.text: He smiled as the kite became a tiny speck in the vast blue sky.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>smiled</u> as the kite became a <u>tiny</u> speck in the vast <u>blue</u> sky.
practice.translation: 他微笑着，看着风筝在广阔的蓝天中变成一个小点。

extension.text: She found that the clack of the keys was like a heartbeat, steady and real.
extension.annotatedText: She found that the <u>clack</u> of the keys was like a <u>heart</u>beat, steady and real.
extension.translation: 她发现按键的咔嗒声就像心跳，平稳又真实。

extension.text: Her grandmother cried when she got a letter because it had been years since anyone wrote to her.
extension.annotatedText: Her <u>grand</u>mother cried when she got a letter because it had been <u>years</u> since anyone wrote to her.
extension.translation: 她奶奶收到信时哭了，因为已经好多年没人给她写过信了。

extension.text: Soon, the young woman started a letter-writing club at the local library.
extension.annotatedText: Soon, the young woman started a <u>let</u>ter-writing club at the local <u>li</u>brary.
extension.translation: 很快，这个年轻女子在当地图书馆办了个写信俱乐部。

extension.text: People of all ages came, bringing their own stories and slow hands.
extension.annotatedText: People of <u>all</u> ages came, bringing their own <u>stor</u>ies and slow hands.
extension.translation: 各个年龄段的人都来了，带着自己的故事和慢悠悠的手。

extension.text: One man said he hadn't written a letter since 1998, but he remembered every word.
extension.annotatedText: One man said he <u>hadn't</u> written a letter since <u>nine</u>teen <u>nine</u>ty-eight, but he remembered every word.
extension.translation: 一个男人说他从1998年就没写过信了，但他每个字都记得。

extension.text: The typewriter became a symbol of patience in a city that never stopped.
extension.annotatedText: The typewriter became a <u>sym</u>bol of <u>pa</u>tience in a city that never stopped.
extension.translation: 这台打字机成了这座永不停歇的城市里耐心的象征。

practice.text: The typewriter keys were sticky, but she loved them anyway.
practice.annotatedText: The typewriter keys were <u>stick</u>y, but she loved them <u>any</u>way.
practice.translation: 打字机的键有点黏，但她还是喜欢。

practice.text: She typed each letter slowly, feeling every word.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>typed</u> each letter <u>slow</u>ly, feeling every word.
practice.translation: 她慢慢地打每一封信，感受每一个字。

practice.text: Her friends thought she was crazy until they got their first letter.
practice.annotatedText: Her friends thought she was <u>cra</u>zy until they got their <u>first</u> letter.
practice.translation: 她的朋友们觉得她疯了，直到收到第一封信。

practice.text: A handwritten letter is a piece of someone's heart on paper.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>hand</u>written letter is a piece of someone's <u>heart</u> on paper.
practice.translation: 手写信是某人留在纸上的心。

practice.text: In a world of emojis, a typed letter says more.
practice.annotatedText: In a world of <u>e</u>mojis, a <u>typed</u> letter says more.
practice.translation: 在表情符号的世界里，一封打出来的信说得更多。

practice.text: She spent an hour on each letter, choosing every word with care.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>spent</u> an hour on each letter, <u>choos</u>ing every word with care.
practice.translation: 她每封信都要花一个小时，用心挑选每个词。

practice.text: The sound of the typewriter filled the room like music.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>sound</u> of the typewriter filled the room like <u>mu</u>sic.
practice.translation: 打字机的声音像音乐一样充满了房间。

practice.text: Slowing down to write a letter is a gift to yourself and to others.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Slow</u>ing down to write a letter is a <u>gift</u> to yourself and to <u>oth</u>ers.
practice.translation: 慢下来写一封信，是给自己和别人的礼物。

extension.text: But the memory of the fireflies stayed with her forever.
extension.annotatedText: But the memory of the fireflies <u>stayed</u> with her <u>forever</u>.
extension.translation: 但萤火虫的记忆永远留在了她心里。

extension.text: Whenever she felt scared, she'd close her eyes and picture that glowing field.
extension.annotatedText: Whenever she felt <u>scared</u>, she'd close her eyes and picture that <u>glowing</u> field.
extension.translation: 每当她感到害怕，就闭上眼睛想象那片发光的田野。

extension.text: It reminded her that darkness isn't empty — it's full of hidden light.
extension.annotatedText: It reminded her that darkness <u>isn't</u> empty — it's full of <u>hidden</u> light.
extension.translation: 这提醒她黑暗并非空无一物——而是充满了隐藏的光。

extension.text: Years later, she became a scientist studying bioluminescence.
extension.annotatedText: Years later, she became a <u>scientist</u> studying <u>bioluminescence</u>.
extension.translation: 多年后，她成了一名研究生物发光的科学家。

extension.text: She wanted to understand how fireflies make their magic light.
extension.annotatedText: She <u>wanted</u> to understand how fireflies make their <u>magic</u> light.
extension.translation: 她想弄懂萤火虫如何制造出那种神奇的光。

extension.text: And every summer, she visited her father in the same field.
extension.annotatedText: And <u>every</u> summer, she visited her father in the <u>same</u> field.
extension.translation: 而且每年夏天，她都会和父亲去同一片田野。

extension.text: They'd sit together, watching the fireflies dance, and she'd thank him for that lesson.
extension.annotatedText: They'd sit together, watching the fireflies <u>dance</u>, and she'd <u>thank</u> him for that lesson.
extension.translation: 他们坐在一起看萤火虫飞舞，她感谢父亲教给她的那一课。

practice.text: A little girl was afraid of the dark.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>little</u> girl was afraid of the <u>dark</u>.
practice.translation: 一个小女孩怕黑。

practice.text: Every night she begged her father to leave the light on.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Every</u> night she <u>begged</u> her father to leave the light on.
practice.translation: 每晚她都求爸爸把灯开着。

practice.text: The whole field sparkled with fireflies.
practice.annotatedText: The whole field <u>sparkled</u> with fireflies.
practice.translation: 整片田野闪烁着萤火虫的光芒。

practice.text: Some lights only shine in the dark.
practice.annotatedText: Some lights <u>only</u> shine in the <u>dark</u>.
practice.translation: 有些光只在黑暗中闪烁。

practice.text: You just have to be brave enough to look for them.
practice.annotatedText: You just have to be <u>brave</u> enough to <u>look</u> for them.
practice.translation: 你只需要有足够的勇气去寻找它们。

practice.text: She never asked for the light to be left on again.
practice.annotatedText: She <u>never</u> asked for the light to be left on a<u>gain</u>.
practice.translation: 她此后再也没要求过开灯。

practice.text: Darkness isn't empty — it's full of hidden light.
practice.annotatedText: Darkness <u>isn't</u> empty — it's full of <u>hidden</u> light.
practice.translation: 黑暗并非空无一物——而是充满了隐藏的光。

practice.text: She became a scientist studying bioluminescence.
practice.annotatedText: She became a <u>scientist</u> studying <u>bioluminescence</u>.
practice.translation: 她成了一名研究生物发光的科学家。

extension.text: Every step we take into the unknown is a testament to our courage and curiosity.
extension.annotatedText: Every <u>step</u> we take into the un<u>known</u> is a <u>testament</u> to our courage and curiosity.
extension.translation: 我们迈向未知的每一步都是勇气和好奇心的证明。

extension.text: We're not just exploring space; we're discovering who we are and what we're capable of.
extension.annotatedText: We're not just <u>exploring</u> space; we're <u>discovering</u> who we are and what we're <u>capable</u> of.
extension.translation: 我们不仅仅在探索太空；我们在发现我们是谁以及我们能做什么。

extension.text: Sure, it's risky and expensive, but the rewards — knowledge, inspiration, survival — are priceless.
extension.annotatedText: Sure, it's <u>risky</u> and <u>expensive</u>, but the rewards — <u>knowledge</u>, inspiration, survival — are priceless.
extension.translation: 当然，这有风险而且昂贵，但回报——知识、灵感、生存——是无价的。

extension.text: When we look up at the stars, we see not just lights but possibilities.
extension.annotatedText: When we look <u>up</u> at the stars, we see not just lights but <u>possibilities</u>.
extension.translation: 当我们仰望星空时，我们看到的不仅是光点，还有可能性。

extension.text: History shows that the nations who explore lead the world.
extension.annotatedText: <u>History</u> shows that the nations who <u>explore</u> lead the world.
extension.translation: 历史表明，勇于探索的国家引领世界。

extension.text: So let's keep pushing boundaries, because the next giant leap is just around the corner.
extension.annotatedText: So let's keep <u>pushing</u> boundaries, because the next <u>giant leap</u> is just around the corner.
extension.translation: 所以让我们继续突破界限，因为下一次巨大飞跃就在眼前。

extension.text: We're building a future where our children will walk on Mars and maybe even beyond.
extension.annotatedText: We're building a <u>future</u> where our <u>children</u> will walk on Mars and maybe even <u>beyond</u>.
extension.translation: 我们正在建设一个未来，我们的孩子将在火星上行走，甚至更远。

practice.text: The universe is calling, and we must answer.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>universe</u> is <u>calling</u>, and we must <u>answer</u>.
practice.translation: 宇宙在召唤，我们必须回应。

practice.text: It's not about the destination; it's about the journey.
practice.annotatedText: It's not about the <u>destination</u>; it's about the <u>journey</u>.
practice.translation: 重要的不是目的地，而是旅程。

practice.text: We choose to go to the moon not because it is easy, but because it is hard.
practice.annotatedText: We <u>choose</u> to go to the <u>moon</u> not because it is <u>easy</u>, but because it is <u>hard</u>.
practice.translation: 我们选择登月不是因为它容易，而是因为它困难。

practice.text: Exploration is written in our DNA.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Exploration</u> is <u>written</u> in our <u>DNA</u>.
practice.translation: 探索刻在我们的基因里。

practice.text: Every step into the unknown is a leap for humanity.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>step</u> into the un<u>known</u> is a <u>leap</u> for humanity.
practice.translation: 迈向未知的每一步都是人类的一大步。

practice.text: The risks are real, but the rewards are greater.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>risks</u> are <u>real</u>, but the <u>rewards</u> are greater.
practice.translation: 风险是真实的，但回报更大。

practice.text: We're not just exploring space; we're discovering ourselves.
practice.annotatedText: We're not just <u>exploring</u> space; we're <u>discovering</u> our<u>selves</u>.
practice.translation: 我们不仅仅在探索太空；我们在发现自我。

practice.text: The next giant leap is just around the corner.
practice.annotatedText: The next <u>giant leap</u> is just around the <u>corner</u>.
practice.translation: 下一次巨大飞跃就在眼前。

extension.text: It's about creating a space where everyone feels they truly belong.
extension.annotatedText: It's about <u>cre</u>ating a <u>space</u> where everyone feels they truly be<u>long</u>.
extension.translation: 这是关于创造一个让每个人都感到真正归属的空间。

extension.text: When we listen to different perspectives, we grow stronger together.
extension.annotatedText: When we <u>lis</u>ten to <u>dif</u>ferent perspectives, we grow <u>strong</u>er together.
extension.translation: 当我们倾听不同的观点时，我们共同变得更强大。

extension.text: It's not enough to just open the door — we have to welcome everyone in.
extension.annotatedText: It's not e<u>nough</u> to just <u>o</u>pen the door — we have to <u>wel</u>come everyone in.
extension.translation: 仅仅开门是不够的——我们必须欢迎每个人进来。

extension.text: True inclusion means changing the system so that no one is left behind.
extension.annotatedText: True in<u>clu</u>sion means <u>chang</u>ing the system so that no one is left be<u>hind</u>.
extension.translation: 真正的包容意味着改变制度，不让任何人掉队。

extension.text: We all have biases, but we can choose to challenge them every day.
extension.annotatedText: We all have <u>bi</u>ases, but we can choose to <u>chal</u>lenge them every <u>day</u>.
extension.translation: 我们都有偏见，但我们可以选择每天挑战它们。

extension.text: A diverse team is a creative team — because different ideas spark innovation.
extension.annotatedText: A di<u>verse</u> team is a <u>cre</u>ative team — because different ideas spark inno<u>va</u>tion.
extension.translation: 多元化的团队就是有创造力的团队——因为不同的想法激发创新。

extension.text: Let's build bridges, not walls, between our differences.
extension.annotatedText: Let's <u>build</u> bridges, not <u>walls</u>, between our <u>dif</u>ferences.
extension.translation: 让我们在差异之间架起桥梁，而不是筑起高墙。

extension.text: And remember, inclusion starts with each one of us, right here and now.
extension.annotatedText: And re<u>mem</u>ber, in<u>clu</u>sion starts with each one of <u>us</u>, right here and now.
extension.translation: 记住，包容始于我们每一个人，就在此时此地。

practice.text: Diversity is a fact, but inclusion is a choice.
practice.annotatedText: Di<u>ver</u>sity is a <u>fact</u>, but in<u>clu</u>sion is a choice.
practice.translation: 多元化是事实，但包容是一种选择。

practice.text: We need to move from tolerance to true belonging.
practice.annotatedText: We need to <u>move</u> from <u>tol</u>erance to true be<u>long</u>ing.
practice.translation: 我们需要从容忍走向真正的归属。

practice.text: Inclusion means making sure every voice is heard and valued.
practice.annotatedText: In<u>clu</u>sion means making sure <u>ev</u>ery voice is heard and <u>val</u>ued.
practice.translation: 包容意味着确保每一个声音都被倾听和重视。

practice.text: Our differences make us unique, and that's our greatest asset.
practice.annotatedText: Our <u>dif</u>ferences make us u<u>nique</u>, and that's our <u>great</u>est asset.
practice.translation: 我们的差异使我们独特，这是我们最大的财富。

practice.text: Don't just invite someone to the table; ask them what they think.
practice.annotatedText: Don't just in<u>vite</u> someone to the <u>ta</u>ble; ask them <u>what</u> they think.
practice.translation: 不要只是邀请某人到桌前；问问他们的想法。

practice.text: True inclusion changes the way we work, not just the way we look.
practice.annotatedText: True in<u>clu</u>sion <u>chang</u>es the way we work, not just the way we <u>look</u>.
practice.translation: 真正的包容改变了我们的工作方式，而不仅仅是我们的外表。

practice.text: When we embrace diversity, we unlock potential we never knew we had.
practice.annotatedText: When we em<u>brace</u> di<u>ver</u>sity, we unlock po<u>ten</u>tial we never knew we had.
practice.translation: 当我们拥抱多元化时，我们释放了从未意识到的潜力。

practice.text: Inclusion isn't a destination; it's a journey we take together.
practice.annotatedText: In<u>clu</u>sion isn't a desti<u>na</u>tion; it's a <u>jour</u>ney we take together.
practice.translation: 包容不是一个终点，而是我们共同踏上的旅程。

extension.text: They often laugh about how a late bus changed their lives.
extension.annotatedText: They often <u>laugh</u> about how a <u>late</u> bus changed their <u>lives</u>.
extension.translation: 他们常常笑谈一辆晚点的公交车如何改变了他们的人生。

extension.text: Now they always sit together on the bus, holding hands.
extension.annotatedText: Now they <u>al</u>ways sit to<u>geth</u>er on the bus, <u>hold</u>ing hands.
extension.translation: 现在他们总是一起坐公交，手牵着手。

extension.text: Sometimes they even get off a stop early just to walk home.
extension.annotatedText: Sometimes they <u>e</u>ven get off a <u>stop</u> <u>ear</u>ly just to walk home.
extension.translation: 有时候他们甚至会提前一站下车，就为了走回家。

extension.text: Their friends say it's a fairy tale, but they know it's just luck.
extension.annotatedText: Their <u>friends</u> say it's a <u>fair</u>y tale, but they <u>know</u> it's just luck.
extension.translation: 朋友们说这是个童话故事，但他们知道这不过是运气。

extension.text: Every morning at the bus stop, they still see strangers who never talk.
extension.annotatedText: <u>Eve</u>ry <u>morn</u>ing at the bus stop, they still see <u>stran</u>gers who never talk.
extension.translation: 每天早上在公交车站，他们还能看到那些从不说话的陌生人。

extension.text: And they smile, remembering how they used to be like that.
extension.annotatedText: And they <u>smile</u>, remem<u>ber</u>ing how they <u>used</u> to be like that.
extension.translation: 然后他们笑了，想起他们曾经也是那样。

practice.text: The bus was fifteen minutes late that day.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>bus</u> was <u>fif</u>teen <u>mi</u>nutes late that day.
practice.translation: 那天公交车晚了十五分钟。

practice.text: Two strangers met at a bus stop.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Two</u> <u>stran</u>gers met at a <u>bus</u> stop.
practice.translation: 两个陌生人在公交车站相遇。

practice.text: They never spoke for three years.
practice.annotatedText: They <u>nev</u>er <u>spoke</u> for <u>three</u> years.
practice.translation: 他们三年没说过话。

practice.text: One was reading, the other listening to music.
practice.annotatedText: <u>One</u> was <u>read</u>ing, the <u>oth</u>er listening to music.
practice.translation: 一个在看书，另一个在听音乐。

practice.text: A late bus changed their lives forever.
practice.annotatedText: A <u>late</u> <u>bus</u> changed their <u>lives</u> forever.
practice.translation: 一辆晚点的公交车永远改变了他们的人生。

practice.text: Now they are married with two kids.
practice.annotatedText: Now they are <u>mar</u>ried with <u>two</u> <u>kids</u>.
practice.translation: 现在他们结婚了，还有两个孩子。

practice.text: Important moments don't announce themselves.
practice.annotatedText: Im<u>por</u>tant <u>mo</u>ments don't an<u>nounce</u> themselves.
practice.translation: 重要的时刻不会提前宣告。

practice.text: They show up and change everything.
practice.annotatedText: They <u>show</u> up and <u>change</u> <u>eve</u>rything.
practice.translation: 它们悄然而至，改变一切。

extension.text: She never told anyone herself — her neighbor figured it out by seeing her leave the house early one morning with a basket.
extension.annotatedText: She never <u>told</u> anyone herself — her neighbor <u>figured it out</u> by seeing her leave the house early one morning with a <u>basket</u>.
extension.translation: 她自己从没告诉任何人——是她的邻居有天清早看到她提着篮子出门才发现的。

extension.text: When people thanked her, she just smiled and said, "Baking is my way of giving hugs."
extension.annotatedText: When people <u>thanked</u> her, she just smiled and said, "<u>Baking</u> is my way of giving <u>hugs</u>."
extension.translation: 人们感谢她时，她只是笑着说：“烘焙就是我的拥抱方式。”

extension.text: Soon, others in the neighborhood started baking too, leaving bread, cookies, and cakes on windowsills for anyone who needed a little kindness.
extension.annotatedText: Soon, others in the <u>neighborhood</u> started <u>baking</u> too, leaving bread, cookies, and cakes on windowsills for anyone who needed a little <u>kindness</u>.
extension.translation: 很快，社区里其他人也开始烘焙，把面包、饼干和蛋糕放在窗台上，给任何需要一点温暖的人。

extension.text: The woman's small act of generosity grew into a tradition that lasted long after the pandemic was over.
extension.annotatedText: The woman's small act of <u>generosity</u> grew into a <u>tradition</u> that lasted long after the pandemic was <u>over</u>.
extension.translation: 老太太小小的善举变成了一项传统，疫情结束后还持续了很久。

extension.text: Now, every Sunday morning, you can still see fresh loaves wrapped in brown paper on windowsills, reminding everyone that we're all in this together.
extension.annotatedText: Now, every <u>Sunday</u> morning, you can still see fresh loaves wrapped in brown paper on windowsills, reminding everyone that we're <u>all in this together</u>.
extension.translation: 如今，每个周日的早晨，你还能看到窗台上包在牛皮纸里的新鲜面包，提醒着每个人我们同舟共济。

practice.text: The bread was always warm and wrapped in brown paper.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>bread</u> was always <u>warm</u> and wrapped in brown <u>paper</u>.
practice.translation: 面包总是热乎乎的，用牛皮纸包着。

practice.text: She used her savings to buy flour and sugar.
practice.annotatedText: She used her <u>savings</u> to buy <u>flour</u> and <u>sugar</u>.
practice.translation: 她用存款买面粉和糖。

practice.text: Nobody knew who the mysterious baker was.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Nobody</u> knew who the <u>mysterious</u> <u>baker</u> was.
practice.translation: 没人知道那个神秘的面包师是谁。

practice.text: The note said, "You are not alone."
practice.annotatedText: The note said, "<u>You</u> are not a<u>lone</u>."
practice.translation: 纸条上写着：“你不是一个人。”

practice.text: An elderly woman had been a baker before she retired.
practice.annotatedText: An <u>elderly</u> woman had been a <u>baker</u> before she re<u>tired</u>.
practice.translation: 一位老太太退休前是个面包师。

practice.text: Her neighbor figured it out by seeing her leave early one morning.
practice.annotatedText: Her <u>neighbor</u> <u>figured it out</u> by seeing her leave early one <u>morning</u>.
practice.translation: 她的邻居有一天清早看到她出门才发现的。

practice.text: Baking is her way of giving hugs to the neighborhood.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Baking</u> is her way of giving <u>hugs</u> to the <u>neighborhood</u>.
practice.translation: 烘焙是她给社区拥抱的方式。

practice.text: The tradition continued long after the pandemic ended.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>tradition</u> continued long after the <u>pandemic</u> <u>ended</u>.
practice.translation: 疫情结束后，这个传统还持续了很久。

extension.text: He was seventy-eight years old, and he said it was the best night of his life.
extension.annotatedText: He was <u>seven</u>ty-eight years old, and he said it was the <u>best</u> night of his life.
extension.translation: 他七十八岁了，说那是他一生中最美好的一晚。

extension.text: The next morning, news of the discovery spread all over the world.
extension.annotatedText: The <u>next</u> morning, news of the discovery spread <u>all over</u> the world.
extension.translation: 第二天早上，发现彗星的消息传遍了全世界。

extension.text: People who had called him a failure suddenly wanted to shake his hand.
extension.annotatedText: People who had called him a <u>fail</u>ure suddenly wanted to <u>shake</u> his hand.
extension.translation: 那些曾说他失败的人突然都想和他握手。

extension.text: But Professor Chen didn't care about the fame. He just wanted to look at his comet one more time.
extension.annotatedText: But Professor Chen <u>didn't</u> care about the fame. He just wanted to look at his <u>com</u>et one more time.
extension.translation: 但陈教授不在乎名声。他只是想再看一眼他的彗星。

extension.text: He spent the next few weeks showing it to students and fellow astronomers.
extension.annotatedText: He spent the <u>next</u> few weeks <u>show</u>ing it to students and fellow astronomers.
extension.translation: 接下来几周，他忙着向学生和其他天文学家展示这颗彗星。

extension.text: Then one evening, he packed up his old telescope and went home. He said his work was done.
extension.annotatedText: Then one <u>eve</u>ning, he packed up his old telescope and went home. He said his <u>work</u> was done.
extension.translation: 然后一天晚上，他收好旧望远镜回家了。他说他的工作完成了。

practice.text: He scanned the sky every night for forty years.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>scanned</u> the sky <u>eve</u>ry night for <u>for</u>ty years.
practice.translation: 他每晚都扫描天空，坚持了四十年。

practice.text: That little blurry dot in the telescope changed everything.
practice.annotatedText: That <u>lit</u>tle <u>blur</u>ry dot in the telescope <u>changed</u> everything.
practice.translation: 望远镜里那个模糊的小点改变了一切。

practice.text: His colleagues whispered, but he kept his eyes on the stars.
practice.annotatedText: His <u>col</u>leagues whispered, but he kept his <u>eyes</u> on the stars.
practice.translation: 同事们在背后嘀咕，但他始终望着星空。

practice.text: The comet was just a faint light at first, barely visible.
practice.annotatedText: The comet was just a <u>faint</u> light at first, <u>bare</u>ly visible.
practice.translation: 那颗彗星起初只是一道微弱的光，几乎看不见。

practice.text: He didn't give up even when everyone else had.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>didn't</u> give up <u>e</u>ven when <u>eve</u>ryone else had.
practice.translation: 即使其他人都放弃了，他也没有放弃。

practice.text: Patience and passion — that's what it takes to find a comet.
practice.annotatedText: <u>Pa</u>tience and <u>pas</u>sion — that's what it takes to find a <u>com</u>et.
practice.translation: 耐心和热情——这就是找到彗星所需要的。

practice.text: He proved that failure is just a step on the road to success.
practice.annotatedText: He <u>proved</u> that <u>fail</u>ure is just a step on the road to <u>suc</u>cess.
practice.translation: 他证明了失败只是成功路上的一个台阶。

practice.text: Now his name is written in the stars forever.
practice.annotatedText: Now his <u>name</u> is written in the <u>stars</u> for<u>e</u>ver.
practice.translation: 如今他的名字永远刻在了星辰之中。

extension.text: I remember the first time I got a melody out of it — it was shaky and out of tune, but I didn't care.
extension.annotatedText: I remember the <u>first</u> time I got a melody out of it — it was <u>shaky</u> and out of tune, but I <u>didn't care</u>.
extension.translation: 我记得第一次吹出旋律的时候——声音颤抖还跑调，但我根本不在乎。

extension.text: I kept practicing in my tiny apartment, late at night, so no one would hear me mess up.
extension.annotatedText: I kept <u>practicing</u> in my tiny apartment, <u>late at night</u>, so no one would hear me <u>mess up</u>.
extension.translation: 我就在小公寓里练，练到深夜，这样别人就听不到我吹错了。

extension.text: After a few weeks I could play Moon River without stopping, and I cried the first time I did it.
extension.annotatedText: After a <u>few weeks</u> I could play Moon River without stopping, and I <u>cried</u> the first time I did it.
extension.translation: 几周后我终于能完整地吹完《月亮河》了，第一次成功时我哭了。

extension.text: I started playing for my friends, and they said it sounded like Grandpa was in the room.
extension.annotatedText: I started playing for my <u>friends</u>, and they said it sounded like <u>Grandpa</u> was in the room.
extension.translation: 我开始吹给朋友们听，他们说感觉爷爷就在房间里。

extension.text: Now I take the harmonica everywhere — to parties, to parks, even on trips abroad.
extension.annotatedText: Now I <u>take</u> the harmonica everywhere — to <u>parties</u>, to <u>parks</u>, even on trips abroad.
extension.translation: 现在我随身带着口琴——去派对、去公园、甚至出国旅游都带着。

extension.text: Last month I played at a small open mic night, and I dedicated the song to him.
extension.annotatedText: Last month I played at a <u>small</u> open mic night, and I <u>dedicated</u> the song to him.
extension.translation: 上个月我在一个小型开放麦之夜表演，把曲子献给了他。

extension.text: After the show an old man came up to me and said, 'Your grandpa would be proud.'

extension.text: That harmonica isn't just an instrument — it's a bridge between me and the man I miss every day.

extension.text: It's the mirror we hold up to ourselves, reflecting our joys, our struggles, and our deepest fears.

extension.text: Without art, we lose a part of what makes us human — our ability to imagine, to empathize, to connect.
extension.annotatedText: Without <u>art</u>, we <u>lose</u> a part of what makes us human — our ability to imagine, to empathize, to connect.

extension.text: Think about the last time a song moved you to tears or a film changed how you saw the world.

extension.translation: 想想上一次一首歌让你落泪，或者一部电影改变了你看世界的方式。

extension.text: That's the power of art — it speaks to us in a language beyond words.

extension.translation: 那就是艺术的力量——它用一种超越语言的语言对我们说话。

extension.text: In schools, art programs aren't just about painting or music; they teach critical thinking and creativity.

extension.translation: 在学校，艺术课程不只是画画或音乐；它们教批判性思维和创造力。

extension.text: We must invest in the arts, not as an afterthought, but as a fundamental pillar of society.
extension.annotatedText: We <u>must</u> invest in the arts, not as an afterthought, but as a <u>fundamental pillar</u> of society.
extension.translation: 我们必须投资艺术，不是作为事后考虑，而是作为社会的基本支柱。

extension.text: Because when we nurture creativity, we nurture the future.
extension.annotatedText: Because when we <u>nurture</u> creativity, we nurture the <u>future</u>.
extension.translation: 因为当我们培育创造力时，我们就在培育未来。

extension.text: So let's not ask whether we can afford art. Let's ask whether we can afford to live without it.
extension.annotatedText: So let's not ask whether we can <u>afford</u> art. Let's ask whether we can <u>afford</u> to live without it.
extension.translation: 所以不要问我们是否负担得起艺术。问问我们能否承受没有它的生活。

practice.text: Art is the soul of a civilization.
practice.annotatedText: Art is the <u>soul</u> of a civilization.
practice.translation: 艺术是文明的灵魂。

practice.text: We look into the eyes of someone who lived centuries ago.
practice.annotatedText: We <u>look</u> into the eyes of someone who lived <u>centuries</u> ago.

practice.text: In crisis, we turn to art for comfort and hope.

practice.translation: 在危机中，我们转向艺术寻求安慰和希望。

practice.text: A society that neglects the arts neglects its own humanity.
practice.annotatedText: A society that <u>neglects</u> the arts neglects its own <u>humanity</u>.

practice.text: The arts teach us critical thinking and empathy.

practice.text: We must invest in art as a fundamental pillar.

practice.text: When we nurture creativity, we nurture the future.

extension.text: He took a deep breath and looked up at the station. "It's strange," he said softly. "I've been coming here every day for so long."

extension.text: Miller smiled and handed over his keys. "Take care of the streets, Jenkins. They're not just roads — they're people's homes."

extension.text: He turned to leave, but then he saw Mrs. Chen from the corner shop rushing over with a small box. "For you, Sergeant. Homemade cookies. You always looked out for us."

extension.text: When you wake up early and do the work, you're not just building habits, you're building character.

extension.text: She'd never met anyone like Mr. Patel before — he always listened more than he spoke, and his tea tasted of cardamom and patience.

extension.text: One chilly Tuesday, she asked, "Mr. Patel, why do you still pour a cup for your wife?"

extension.text: And Mr. Patel started to notice that the second cup wasn't just for his wife anymore — it was for friendship, for memory, for the warmth that grows when two lonely people sit together.
extension.annotatedText: And Mr. Patel started to <u>no</u>tice that the second cup wasn't just for his wife anymore — it was for <u>friend</u>ship, for <u>memo</u>ry, for the warmth that grows when two lonely people sit together.
extension.translation: 而Patel先生开始注意到，第二杯茶不再只是给他妻子的——它是为了友谊，为了记忆，为了两个孤独的人坐在一起时产生的温暖。

practice.text: Mr. Patel poured the tea slowly, watching the steam rise.
practice.annotatedText: Mr. <u>Pa</u>tel poured the tea <u>slow</u>ly, watching the <u>steam</u> rise.
practice.translation: Patel先生慢慢地倒茶，看着蒸汽升起。

practice.text: Every Tuesday she knocked on his door at exactly four o'clock.
practice.annotatedText: Every <u>Tues</u>day she knocked on his door at ex<u>act</u>ly <u>four</u> o'clock.
practice.translation: 每个星期二她都准时四点敲他的门。

practice.text: He never forgot to put a spoon of honey in her cup — just the way she liked it.
practice.annotatedText: He never for<u>got</u> to put a spoon of <u>hon</u>ey in her cup — just the way she <u>liked</u> it.
practice.translation: 他从不忘记在她的杯子里放一勺蜂蜜——就按她喜欢的方式。

practice.text: The kettle whistled, and the kitchen filled with the smell of ginger and cloves.
practice.annotatedText: The <u>ket</u>tle whistled, and the kitchen filled with the smell of <u>gin</u>ger and <u>cloves</u>.
practice.translation: 水壶响了，厨房里弥漫着生姜和丁香的味道。

practice.text: "My wife loved this blend," he said, handing her a cup.
practice.annotatedText: "My wife <u>loved</u> this blend," he said, <u>hand</u>ing her a cup.
practice.translation: “我妻子喜欢这种混合茶，”他说着递给她一杯。

practice.text: She held the cup close to her face, letting the warmth sink in.
practice.annotatedText: She held the cup <u>close</u> to her face, letting the <u>warmth</u> sink <u>in</u>.
practice.translation: 她把杯子贴近脸庞，让温暖渗入。

practice.text: Their conversations were soft, like the steam from the teacups.
practice.annotatedText: Their conversations were <u>soft</u>, like the <u>steam</u> from the <u>tea</u>cups.
practice.translation: 他们的谈话很轻柔，就像茶杯里的蒸汽。

practice.text: And so the ritual continued — one cup for the past, one cup for the present.
practice.annotatedText: And so the <u>rit</u>ual continued — one cup for the <u>past</u>, one cup for the <u>pres</u>ent.
practice.translation: 于是这个仪式继续着——一杯为过去，一杯为现在。

extension.text: I've learned that change isn't something to fear but to embrace with open arms.
extension.annotatedText: I've learned that change <u>isn't</u> something to <u>fear</u> but to embrace with <u>open arms</u>.
extension.translation: 我明白了，变化不是用来害怕的，而是应该张开双臂去拥抱的。

extension.text: Every step forward means leaving something behind, but that's what growth is all about.
extension.annotatedText: Every step <u>forward</u> means leaving something behind, but that's what <u>growth</u> is all about.
extension.translation: 每往前走一步，就意味着要留下些什么，但这正是成长的意义。

extension.text: You've given me the courage to start anew, and for that I'll always be grateful.
extension.annotatedText: You've given me the <u>courage</u> to start anew, and for that I'll <u>always</u> be grateful.
extension.translation: 你们给了我重新开始的勇气，为此我将永远心存感激。

extension.text: Let's not dwell on the sadness of parting but celebrate the journey we've shared.
extension.annotatedText: Let's not dwell on the <u>sadness</u> of parting but <u>celebrate</u> the journey we've shared.
extension.translation: 与其沉浸在离别的悲伤中，不如一起庆祝我们共同走过的旅程。

extension.text: I'm taking your kindness and wisdom with me wherever I go.
extension.annotatedText: I'm <u>taking</u> your kindness and wisdom with me wherever I <u>go</u>.
extension.translation: 无论我去到哪里，都会带上你们的善良和智慧。

extension.text: So here's to the memories we made and the ones we'll make in the future.
extension.annotatedText: So <u>here's</u> to the memories we made and the ones we'll <u>make</u> in the future.
extension.translation: 那么，为我们已经创造的回忆，以及未来将创造的回忆，干杯。

extension.text: Don't worry about me; I'll be fine because you've equipped me well.
extension.annotatedText: Don't <u>worry</u> about me; I'll be fine because you've <u>equipped</u> me well.
extension.translation: 别担心我，我会好好的，因为你们让我装备齐全。

practice.text: Saying goodbye isn't easy, but it's necessary.
practice.annotatedText: Saying <u>goodbye</u> isn't <u>easy</u>, but it's <u>necessary</u>.
practice.translation: 说再见不容易，但却是必要的。

practice.text: This chapter closes, but the story continues.
practice.annotatedText: This <u>chapter</u> closes, but the <u>story</u> continues.
practice.translation: 这一章结束了，但故事还在继续。

practice.text: I'll cherish the moments we laughed together until the tears came.
practice.annotatedText: I'll <u>cherish</u> the moments we <u>laughed</u> together until the tears came.
practice.translation: 我会珍惜我们一起笑到流泪的时光。

practice.text: You've taught me that endings can be beautiful too.
practice.annotatedText: You've taught me that <u>endings</u> can be <u>beautiful</u> too.
practice.translation: 你们让我明白，结局也可以很美好。

practice.text: From this farewell, I carry your spirit in my heart.
practice.annotatedText: From this farewell, I <u>carry</u> your <u>spirit</u> in my heart.
practice.translation: 从这次告别中，我把你们的精神带在心里。

practice.text: Don't say it's over; say it's just begun in a new place.
practice.annotatedText: Don't say it's <u>over</u>; say it's just <u>begun</u> in a new place.
practice.translation: 别说结束了，说它才刚刚在新的地方开始。

practice.text: Our paths may diverge, but our hearts remain connected.
practice.annotatedText: Our <u>paths</u> may diverge, but our <u>hearts</u> remain connected.
practice.translation: 我们的路或许会分开，但心依然相连。

practice.text: Let this goodbye be a gentle push into our next adventure.
practice.annotatedText: Let this goodbye be a <u>gentle</u> push into our next <u>adventure</u>.
practice.translation: 让这次告别成为我们下一次冒险的温柔助推。
